storage.portable.en_us:
## Backpacks carry the working load

A <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:backpack" /> is a chest you wear. Each tier adds storage slots and upgrade slots, and the backpack keeps its contents when you take it off.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:copper_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:iron_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:gold_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:diamond_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:netherite_backpack" /></ItemGrid>

| Tier | Storage slots | Upgrade slots |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:backpack" /> | 9 | 1 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:copper_backpack" /> | 18 | 1 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:iron_backpack" /> | 27 | 2 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:gold_backpack" /> | 36 | 2 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:diamond_backpack" /> | 45 | 3 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:netherite_backpack" /> | 54 | 3 |

The leather backpack is the first craft. Each step after it upgrades the backpack you already carry, so its contents survive the upgrade. The diamond step needs a shulker shell, and the netherite step is a smithing upgrade.

One rule in this pack surprises people. Shulker boxes, including the reinforced ones, are refused inside a backpack. The server configuration blocks every vanilla and reinforced shulker box as backpack contents, so a backpack cannot be used to nest shulker storage.

***

## Upgrades worth their slot

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:upgrade_base" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:crafting_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:stonecutter_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:tool_swapper_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:refill_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:feeding_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.alchemy_bench_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.botanist_workbench_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.carpenters_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.glassblower_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.loom_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.mason_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.tinkering_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:jukebox_upgrade" /></ItemGrid>

| Upgrade | Saves you |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:crafting_upgrade" /> | A crafting table in the field |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:stonecutter_upgrade" /> | A stonecutter, for shaped blocks |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:tool_swapper_upgrade" /> | Opening the inventory to change tool |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:refill_upgrade" /> | Restocking a hotbar stack from the pack |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:feeding_upgrade" /> | Eating from the pack during a fight |

<Recipe id="sophisticatedbackpacks:upgrade_base" />

<Recipe id="sophisticatedbackpacks:crafting_upgrade" />

The upgrade base needs brass, so the first upgrade arrives after a Create workshop, not before it. This pack also carries seven Chipped workstation upgrades, which turn the backpack into a portable botanist bench, glassblower, carpenter table, mason table, loom, alchemy bench or tinkering table.

Stack multipliers, nested portable containers, automatic processing, fluid storage, energy storage and creature capture are not available here. Plan around the basic versions rather than expecting an upgraded variant.

***

## Shulker boxes for the big haul

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:copper_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:iron_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:gold_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:diamond_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:netherite_shulker_box" /></ItemGrid>

| Box | Slots | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Vanilla shulker box | 27 | Keeps contents when broken |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:copper_shulker_box" /> | 45 | First reinforced tier |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:iron_shulker_box" /> | 54 | Same as a double chest |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:gold_shulker_box" /> | 81 | Three chests |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:diamond_shulker_box" /> | 108 | Four chests |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:netherite_shulker_box" /> | 108 | Resists blast, fire and lava |

Reinforced boxes are crafted from reinforced chests or in the shaped recipe, and the netherite tier is a smithing upgrade. Any tier can be dyed, which is the cheapest way to label a wall of storage.

Easy Shulker Boxes lets you open a supported shulker box from the inventory instead of placing it. Shulker Drops Two raises the shell drop to two by default in this pack, so a shulker farm pays back faster.

Next step is storage that a factory can fill. [Bulk storage](storage.bulk.md) covers vaults and silos.
storage.portable.zh_cn:
## 背包承担工作负载

<ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:backpack" /> 是穿在身上的箱子。每一级增加储存格与升级槽，取下背包时里面的东西仍然保留。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:copper_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:iron_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:gold_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:diamond_backpack" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:netherite_backpack" /></ItemGrid>

| 等级 | 储存格 | 升级槽 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:backpack" /> | 9 | 1 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:copper_backpack" /> | 18 | 1 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:iron_backpack" /> | 27 | 2 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:gold_backpack" /> | 36 | 2 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:diamond_backpack" /> | 45 | 3 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:netherite_backpack" /> | 54 | 3 |

皮革背包是第一件。之后每一步都是升级你已经在背的那一只，里面的东西会跟着升级保留。钻石一步需要潜影壳，下界合金一步是锻造升级。

本包有一条容易踩到的规则。潜影盒，包括加固潜影盒，都不能放进背包。服务端配置把原版与加固潜影盒全部列为背包禁用物品，因此背包不能用来套放潜影储存。

***

## 值得占一个槽的升级

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:upgrade_base" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:crafting_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:stonecutter_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:tool_swapper_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:refill_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:feeding_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.alchemy_bench_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.botanist_workbench_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.carpenters_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.glassblower_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.loom_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.mason_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:chipped.tinkering_table_upgrade" /><ItemIcon id="sophisticatedbackpacks:jukebox_upgrade" /></ItemGrid>

| 升级 | 省掉什么 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:crafting_upgrade" /> | 外出的工作台 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:stonecutter_upgrade" /> | 切石机，用于成形方块 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:tool_swapper_upgrade" /> | 开物品栏换工具 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:refill_upgrade" /> | 从背包补满快捷栏那一叠 |
| <ItemLink id="sophisticatedbackpacks:feeding_upgrade" /> | 战斗中从背包进食 |

<Recipe id="sophisticatedbackpacks:upgrade_base" />

<Recipe id="sophisticatedbackpacks:crafting_upgrade" />

升级基底需要黄铜，因此第一件升级出现在 Create 工坊之后，而不是之前。本包还带七个 Chipped 工作站升级，把背包变成便携的植物学家工作台、吹玻璃台、木工台、石匠台、织布机、炼金台或修补台。

堆叠倍率、嵌套便携容器、自动加工、流体储存、能量储存与生物捕捉在这里都不可用。按基础版本规划，不要期待升级版。

***

## 大批搬运用潜影盒

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:copper_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:iron_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:gold_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:diamond_shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="reinfshulker:netherite_shulker_box" /></ItemGrid>

| 潜影盒 | 格数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 原版潜影盒 | 27 | 破坏后保留内容 |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:copper_shulker_box" /> | 45 | 第一个加固等级 |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:iron_shulker_box" /> | 54 | 与双箱相同 |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:gold_shulker_box" /> | 81 | 三个箱子 |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:diamond_shulker_box" /> | 108 | 四个箱子 |
| <ItemLink id="reinfshulker:netherite_shulker_box" /> | 108 | 抗爆炸、火焰与熔岩 |

加固潜影盒由加固箱子或成形配方制作，下界合金等级是锻造升级。任何等级都能染色，这是给一整面储存墙贴标签最便宜的办法。

Easy Shulker Boxes 让你直接从物品栏打开受支持的潜影盒，不必放下。本包默认把 Shulker Drops Two 的掉落设为两个壳，因此潜影农场回本更快。

下一步是工厂能自己装满的储存。[大宗储存](storage.bulk.md)说明储物仓与筒仓。

travel.destinations.en_us:
## Waystone network

![A Waystone above the landscape](images/visual-mountaintop-waystone.png)

A Waystone above the landscape

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mossy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:deepslate_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blackstone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:sandy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:red_nether_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:end_stone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mud_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:prismarine_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:purpur_waystone" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="waystones:waystone" /> becomes a destination only after you use it once. That first use activates it and adds it to your list. An unactivated stone does not appear in the travel screen, which is the usual reason a base you can see is not on the list.

The material is appearance. A mossy, deepslate, blackstone, sandy, nether brick or end stone waystone behaves like the plain one. The screen shows the experience cost and any cooldown before you confirm, so read the row rather than clicking through.

## Portable and shared travel

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_stone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blank_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:white_portstone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_plate" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:dormant_shard" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:attuned_shard" /></ItemGrid>

| Item | Scope | How it works |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_stone" /> | Personal, to any activated stone | Use it to open the list |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:blank_scroll" /> | Personal, one destination | Use it on a waystone to bind it |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /> | Group, stones of the same colour | Connect matching colours |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:white_portstone" /> | Departure only | Trades access for a destination slot |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> | Paired plates | Attune a shard in one, carry it to the other |

A <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> pair is the only one of these that moves you between two fixed points without a waystone at either end. Attune a <ItemLink id="waystones:dormant_shard" /> in the first plate, then use the <ItemLink id="waystones:attuned_shard" /> on the second. Recolour a sharestone with the recipe below to put it in a different group.

<Recipe id="waystones:orange_sharestone_recolor" />

## Tempad

![Tempad destination equipment](images/feedback-tempad.png)

Tempad destination equipment

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tempad:tempad" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_card" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:workstation" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_generator" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_cell" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:card_wallet" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronometer" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_battery" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_broadcaster" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_marker" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="tempad:tempad" /> stores <ItemLink id="tempad:location_card" /> entries and opens a <ItemLink id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /> door to one of them. It is a coordinate system, not a network. A saved place is a fixed point, so it does not follow a moving ship, and it does not know whether the destination is still safe.

Power comes from chronon equipment. A <ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_generator" /> with a <ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_cell" /> is the stationary supply, and the <ItemLink id="tempad:workstation" /> is where cards and devices are made. Check the card in the Tempad screen before you step through.

## Moving destinations

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /></ItemGrid>

Waystones: Sable lets a waystone travel on an assembled body. Place and activate the waystone on the ship, and it appears as a destination in the Sable group. It teleports the player to the moving stone, not the ship to another dimension.

Create: AeroWarptics relocates an assembled ship within one dimension. Neither addon is a cross dimension ship transfer. For that, see [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md).

## Choosing a system

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:obsidian" /></ItemGrid>

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| A base network you return to | Waystones |
| A group of friends sharing a base | Sharestones |
| Two fixed points with no stone | Warp plates |
| A pocket list of coordinates | Tempad |
| A destination that moves with a ship | Waystones: Sable |

travel.destinations.zh_cn:
## 传送石网络

![山巅上的传送石](images/visual-mountaintop-waystone.png)

山巅上的传送石

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mossy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:deepslate_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blackstone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:sandy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:red_nether_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:end_stone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mud_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:prismarine_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:purpur_waystone" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="waystones:waystone" /> 只有在你使用过一次之后才成为目的地。第一次使用会激活它并加入你的列表。未激活的石头不会出现在传送界面，这也是明明看得见的基地却不在列表里的常见原因。

材质只是外观。苔石、深板岩、黑石、砂岩、下界砖或末地石传送石与普通传送石行为相同。确认之前先看界面上的经验消耗与冷却，不要一路点过去。

## 随身与共享传送

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_stone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blank_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:white_portstone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_plate" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:dormant_shard" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:attuned_shard" /></ItemGrid>

| 物品 | 范围 | 用法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_stone" /> | 个人，通往任意已激活石头 | 使用后打开列表 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:blank_scroll" /> | 个人，单个目的地 | 对传送石使用以绑定 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /> | 群体，同色石头之间 | 连接相同颜色 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:white_portstone" /> | 仅作为出发点 | 用目的地名额换取通行 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> | 成对传送板 | 在一块中充能碎片，带到另一块 |

<ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> 是其中唯一不需要两端有传送石就能在两点间移动的方式。在第一块板中为 <ItemLink id="waystones:dormant_shard" /> 充能，再对第二块使用 <ItemLink id="waystones:attuned_shard" />。用下面的配方给共享石换色，就能把它归入另一组。

<Recipe id="waystones:orange_sharestone_recolor" />

## Tempad

![Tempad 传送设备](images/feedback-tempad.png)

Tempad 传送设备

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tempad:tempad" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_card" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:workstation" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_generator" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_cell" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:card_wallet" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronometer" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_battery" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_broadcaster" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_marker" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="tempad:tempad" /> 保存 <ItemLink id="tempad:location_card" /> 条目，并通过 <ItemLink id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /> 打开通往其中一处的门。它是坐标系统，不是网络。保存的位置是固定点，不会跟随移动的船，也不知道目的地是否仍然安全。

能量来自时间粒子设备。<ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_generator" /> 配 <ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_cell" /> 是固定供电，<ItemLink id="tempad:workstation" /> 用来制作卡片与设备。穿门之前先在 Tempad 界面确认卡片。

## 移动目的地

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /></ItemGrid>

Waystones: Sable 让传送石能随已组装载体移动。把传送石装在船上并激活，它就会出现在 Sable 分组里。它把玩家传送到移动中的石头，而不是把船传送到别的维度。

Create: AeroWarptics 在同一维度内迁移已组装的船。两者都不是跨维度搬运整艘船。跨维度请见[轨道飞行](space.vehicle-transfer.md)。

## 如何选择

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:obsidian" /></ItemGrid>

| 需求 | 使用 |
| --- | --- |
| 常回的基地网络 | 传送石 |
| 朋友共用一处基地 | 共享石 |
| 两端都没有传送石的两点 | 传送板 |
| 随身携带的坐标列表 | Tempad |
| 随船移动的目的地 | Waystones: Sable |

## Skill development

![Connected class skill paths](images/visual-class-skill-tree.png)

Open skills with <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" />. Pufferfish’s Skills supplies the screen and progression engine, and Skill Tree and More RPG Classes Skill Tree supply the class and weapon branches.

Kills earn tree experience through the supplied definitions, with anti-farming limits and nearby team sharing. Read a connected node before spending points on it. Class points, weapon points and ordinary experience levels are separate resources, and only the first two buy tree nodes.

1. Try a class weapon and its abilities, then open Class Skills and read its root before spending a class point. Exclusive roots prevent combining every class path.
2. Open Weapon Skills separately and spend weapon points on the branch for the weapon you actually use. A class choice and a weapon branch are related decisions, not the same purchase.
3. After a spell modifier, equip the matching book or weapon and use the named ability. Passive nodes instead describe the event that triggers them.

Arcane class modifiers develop the class-book spells, while the staff branch develops the staff itself. Buying one does not buy the other or bind a missing spell.

## 技能成长

![相互连接的职业技能路线](images/visual-class-skill-tree.png)

按 <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" /> 打开技能界面。Pufferfish’s Skills 提供界面与成长系统，Skill Tree 和 More RPG Classes Skill Tree 提供职业及武器分支。

击杀按自带定义获得技能树经验，并设有防刷限制与附近队友分享。投入点数前先看清相连节点的要求。职业点数、武器点数与普通经验等级是三种不同资源，只有前两种用于购买技能节点。

1. 先试用职业武器与招式，再打开职业技能分类阅读根节点，然后投入职业点。互斥根节点让你不能叠加所有职业路线。
2. 另行打开武器技能分类，把武器点投入实际使用武器对应的分支。职业选择与武器分支相互配合，但不是同一次购买。
3. 选好法术强化节点后，仍要装备对应书籍或武器并使用所指招式。被动节点则需满足其说明的触发条件。

奥术职业强化影响职业书法术，法杖分支发展的则是法杖本身。购买其中一项不会自动获得另一项，也不会绑定尚未学会的法术。

## Shader compatibility

![Complementary Reimagined landscape](images/feedback-shader-reimagined.png)

Complementary Reimagined landscape

Iris Flywheel Compat connects Iris shaders with optimized Flywheel rendering for Create machinery. Iris Veil Compat connects Iris with Veil effects used by Aeronautics and Sable. These are client rendering bridges, not extra shader styles or server gameplay features.

Fresh installations select Complementary Reimagined but leave shaders disabled. Enable a shader deliberately in Iris, then inspect both machinery and ship effects. Existing player settings are preserved. The Veil bridge is an alpha release, so compatibility support is not a guarantee that every shader effect renders correctly.

***

## Shaders & distance

Iris loads shader packs. Distant Horizons displays simplified distant terrain. These are separate systems.

Fresh installations enable adaptive Distant Horizons transfer speed, which adjusts terrain-data transfer to client performance. This does not set render distance or speed up terrain generation. Existing player settings are preserved.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Distant Horizons | Displays simplified terrain beyond ordinary render distance. |
| Iris Shaders | Loads shader packs. |

***

## Dynamic lighting

Sodium Dynamic Lights and its Create and Sable bridge are heavy edition only. Dynamic lighting is a visual effect, not a guarantee of server-side spawn prevention.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Create Sable Dynamic Lights (heavy edition only) | Extends dynamic lighting to Create and Sable structures. |
| Sodium Dynamic Lights (heavy edition only) | Provides dynamic lighting with Sodium settings integration. |

***

- [Shader styles](visuals.shader-packs.md)
- [Video options](visuals.interface.md)
- [Light & spawning](building.safety.md)

## 光影兼容

![Complementary Reimagined 景观](images/feedback-shader-reimagined.png)

Complementary Reimagined 景观

Iris Flywheel Compat 衔接 Iris 光影与 Create 机器使用的 Flywheel 优化渲染。Iris Veil Compat 衔接 Iris 与 Aeronautics、Sable 使用的 Veil 效果。这些属于客户端渲染兼容组件，并非额外光影风格或服务器玩法。

新安装选择 Complementary Reimagined，但默认关闭光影。在 Iris 中主动开启光影后，检查机器与船体效果。原有玩家设置会保留。Veil 兼容组件为早期测试版本，提供兼容支持不代表每种光影效果都能正确显示。

***

## 光影与远景

Iris 加载光影包，Distant Horizons 显示简化远景。它们是独立系统。

新安装默认启用 Distant Horizons 自适应传输速度，根据客户端性能调整地形数据传输。这不会设置渲染距离，也不会加快地形生成。原有玩家设置会保留。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Distant Horizons | 在普通渲染距离之外显示简化地形。 |
| Iris Shaders | 加载光影包。 |

***

## 动态光源

Sodium Dynamic Lights 及其机械动力与 Sable 兼容组件仅供重型版使用。动态光源属于视觉效果，不保证服务器阻止生物生成。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Create Sable Dynamic Lights（仅重型版） | 将动态光源扩展到机械动力与 Sable 结构。 |
| Sodium Dynamic Lights（仅重型版） | 提供动态光源与 Sodium 设置整合。 |

## World map

![World map](images/parent-world-map.png)

Xaero's World Map records explored terrain. Open it with <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_open_map" /> and zoom with the mouse wheel.

***

## Waypoints

Use <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_waypoints_key" /> to manage waypoints. Mark a base, portal or useful location so you can return to it.

Map teleportation depends on server permissions. Placing a waypoint does not grant survival teleportation.

***

## Find & share

- [Location finders](maps.find.md) for a biome or structure.
- [Shared maps](maps.shared.md) for shared explored terrain.

maps.personal.zh_cn:
## 世界地图

![世界地图](images/parent-world-map.png)

Xaero's World Map 记录已探索地形。按 <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_open_map" /> 打开，用鼠标滚轮缩放。

***

## 路标

用 <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_waypoints_key" /> 管理路标。标记基地、传送门或有用地点，方便返回。

地图传送取决于服务器权限。创建路标不会获得生存模式传送能力。

***

## 查找与共享

- [地点查找](maps.find.md)，生物群系或结构。
- [共享地图](maps.shared.md)，共享已探索地形。
- [维度](world.dimensions.md)，维度入口。

maps.shared.en_us:
## Shared terrain

![Shared map terrain](images/parent-world-map.png)

Xaero's Maps: Multiplayer+ synchronizes explored world-map terrain between players when the addon is installed on the server and participating clients.

Terrain sharing, waypoint sharing and player tracking are separate features. Do not assume another player's waypoints are copied with their terrain.

***

## Getting started

Open Maps after joining the server. Let synchronization update the explored areas before treating an empty region as unexplored.

- [Personal maps](maps.personal.md)

Cave synchronization can disable World Map's cave-layer selector. This does not mean the Minimap's cave display is also disabled.


***

## Team capes

Team Capes (heavy edition only) displays capes in your vanilla team color. It is a visual team identifier, separate from terrain synchronization and waypoint sharing.
maps.shared.zh_cn:
## 共享地形

![共享地图地形](images/parent-world-map.png)

服务器与参与玩家客户端安装 Xaero's Maps: Multiplayer+ 后，可以同步已探索的世界地图地形。

地形共享、路标共享与玩家追踪是不同功能。不要认为地形同步会一并复制其他玩家的路标。

***

## 入门

加入服务器后打开地图，等待已探索区域同步，再判断空白区域是否尚未探索。

- [个人地图](maps.personal.md)

洞穴同步可能关闭世界地图的洞穴层选择器，不代表小地图的洞穴显示也被关闭。


***

## 队伍披风

Team Capes（仅重型版）显示与原版队伍颜色一致的披风。它用于视觉识别队伍，与地形同步和路标共享分开。

adventure.bosses.en_us:
## Infernal Dragon

![Infernal Dragon](images/encounters-bossesrise-infernal-dragon.png)

Ashlord, The Infernal Dragon. Bosses'Rise. An orange winged dragon with a long tail.

Find Dragon Tower in eligible Overworld jungles, plains and savannas.

Enter the tower. Its boss spawner controls the encounter.

***

## Yeti

![Yeti](images/encounters-bossesrise-yeti.png)

Skor, The Yeti. Bosses'Rise. A pale, bulky creature with blue ice around its limbs.

Find Yeti Hideout in the Overworld Snowy Plains.

Reach the arena inside the hideout.

***

## Sandworm

![Sandworm](images/final-boss-review-sandworm.png)

Sirok, The Sandworm. Bosses'Rise. A segmented worm that moves beneath the sand.

Find Sandworm Nest in an Overworld desert.

Enter the nest.

***

## Underworld Knight

![Underworld Knight](images/encounters-bossesrise-underworld-knight.png)

Helvar, the Underworld Knight. Bosses'Rise. A dark armored knight with a large sword.

Find the underground Underworld Arena in the Nether Wastes or Soul Sand Valley.

Reach the arena.

***

## Kraken

![Kraken](images/final-boss-review-kraken.png)

Nerakyss, The Kraken. Bosses'Rise. A tentacled sea monster.

Find Kraken Ship in deep Overworld oceans, including cold and lukewarm waters.

Explore the ship. Its pirate encounter spawner controls the encounter.

***

## Ignis

![Ignis](images/encounters-l_enders-cataclysm-ignis.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. A fiery armored warrior carrying a sword and shield.

Find Burning Arena in the Nether Wastes.

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:burning_ashes" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:altar_of_fire" />
</ItemGrid>

Place one <ItemLink id="cataclysm:burning_ashes" /> in <ItemLink id="cataclysm:altar_of_fire" />. The offering is consumed when Ignis appears.

***

## Netherite Monstrosity

![Netherite Monstrosity](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-netherite-monstrosity.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. A horned giant with enormous articulated hands.

Find Soul Black Smith in the Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley or either Nether forest.

Damage the dormant giant to wake it. No summoning offering is required.

***

## Ender Guardian

![Ender Guardian](images/encounters-cataclysm-ender-guardian-publisher.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. A massive purple and gold guardian.

Find Ruined Citadel on the End Highlands and End Midlands.

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:altar_of_void" />
</ItemGrid>

Approach within six blocks of <ItemLink id="cataclysm:altar_of_void" /> on a difficulty other than Peaceful. No offering is required.

***

## The Harbinger

![The Harbinger](images/encounters-cataclysm-the-harbinger-publisher.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. A dark mechanical boss with red lights.

Find Ancient Factory beneath the Overworld in eligible Terralith caves.

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:nether_star" />
</ItemGrid>

Use one <ItemLink id="minecraft:nether_star" /> on the dormant Harbinger. It is consumed in survival.

***

## The Leviathan

![The Leviathan](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-the-leviathan.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. An aquatic creature with four mouth sections and a tongue.

Find Sunken City beneath deep Overworld oceans.

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:abyssal_sacrifice" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:altar_of_abyss" />
</ItemGrid>

Place one <ItemLink id="cataclysm:abyssal_sacrifice" /> in <ItemLink id="cataclysm:altar_of_abyss" />. The offering is consumed when the Leviathan appears. Prepare for an underwater fight.

***

## Ancient Remnant

![Ancient Remnant](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-ancient-remnant.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. A large creature with a long segmented tail.

Find Cursed Pyramid in an Overworld desert.

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:necklace_of_the_desert" />
</ItemGrid>

Use one <ItemLink id="cataclysm:necklace_of_the_desert" /> on the dormant Remnant. It is consumed in survival.

***

## Maledictus

![Maledictus](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-maledictus.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. A horned, winged warrior equipped with maces, a bow and a halberd.

Find Frosted Prison in the Overworld Snowy Plains.

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:strange_key" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:door_of_seal" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:cursed_tombstone" />
</ItemGrid>

Defeat Aptrgangr for <ItemLink id="cataclysm:strange_key" />. Use it on <ItemLink id="cataclysm:door_of_seal" /> to reach the chamber. Interact with <ItemLink id="cataclysm:cursed_tombstone" /> while holding an item once its power has recovered. The tombstone does not require a specific offering.

***

## Scylla

![Scylla](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-scylla.png)

L_Ender's Cataclysm. A humanoid warrior with sea snakes and a chained anchor.

Find Acropolis over the Overworld Warm Ocean.

Interact with the inactive Scylla to begin the encounter. No specific offering is required.

***

## Invoker

![Invoker](images/final-boss-review-invoker.png)

Illager Invasion. A spellcasting illager boss. Find it during village raids. The wave and difficulty depend on server settings.

***

## Wildfire

![Wildfire](images/encounters-friends-and-foes-forge-wildfire.png)

Friends&Foes. A blaze-like creature surrounded by broad golden shields. Find it in a Nether Citadel. Enter the structure to encounter it.

***

## Ender Dragon

![Ender Dragon](images/final-boss-review-ender-dragon.png)

Minecraft. A black winged dragon on the central End island. Reach it through an activated End portal.

***

## Wither

![Wither](images/final-boss-review-wither.png)

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:soul_sand" />
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:soul_soil" />
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull" />
</ItemGrid>

Minecraft. A floating three-headed skeleton. Build a T-shaped frame from four <ItemLink id="minecraft:soul_sand" /> or <ItemLink id="minecraft:soul_soil" />. Place three <ItemLink id="minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull" /> across the top, placing the final skull last.

***

## Difficulty

Dangerous changes existing enemy health and equipment. It does not add a separate boss roster.

***

adventure.bosses.zh_cn:
## 炼狱飞龙

![炼狱飞龙](images/encounters-bossesrise-infernal-dragon.png)

阿什洛德，炼狱飞龙。来自 Bosses'Rise。橙色的有翼飞龙，拖着长尾。

在主世界符合条件的丛林、平原与热带草原寻找 Dragon Tower。

进入龙塔，战斗由塔内的首领生成器控制。

***

## 霜冻雪怪

![霜冻雪怪](images/encounters-bossesrise-yeti.png)

斯科尔，霜冻雪怪。来自 Bosses'Rise。体形壮硕的浅色雪怪，四肢覆盖蓝色冰块。

在主世界的积雪平原寻找 Yeti Hideout。

进入藏身处内的竞技场。

***

## 巨型沙虫

![巨型沙虫](images/final-boss-review-sandworm.png)

斯洛克，巨型沙虫。来自 Bosses'Rise。会钻入沙地下方的分节巨虫。

在主世界沙漠寻找 Sandworm Nest。

进入巢穴。

***

## 冥界骑士

![冥界骑士](images/encounters-bossesrise-underworld-knight.png)

赫尔瓦，冥界骑士。来自 Bosses'Rise。身穿深色铠甲、手持大剑的骑士。

在下界荒地或灵魂沙峡谷寻找地下的 Underworld Arena。

进入竞技场。

***

## 海怪

![海怪](images/final-boss-review-kraken.png)

奈拉基斯，海怪。来自 Bosses'Rise。拥有多条触手的海怪。

在主世界深海寻找 Kraken Ship，包括冷水与温水深海。

探索海怪船，战斗由船上的海盗战斗生成器控制。

***

## 焰魔

![焰魔](images/encounters-l_enders-cataclysm-ignis.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。全身燃烧的铠甲战士，持有剑与盾。

在下界荒地寻找 Burning Arena。

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:burning_ashes" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:altar_of_fire" />
</ItemGrid>

将一份<ItemLink id="cataclysm:burning_ashes" />放入<ItemLink id="cataclysm:altar_of_fire" />。焰魔出现时会消耗祭品。

***

## 下界合金巨兽

![下界合金巨兽](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-netherite-monstrosity.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。头部有角的巨兽，拥有巨大的关节式双手。

在下界荒地、灵魂沙峡谷或两类下界森林寻找 Soul Black Smith。

对休眠中的巨兽造成伤害即可唤醒，不需要召唤祭品。

***

## 末影守卫

![末影守卫](images/encounters-cataclysm-ender-guardian-publisher.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。体形庞大的紫金色守卫。

在末地高地与末地中地寻找 Ruined Citadel。

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:altar_of_void" />
</ItemGrid>

在非和平难度下靠近<ItemLink id="cataclysm:altar_of_void" />至六格以内，不需要祭品。

***

## 先驱者

![先驱者](images/encounters-cataclysm-the-harbinger-publisher.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。带有红色灯光的深色机械首领。

在主世界地下符合条件的 Terralith 洞穴寻找 Ancient Factory。

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:nether_star" />
</ItemGrid>

对休眠中的先驱者使用一颗<ItemLink id="minecraft:nether_star" />，生存模式下会消耗物品。

***

## 利维坦

![利维坦](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-the-leviathan.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。拥有四瓣口部与长舌的水生巨兽。

在主世界深海下方寻找 Sunken City。

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:abyssal_sacrifice" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:altar_of_abyss" />
</ItemGrid>

将一份<ItemLink id="cataclysm:abyssal_sacrifice" />放入<ItemLink id="cataclysm:altar_of_abyss" />。利维坦出现时会消耗祭品，需要准备水下战斗。

***

## 远古遗魂

![远古遗魂](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-ancient-remnant.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。拥有长分节尾部的大型生物。

在主世界沙漠寻找 Cursed Pyramid。

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:necklace_of_the_desert" />
</ItemGrid>

对休眠中的远古遗魂使用一条<ItemLink id="cataclysm:necklace_of_the_desert" />，生存模式下会消耗物品。

***

## 咒翼灵骸

![咒翼灵骸](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-maledictus.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。拥有双翼与角的战士，使用双锤、弓与长戟。

在主世界的积雪平原寻找 Frosted Prison。

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:strange_key" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:door_of_seal" />
<ItemIcon id="cataclysm:cursed_tombstone" />
</ItemGrid>

击败冥行武弁获得<ItemLink id="cataclysm:strange_key" />，用它开启<ItemLink id="cataclysm:door_of_seal" />并进入首领房间。待<ItemLink id="cataclysm:cursed_tombstone" />恢复力量后，手持物品与之互动即可召唤，不要求特定祭品。

***

## 斯库拉

![斯库拉](images/nav-visual-cataclysm-scylla.png)

来自 L_Ender's Cataclysm。身边缠绕海蛇、手持锁链船锚的战士。

在主世界暖水海洋上方寻找 Acropolis。

与尚未激活的斯库拉互动即可开始战斗，不要求特定祭品。

***

## 祈灵师

![祈灵师](images/final-boss-review-invoker.png)

来自 Illager Invasion 的灾厄村民施法首领，在村庄袭击中出现，波次与难度取决于服务器设置。

***

## 野火

![野火](images/encounters-friends-and-foes-forge-wildfire.png)

来自 Friends&Foes，外形类似烈焰人，身边环绕宽大的金色盾牌。进入下界的 Citadel 寻找它。

***

## 末影龙

![末影龙](images/final-boss-review-ender-dragon.png)

Minecraft 的黑色有翼巨龙，位于末地中央岛屿。通过激活的末地传送门前往。

***

## 凋灵

![凋灵](images/final-boss-review-wither.png)

<ItemGrid>
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:soul_sand" />
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:soul_soil" />
<ItemIcon id="minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull" />
</ItemGrid>

Minecraft 的三头浮空骷髅。用四块<ItemLink id="minecraft:soul_sand" />或<ItemLink id="minecraft:soul_soil" />搭成丁字形，再在顶部放置三颗<ItemLink id="minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull" />，最后放上第三颗头颅。

***

## 难度

Dangerous 调整现有敌人的生命值与装备，不增加独立的首领种类。

## Loot containers

![Lootr chest](images/encounters-lootr-catalog.png)

Lootr chest in a mineshaft.

Lootr gives each player a separate inventory in converted loot-table chests, trapped chests, barrels, shulker boxes and minecarts. Gold means you have not opened the container, while blue means you have. A client setting can hide these colors. Ordinary storage without a loot table does not automatically become personal loot.

***

## Drop lookup

| Mod | Coverage | Reading the display |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EMI Loot | Chest tables, block drops and creature drops | Read chance, average stack size and conditions separately. |
| Lootr | Per-player container access | Does not replace the underlying loot table or guarantee a particular item. |

***

## Getting started

Open a Lootr container for your own loot. Use the item browser’s loot displays to check sources and conditions. Refresh and decay depend on server settings. Reopening does not guarantee new loot.

## Related topics

- [Browse recipe](help.search.md)
adventure.loot.zh_cn:
## 战利品容器

![Mineshaft lootr chest!](images/encounters-lootr-catalog.png)

矿井中的 Lootr 箱子。

Lootr 为转换后的战利品表箱子、陷阱箱、木桶、潜影盒与矿车提供每位玩家独立的物品栏。金色代表你尚未开启，蓝色代表你已开启，客户端设置可隐藏这些颜色。没有战利品表的普通储物容器不会自动变成个人战利品。

***

## 掉落查询

| 模组 | 内容 | 读取方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EMI Loot | 箱子战利品表、方块掉落与生物掉落 | 分别查看概率、平均堆叠数量与条件。 |
| Lootr | 每位玩家的容器访问 | 不替换原有战利品表，也不保证必定获得某个物品。 |

***

## 开始探索

开启 Lootr 容器领取属于你的战利品。用物品浏览器的掉落显示查看来源与条件。刷新与衰减取决于服务器设置，重复开启不保证产生新物品。

## 下界的四类食材

![疣猪兽食材与下界厨房](images/visual-nether-kitchen.png)

疣猪兽食材与下界厨房

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:spicy_hoglin_stew_cup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:strider_stew_cup" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:bacon-wrapped_sausage_on_a_stick" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:blue_tenderloin_steak" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:chilidog" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:cooked_loin" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:fried_hoglin_chop" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:hoglin_hide" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:hoglin_loin" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:hoglin_sausage" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:hotdog" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:hotdog_with_mixed_salad" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:hotdog_with_nether_salad" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:minced_strider" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:plate_of_cold_striderloaf" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:plate_of_striderloaf" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:plate_of_stuffed_hoglin" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:plate_of_stuffed_hoglin_ham" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:plate_of_stuffed_hoglin_snout" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:raw_stuffed_hoglin" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:red_loin_on_a_stick" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:roasted_sausage" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:sausage_and_potatoes" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:spicy_hoglin_stew" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:strider_egg" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:strider_rock" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:strider_slice" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:strider_stew" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:strider_with_grilled_fungus" /></ItemGrid>

My Nether's Delight 围绕下界已有的东西展开，也就是肉、菌类与辣椒。这里没有一样依赖主世界农田，因此第一个有用的问题是，你需要的那份食材来自哪种狩猎或采集。

| 料理类型 | 活体来源 | 变成什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 疣猪兽肉 | 用刀猎杀疣猪兽 | 里脊、熟里脊、碎肉、香肠、酿疣猪兽与装盘份 |
| 炽足兽肉 | 用刀猎杀炽足兽 | 碎炽足兽肉、肉片、炽足兽肉糕与炽足兽炖汤 |
| 辣椒 | 子弹辣椒丛与板条箱 | 辣椒粉、酿辣椒与香辣料理线 |
| 恶魂 | 猎杀恶魂 | 恶魂面、恶魂米、恶魂面团与奶油甜点 |
| 蛋与面包 | 鸡蛋与炽足兽蛋 | 水煮、魔鬼、苏格兰与金蛋料理，以及吐司 |

***

## 疣猪兽与炽足兽切分

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cooked_bacon" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:stick" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:warped_fungus" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bowl" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:bullet_pepper" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:nether_wart" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:wheat" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:milk_bottle" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:egg" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:hoglin_trophy" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bread" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:mixed_salad" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:nether_salad" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:ham" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:warped_fungus_colony" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:crimson_fungus_colony" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:crimson_fungus" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:potato" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:carrot" /><ItemIcon id="mynethersdelight:rock_soup" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:warped_roots" /></ItemGrid>

| 起始物品 | 切分结果 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="mynethersdelight:hoglin_loin" /> | 熟里脊与煎疣猪排 | 热狗、香肠与装盘料理 |
| <ItemLink id="mynethersdelight:hoglin_sausage" /> | 烤香肠 | 香肠配土豆、辣味热狗与肉串 |

## Cave carrots

![A kitchen in the caves](images/visual-cavern-kitchen.png)

A kitchen in the caves

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:wild_cave_carrots" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_carrot" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:baked_cave_carrot" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_soup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_hamburger" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:copper_carrot" /></ItemGrid>

Miner's Delight builds its menu on a cave crop. <ItemLink id="minersdelight:wild_cave_carrots" /> grows in cave patches rather than on a surface farm. Break a patch to start your own row, then plant the harvested <ItemLink id="minersdelight:cave_carrot" /> underground.

Bake the carrot for a simple provision, or use it in a soup and a burger. <ItemLink id="minersdelight:copper_carrot" /> is a separate prepared item, not a cooked cave carrot.

| Stage | Item | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wild patch | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:wild_cave_carrots" /></ItemGrid> | Seed source |
| Harvest | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_carrot" /></ItemGrid> | Planting and cooking |
| Baked | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:baked_cave_carrot" /></ItemGrid> | Portable food |
| Combined | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_soup" /></ItemGrid> | Full meal in a bowl |

***

## Underground proteins

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:arthropod" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:spider_leg" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:bat_wing" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:smoked_bat_wing" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:silverfish_eggs" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:bat_rolls" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:insect_stew" /></ItemGrid>

Spiders and cave arthropods supply <ItemLink id="minersdelight:arthropod" /> and <ItemLink id="minersdelight:spider_leg" />. Bats supply <ItemLink id="minersdelight:bat_wing" />, which smokes into a longer lasting provision. <ItemLink id="minersdelight:silverfish_eggs" /> come from infested blocks rather than from a farm.

Handle these as a separate supply chain from crop food. A mining trip that clears a spider nest and a bat cluster returns with meat, and the eggs arrive only when you break infested stone.

| Ingredient | Source | Prepared form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arthropod | Spiders and cave insects | Cooked arthropod and insect stew |
| Spider leg | Spiders | Baked spider leg |
| Bat wing | Bats | Smoked bat wing |
| Silverfish eggs | Infested blocks | Weird caviar and seasoned arthropods |

***

## Copper kitchen

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:copper_pot" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:copper_cup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:beef_stew_cup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:milk_cup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:water_cup" /></ItemGrid>

The <ItemLink id="minersdelight:copper_pot" /> is the station for this menu. <ItemLink id="minersdelight:copper_cup" /> is a serving container, and a cup dish has its own recipe. Fill cups before you go down, because <ItemLink id="minersdelight:water_cup" /> and <ItemLink id="minersdelight:milk_cup" /> are container contents, not cooked meals.

Cups free a hand compared with a bowl and they stack the way a bowl meal does not. Choose the serving form before the trip rather than after the pot is full.

***

## Provision bars

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:crunchy_bar" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:nutritional_bar" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:golden_nutritional_bar" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:gossypium" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:honey_bottle" /></ItemGrid>

Crafted bars are the travel branch. <ItemLink id="minersdelight:crunchy_bar" /> is the basic bar, <ItemLink id="minersdelight:nutritional_bar" /> is the denser version, and <ItemLink id="minersdelight:golden_nutritional_bar" /> is the gold tier. They do not need a bowl and they keep their stack in a packed inventory.

<ItemLink id="minersdelight:gossypium" /> supplies the plant fibre for the bar recipes. Grow it with the cave carrot row so a mining base can restock without returning to the surface.

| Provision | Container | Best use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Baked cave carrot | None | Short trip snack |
| Cave soup | Bowl or cup | Full meal at a camp |
| Crunchy bar | None | Deep mining ration |
| Golden nutritional bar | None | Long expedition reserve |

## 洞穴胡萝卜

![洞穴中的厨房](images/visual-cavern-kitchen.png)

洞穴中的厨房

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:wild_cave_carrots" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_carrot" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:baked_cave_carrot" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_soup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_hamburger" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:copper_carrot" /></ItemGrid>

Miner's Delight 的菜单建立在一种洞穴作物上。<ItemLink id="minersdelight:wild_cave_carrots" /> 生长在洞穴植株丛中，而不是地表农田。破坏一丛就能开始自己的种植行，再把收获的 <ItemLink id="minersdelight:cave_carrot" /> 种在地下。

胡萝卜可直接烘烤成简单口粮，也能用于汤和汉堡。<ItemLink id="minersdelight:copper_carrot" /> 是另一种加工品，不是烤洞穴胡萝卜。

| 阶段 | 物品 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 野生植株 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:wild_cave_carrots" /></ItemGrid> | 种子来源 |
| 收获 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_carrot" /></ItemGrid> | 种植与烹饪 |
| 烘烤 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:baked_cave_carrot" /></ItemGrid> | 便携食物 |
| 组合 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:cave_soup" /></ItemGrid> | 碗装完整料理 |

***

## 地下蛋白

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:arthropod" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:spider_leg" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:bat_wing" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:smoked_bat_wing" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:silverfish_eggs" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:bat_rolls" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:insect_stew" /></ItemGrid>

蜘蛛与洞穴节肢动物提供 <ItemLink id="minersdelight:arthropod" /> 和 <ItemLink id="minersdelight:spider_leg" />。蝙蝠提供 <ItemLink id="minersdelight:bat_wing" />，烟熏后更耐存放。<ItemLink id="minersdelight:silverfish_eggs" /> 来自被虫蚀的方块，而不是农场。

把这些与作物食物分开管理。清理蜘蛛巢和蝙蝠群的一趟矿洞之行会带回肉类，虫卵只有在破坏被虫蚀的石块时才会出现。

| 食材 | 来源 | 加工形态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 节肢动物 | 蜘蛛与洞穴昆虫 | 熟节肢动物与昆虫炖菜 |
| 蜘蛛腿 | 蜘蛛 | 烤蜘蛛腿 |
| 蝙蝠翼 | 蝙蝠 | 烟熏蝙蝠翼 |
| 蠹虫卵 | 被虫蚀的方块 | 怪异鱼子酱与调味节肢动物 |

***

## 铜制厨房

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:copper_pot" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:copper_cup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:beef_stew_cup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:milk_cup" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:water_cup" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="minersdelight:copper_pot" /> 是这套菜单的工作站。<ItemLink id="minersdelight:copper_cup" /> 是盛装容器，杯装料理有自己的配方。下矿前先装满杯子，因为 <ItemLink id="minersdelight:water_cup" /> 与 <ItemLink id="minersdelight:milk_cup" /> 是容器内容物，不是烹饪好的料理。

杯子比碗更省手，堆叠方式也与碗装料理不同。在锅装满之前就决定盛装形式，而不是装完再改。

***

## 补给棒

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:crunchy_bar" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:nutritional_bar" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:golden_nutritional_bar" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:gossypium" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:honey_bottle" /></ItemGrid>

合成补给棒是旅行分支。<ItemLink id="minersdelight:crunchy_bar" /> 是基础棒，<ItemLink id="minersdelight:nutritional_bar" /> 更紧实，<ItemLink id="minersdelight:golden_nutritional_bar" /> 是黄金档。它们不需要碗，在背包里也能保持堆叠。

<ItemLink id="minersdelight:gossypium" /> 提供补给棒配方所需的植物纤维。把它与洞穴胡萝卜一起种植，地下基地就能自行补给而不用返回地表。

| 补给 | 容器 | 适用场合 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 烤洞穴胡萝卜 | 无 | 短途零食 |
| 洞穴汤 | 碗或杯 | 营地的完整料理 |
| 脆棒 | 无 | 深层采矿口粮 |
| 黄金营养棒 | 无 | 长途远征储备 |

***

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:squid" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:baked_squid" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:tentacles" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:takoyaki" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:vegan_patty" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:vegan_hamburger" /><ItemIcon id="minersdelight:plate_of_fake_meatloaf" /></ItemGrid>

## Cataclysm ingredients

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:amethyst_crab_meat" /><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:coral_chunk" /><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:lionfish" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:deepling_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:raw_brute_deepling_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:raw_warlock_deepling_meat" /></ItemGrid>

L_Ender's Cataclysm Delight turns Cataclysm creatures into ingredients. Small and mid tier mobs drop their own meat, and bosses drop parts that only boss dishes use. The mod adds more than fifty foods and seven boss dishes.

Kill a creature with a knife when you want portions instead of a whole cut. <ItemLink id="cataclysm:amethyst_crab_meat" /> becomes slices and sticks. <ItemLink id="cataclysm:coral_chunk" /> and <ItemLink id="cataclysm:lionfish" /> feed the coral and reef branch. Deepling meat comes in three variants, one for each deepling type.

| Ingredient | Source family | First prepared form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:amethyst_crab_meat" /></ItemGrid> | Amethyst crab | Meat slice and meat stick |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:coral_chunk" /></ItemGrid> | Coral golem | Red slice and coral sandwich |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:lionfish" /></ItemGrid> | Lionfish | Slice and grilled lionfish |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:deepling_meat" /></ItemGrid> | Deepling | Cooked deepling meat |

A dish recipe is not proof of a guaranteed drop. Kill the creature once and read the actual drop before you plan a meal around it.

***

## Boss dishes

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:netherite_monstrosity_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:cooked_netherite_monstrosity_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart_stew" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:leviathan" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:ignis" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:watcher_heart" /></ItemGrid>

Boss meat is a separate tier. A boss drops a raw part, the kitchen turns it into a cooked cut, and a few parts become a named dish. <ItemLink id="lendersdelight:netherite_monstrosity_meat" /> cooks into a cut. <ItemLink id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart" /> becomes a heart stew or a glazed heart. <ItemLink id="lendersdelight:leviathan" /> and <ItemLink id="lendersdelight:ignis" /> are plated boss dishes that use the whole encounter ingredient.

Eating these dishes feeds the mod's stat progression. Each new dish adds a small permanent gain, so a varied boss menu is worth more than repeating one recipe.

| Stage | Item | What it needs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Raw part | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:netherite_monstrosity_meat" /></ItemGrid> | A defeated boss |
| Cooked cut | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:cooked_netherite_monstrosity_meat" /></ItemGrid> | Heat and a pan or pot |
| Named dish | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart_stew" /></ItemGrid> | The part plus a full recipe |

***

## Cooking route

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:skillet" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bowl" /></ItemGrid>

Most of this menu runs through the same three stations as the rest of the pack. Cut portions on a <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" />, cook single pieces in a <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:skillet" />, and combine full recipes in a <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" />. Bring a stack of bowls, because soups and stews need one per serving.

Carry the raw part home rather than cooking at the dungeon. Boss ingredients are heavy in recipe cost, and a failed field cook wastes the trip.

***

<ItemLink id="lendersdelight:improved_dog_food" /> feeds tamed wolves and does not count toward your diet. Keep pet food in a separate chest from expedition meals so you do not spend a boss ingredient by mistake.

## 灾变食材

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:amethyst_crab_meat" /><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:coral_chunk" /><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:lionfish" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:deepling_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:raw_brute_deepling_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:raw_warlock_deepling_meat" /></ItemGrid>

L_Ender's Cataclysm Delight 把灾变生物变成食材。小型和中型生物掉落各自的肉，首领掉落只用于首领料理的部位。该模组提供五十多种食物和七道首领料理。

想要小份而不是整块时，用刀击杀生物。<ItemLink id="cataclysm:amethyst_crab_meat" /> 可切成肉片和肉串。<ItemLink id="cataclysm:coral_chunk" /> 与 <ItemLink id="cataclysm:lionfish" /> 供应珊瑚与礁石分支。沉灵肉有三种变体，对应不同沉灵。

| 食材 | 来源族群 | 初次加工产物 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:amethyst_crab_meat" /></ItemGrid> | 紫水晶蟹 | 蟹肉片与蟹肉串 |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:coral_chunk" /></ItemGrid> | 珊瑚傀儡 | 红色切片与珊瑚三明治 |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="cataclysm:lionfish" /></ItemGrid> | 狮子鱼 | 鱼片与烤狮子鱼 |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:deepling_meat" /></ItemGrid> | 沉灵 | 熟沉灵肉 |

有料理配方不等于必定掉落。先击杀一次并查看实际掉落，再围绕这道菜安排行程。

***

## 首领料理

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:netherite_monstrosity_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:cooked_netherite_monstrosity_meat" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart_stew" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:leviathan" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:ignis" /><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:watcher_heart" /></ItemGrid>

首领肉是独立的一档。首领掉落生部位，厨房把它做成熟肉，少数部位还能做成有名有姓的料理。<ItemLink id="lendersdelight:netherite_monstrosity_meat" /> 可烤成肉排。<ItemLink id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart" /> 可做成心汤或蜜汁心。<ItemLink id="lendersdelight:leviathan" /> 与 <ItemLink id="lendersdelight:ignis" /> 是用整份遭遇食材制作的盘装首领料理。

食用这些料理会推进模组的属性成长。每道新料理都带来一点永久提升，因此菜色丰富比反复做同一道更划算。

| 阶段 | 物品 | 所需条件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 生部位 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:netherite_monstrosity_meat" /></ItemGrid> | 击败首领 |
| 熟肉 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:cooked_netherite_monstrosity_meat" /></ItemGrid> | 热源与煎锅或锅 |
| 成品料理 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="lendersdelight:maledictus_heart_stew" /></ItemGrid> | 部位加完整配方 |

***

## 烹饪路线

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:skillet" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bowl" /></ItemGrid>

这套菜单与整合包其他料理共用三个工作站。在 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /> 上切分，用 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:skillet" /> 加工单份，用 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /> 组合完整配方。带上一叠碗，汤和炖菜每份都要用碗盛装。

把生部位带回家再做。首领食材的配方成本很高，在现场临时烹饪失败会浪费整趟行程。

***

<ItemLink id="lendersdelight:improved_dog_food" /> 用于喂养已驯服的狼，不计入你的饮食记录。把宠物食物与远征口粮分箱存放，避免误用首领食材。

## Slicer

![Mechanical preparation beside a heated cooking pot](images/visual-automatic-cooking.png)

Mechanical preparation beside a heated cooking pot

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sliceanddice:slicer" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /></ItemGrid>

The <ItemLink id="sliceanddice:slicer" /> automates cutting board work. It does not turn ingredients into finished meals. A knife sits inside the machine, and each processed item consumes knife durability in this pack, so plan for repairs or a supply of spare knives.

The machine needs rotational power. Give it the ingredient and the correct knife, and it produces the same portions a board would. Feed the output into the next station or a storage crate.

### Slicer craft

<Recipe id="sliceanddice:slicer" />

Place the slicer, add the knife, then connect rotation and ingredient delivery. Check the machine interface for the current tool before you build the line around it.

***

## Sprinkler and basin

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sliceanddice:sprinkler" /><ItemIcon id="sliceanddice:fertilizer_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:water_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="sliceanddice:sprinkler" /> waters and fertilizes a field on rotation. It holds 300 millibuckets, spends 100 per use and reaches five blocks horizontally in this pack. One bucket of water fills it three times. Place it above the crop row and pipe water in, or refill it by hand.

The <ItemLink id="sliceanddice:fertilizer_bucket" /> supplies the fertilizer. Keep it separate from drinking water and from food containers.

Slice and Dice also adds heated basin cooking. A basin with a heated floor cooks Farmer's Delight pot recipes in bulk, which suits a kitchen that runs one meal at a time for a whole base.

| Setting | Value in this pack | Practical result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sprinkler capacity | 300 millibuckets | One water bucket gives three uses |
| Fluid per use | 100 millibuckets | Plan water delivery per harvest |
| Horizontal range | Five blocks | Covers an eleven block wide strip |
| Basin heat | Heated | Needs a heated basin floor |

***

## Central Kitchen

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:redstone" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:skillet" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:stove" /></ItemGrid>

Create: Central Kitchen connects Create logistics to the Farmer's Delight stations. A mechanical arm can load and unload supported <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" />, <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:skillet" />, stove and cutting board. A packager unpacks ingredient boxes straight into a pot. Boiler heaters count as cooking heat, and an active heater speeds a pot or skillet.

Central Kitchen also converts cutting board recipes into Create sawing and deploying recipes. That lets a mechanical saw cut ingredients without a knife inside a machine.

Do not assume every pot recipe has a machine equivalent. Open the target dish in the recipe browser and check its actual processing type before you build the line.

***

## 切片机

![受热烹饪锅旁的机械加工](images/visual-automatic-cooking.png)

受热烹饪锅旁的机械加工

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sliceanddice:slicer" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="sliceanddice:slicer" /> 把砧板加工自动化，但不会把食材直接变成成品料理。机器内需要装入刀具，本包中每加工一份物品都会消耗刀的耐久，因此要准备修理手段或备用刀具。

机器需要旋转动力。放入食材和正确的刀，它会产出与砧板相同的分割物。把产物送入下一台设备或仓储箱。

### 切片机合成

<Recipe id="sliceanddice:slicer" />

放置切片机，装入刀具，再连接旋转动力与食材输入。围绕产线建造前先查看机器界面里当前装入的工具。

***

## 喷灌器与水盆

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="sliceanddice:sprinkler" /><ItemIcon id="sliceanddice:fertilizer_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:water_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="sliceanddice:sprinkler" /> 借助旋转为农田浇水施肥。本包中容量为三百毫桶，每次使用消耗一百毫桶，水平范围五格。一桶水可装三次。把它放在作物行上方并接入水源，也可以手动补充。

<ItemLink id="sliceanddice:fertilizer_bucket" /> 提供肥料。它与饮用水、食物容器分开存放。

Slice and Dice 还加入受热水盆烹饪。底部受热的水盆可批量完成农夫乐事的锅类配方，适合为整个基地一次做大量料理。

| 设置 | 本包取值 | 实际影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 喷灌器容量 | 三百毫桶 | 一桶水可用三次 |
| 每次消耗 | 一百毫桶 | 按收获周期安排供水 |
| 水平范围 | 五格 | 覆盖十一格宽的条带 |
| 水盆热量 | 受热 | 需要受热的水盆底部 |

***

## 中央厨房

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:redstone" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:skillet" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:stove" /></ItemGrid>

Create: Central Kitchen 把机械动力物流接到农夫乐事的设备上。机械手可以为受支持的 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" />、<ItemLink id="farmersdelight:skillet" />、炉灶和砧板装卸物品。打包机能把食材箱直接拆入锅中。锅炉加热器可作为烹饪热源，工作中的加热器还能加快锅与煎锅。

中央厨房还会把砧板配方转换为机械动力的锯切与 部署配方，让机械锯无需刀具也能切割食材。

不要假设每个锅类配方都有机器版本。搭建产线前在配方浏览器里打开目标料理，确认它实际的加工类型。

## Wild crops and seeds

![A garden of cooking ingredients](images/visual-garden-crops.png)

A garden of cooking ingredients

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_cabbages" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_tomatoes" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_onions" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_rice" /></ItemGrid>

Farmer's Delight crops grow wild in matching climates. Break a wild patch by hand for a seed or a plantable item, and occasionally for produce. Shear the patch instead to pick it up and replant it as decoration or as a seed bank. Bone meal on a wild patch multiplies it in place, which turns one find into a full row.

| Wild patch | Where it grows | What you get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_cabbages" /></ItemGrid> | Beaches and coasts | Cabbage seeds |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_tomatoes" /></ItemGrid> | Arid climates | Tomato seeds |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_onions" /></ItemGrid> | Temperate climates | Onion |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_rice" /></ItemGrid> | Swamps and jungles | Rice |

Village farm plots and chests also carry samples of these crops, so a village trip fills a garden without a long search.

***

## Planting and harvest

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cabbage_seeds" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cabbage" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:tomato_seeds" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:tomato" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:onion" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rice_panicle" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rice" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:straw" /></ItemGrid>

Plant <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cabbage_seeds" /> and <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:tomato_seeds" /> on farmland like any other crop. <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:onion" /> is planted directly as the bulb.

Tomatoes climb. Place a <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rope" /> above a planted tomato and the vine grows up it. Breaking a ripe vine leaves the rope behind in this pack, so you can reuse the support for the next planting.

Rice is planted in shallow water. Harvest a ripe <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rice_panicle" /> and choose the processing route. Craft the panicle for one <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rice" />. Cut it on a <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /> with a knife for one rice and one <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:straw" />. The board route gives the same rice plus straw for rope, canvas and crafting.

***

## Rich soil

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:organic_compost" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rich_soil" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:brown_mushroom" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:podzol" /></ItemGrid>

Craft <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:organic_compost" />, place it, and wait. Sunlight and water nearby speed the decomposition. Neighbouring compost, rich soil, mycelium, podzol and mushrooms act as activators and speed it further. The pile becomes <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rich_soil" />.

Rich soil boosts crop growth like a free bone meal, with a twenty percent chance per growth tick in this pack. Hoe it into rich farmland to keep the boost on tilled crops. Rich farmland also resists trampling and does not turn back into dirt when a pumpkin or melon grows on it.

A mushroom planted on rich soil in darkness grows into a colony of two to five caps. Break the colony for every cap, or shear it to move the whole colony.

***

## Harvest helpers

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bone_meal" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rich_soil" /></ItemGrid>

RightClickHarvest lets you harvest and replant a mature crop with a right click. The pack configures the mod to work without a hoe, so an empty hand is enough. Smarter Farmers makes villagers replant the seed that belongs to the crop, including modded crops. Universal Bone Meal lets bone meal grow plants that vanilla refuses, such as sugar cane and cactus.

These helpers change how you work a field, not what a crop yields. Check the crop before you build an automatic farm around it, because a modded plant may need its own support.

| Helper | What it changes | What stays the same |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RightClickHarvest | Harvest and replant in one click | Crop drops |
| Smarter Farmers | Villager replanting for modded crops | Villager trades |
| Universal Bone Meal | Bone meal works on more plants | Growth speed of supported crops |
| Create: Integrated Farming | Vacuum harvester harvests and replants an area | Crop drops |

***

## 野生作物与种子

![厨房食材菜园](images/visual-garden-crops.png)

厨房食材菜园

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_cabbages" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_tomatoes" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_onions" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_rice" /></ItemGrid>

农夫乐事的作物会生长在气候相符的野外。徒手破坏野生植株会得到种子或可种植的物品，偶尔还会得到作物本身。用剪刀采集则可整株取回，重新种下作为装饰或种子来源。对野生植株使用骨粉会让它在原地增殖，一次发现就能变成一整排。

| 野生植株 | 生长地点 | 获得物 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_cabbages" /></ItemGrid> | 海滩与海岸 | 卷心菜种子 |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_tomatoes" /></ItemGrid> | 干旱气候 | 番茄种子 |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_onions" /></ItemGrid> | 温带气候 | 洋葱 |
| <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:wild_rice" /></ItemGrid> | 沼泽与丛林 | 稻米 |

村庄农田和箱子中也会出现这些作物的样本，跑一趟村庄就能凑齐菜园，不必长途寻找。

***

## 种植与收获

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cabbage_seeds" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cabbage" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:tomato_seeds" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:tomato" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:onion" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rice_panicle" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rice" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:straw" /></ItemGrid>

把 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cabbage_seeds" /> 与 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:tomato_seeds" /> 像普通作物一样种在耕地上。<ItemLink id="farmersdelight:onion" /> 直接用鳞茎种植。

番茄会攀爬。在种下的番茄上方放一根 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rope" />，藤蔓会顺着绳子生长。本包中破坏成熟的藤蔓会留下绳子，下一次种植仍可使用同一支撑。

稻米种在浅水中。收获成熟的 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rice_panicle" /> 后选择加工方式。直接合成得到一份 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rice" />。用刀在 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /> 上切割，则得到一份稻米和一份 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:straw" />。砧板路线稻米数量相同，还多出可用于绳子、帆布和合成的稻草。

***

## 肥沃土壤

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:organic_compost" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rich_soil" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:brown_mushroom" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:podzol" /></ItemGrid>

合成 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:organic_compost" />，放置后等待。阳光和附近的水会加快分解。相邻的堆肥、肥沃土壤、菌丝、灰化土和蘑菇都是促进方块，能让它更快转化。堆肥最终变成 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:rich_soil" />。

肥沃土壤会像免费的骨粉一样促进作物生长，本包中每次生长判定有百分之二十的概率触发。用锄头把它变成 肥沃耕地，耕地也能保留这份加成。肥沃耕地还能抵抗踩踏，南瓜或西瓜长在上面也不会变回泥土。

在黑暗处种在肥沃土壤上的蘑菇会长成两到五个菌盖的菌落。徒手破坏可收走全部菌盖，用剪刀则能整株取回。

***

## 收获辅助

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bone_meal" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:rich_soil" /></ItemGrid>

RightClickHarvest 让你右键一次就完成收获与补种。本包配置为无需锄头，空手即可操作。Smarter Farmers 让村民补种与作物匹配的种子，模组作物也包含在内。Universal Bone Meal 让骨粉能催熟原版拒绝的植物，例如甘蔗和仙人掌。

这些辅助改变的是田间操作方式，不改变作物产量。围绕某种作物搭建自动农场前先确认它的收获方式，模组植物可能需要额外支持。

| 辅助模组 | 改变的内容 | 不变的内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RightClickHarvest | 一次点击完成收获与补种 | 作物掉落 |
| Smarter Farmers | 村民为模组作物补种 | 村民交易 |
| Universal Bone Meal | 骨粉可用于更多植物 | 受支持作物的生长速度 |
| Create: Integrated Farming | 真空收割机在区域内收获并补种 | 作物掉落 |

***

## Rod and tackle

<EmiSearch query="@starcatcher" />

![Reeling in a Starcatcher catch](images/visual-fishing-reeling.png)

Reeling in a Starcatcher catch

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:hook" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:bobber" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:tackle_box_cyan" /></ItemGrid>

Starcatcher replaces the vanilla fishing result with its own catch table, a reeling minigame and a catalogue. The mod's rod is the tool that reaches that table. A vanilla fishing rod still pulls vanilla loot from the same water.

| Item | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" /> | Casts at Starcatcher entries and starts the minigame. |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" /> | Opens the catch catalogue, each species condition and the minigame settings. |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:hook" /> | Rod attachment. Changes how a catch behaves during the fight. |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:bobber" /> | Rod attachment. Changes lure timing and which entries can appear. |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:tackle_box_cyan" /> | Stores fish and tackle and swaps attachments without a crafting table. |

***

## Craft the rod and the guide

![Tackle Boxes and fishing attachments](images/visual-fishing-tackle.png)

Tackle Boxes and fishing attachments

<Recipe id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" />

<Recipe id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" />

1. Craft <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" /> and fit one hook and one bobber before the first cast.
2. Carry <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" />. It is the only place that lists every condition for a species.
3. Cast into water, wait for the bite, then reel. The minigame opens with the fish on the line.
4. Hit the highlighted zones with <KeyBind id="key.starcatcher.minigame_hit" /> until the catch meter fills.

A catch is confirmed when the fish item or its bucket form lands in the inventory and the guide adds the entry. If the line returns empty, the water qualified but the fish did not, so re-read its row in the guide rather than moving biome at random.

***

## Attachments change the fight

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:worm" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:cherry_bait" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:amethyst_hook" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:vanilla_hook" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:vanilla_bobber" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| Attachment | Effect on the catch |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:worm" /> | Common bait. Shortens the wait and widens the entry pool. |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:cherry_bait" /> | Favours cherry landscape entries over the general pool. |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:amethyst_hook" /> | Required for lava fishing without a netherite upgrade. |
| Vanilla-flavoured hook with vanilla-flavoured bobber | Skips the minigame, so the catch resolves as a plain pull. |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:bucket" /> | Used as an offered item for species whose entry lists a bucket catch. |

A preferred bait raises the chance of a species appearing. A required bait is a hard condition, so the cast fails that species without it. The guide labels the difference on each entry.

***

## What decides the catch

| Condition | Check before you cast |
| --- | --- |
| Biome | The exact habitat the entry names, not the nearest similar one. |
| Fluid | Water and lava are separate tables. Lava needs the amethyst hook or the netherite rod. |
| Dimension | Nether and End entries only resolve in those dimensions. |
| Elevation and light | Surface, cave and mountain entries differ inside one biome. |
| Time and weather | Day, night, rain and thunder remain restrictions after the biome matches. |

![Species entries and catch requirements](images/visual-fishing-guide.png)

Species entries and catch requirements

The Guide is the arbiter for all five rows. Habitat pages narrow the search. They never override a species condition.

***

## Hybrid Aquatic entries

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:fish_radar" /></ItemGrid>

<EmiSearch query="@hybrid_aquatic" />

The compatibility addon registers Hybrid Aquatic fish as Starcatcher entries with their own conditions and difficulty. They are catalogued, displayed and counted like native entries. A Hybrid Aquatic animal swimming beside the bobber is not evidence that the rod can catch it there, because creature spawning and rod entries are separate systems.

***

## Keep and show the catch

![Living catches in aquariums](images/visual-fishing-aquariums.png)

Living catches in aquariums

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:oak_tackle_box_boat" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:aquarium" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:oak_fish_plaque" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:tournament_stand" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:fish_radar" /></ItemGrid>

A Tackle Box Boat carries tackle while you travel by water. An Aquarium holds live bucketed catches and scales the model by the fish's recorded size. A Fish Plaque mounts one catch. A Tournament Stand runs a timed contest between players. <ItemLink id="starcatcher:fish_radar" /> reads nearby fishing possibilities and is worth crafting only after the first entries are in the guide.

***

## 鱼竿与钓具

<EmiSearch query="@starcatcher" />

![收竿中的 Starcatcher 渔获](images/visual-fishing-reeling.png)

收竿中的 Starcatcher 渔获

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:hook" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:bobber" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:tackle_box_cyan" /></ItemGrid>

Starcatcher 用自带的渔获表、收竿小游戏和图鉴取代原版钓鱼结果。只有本模组的鱼竿能进入这张表。原版钓鱼竿在同一片水域仍然只钓出原版战利品。

| 物品 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" /> | 抛向 Starcatcher 渔获条目，并开启小游戏。 |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" /> | 打开渔获图鉴、每种鱼的条件与小游戏设置。 |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:hook" /> | 鱼竿配件，改变鱼在收竿过程中的行为。 |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:bobber" /> | 鱼竿配件，改变咬钩时间与可能出现的条目。 |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:tackle_box_cyan" /> | 收纳鱼与钓具，不必工作台就能更换配件。 |

## 制作鱼竿与图鉴

![钓具箱与鱼竿配件](images/visual-fishing-tackle.png)

钓具箱与鱼竿配件

<Recipe id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" />

<Recipe id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" />

1. 制作 <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_rod" />，第一次抛竿前装好一个鱼钩与一个浮标。
2. 随身带 <ItemLink id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" />。鱼种的完整条件只写在这里。
3. 抛入水中，等鱼咬钩后收竿，鱼上钩时小游戏随之开始。
4. 用 <KeyBind id="key.starcatcher.minigame_hit" /> 击中高亮判定区，直到收竿进度填满。

鱼或它的装桶形态进入背包，并且图鉴新增条目，才算这次渔获成立。空竿说明水域符合条件而鱼没有选中，此时应回看图鉴中该鱼种的条件，而不是随意换生物群系。

## 配件改变收竿方式

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:worm" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:cherry_bait" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:amethyst_hook" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:vanilla_hook" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:vanilla_bobber" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| 配件 | 对渔获的影响 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:worm" /> | 常见鱼饵，缩短等待并扩大可出现的条目范围。 |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:cherry_bait" /> | 让樱花地形条目比通用池更容易出现。 |
| <ItemLink id="starcatcher:amethyst_hook" /> | 未做下界合金升级时，熔岩钓鱼必需此配件。 |
| 原版风味鱼钩配原版风味浮标 | 跳过小游戏，渔获按普通收竿结算。 |

偏好的鱼饵提高鱼种出现的概率。必需的鱼饵是硬性条件，缺少它这次抛竿就不会出现该鱼种。图鉴在每种鱼的条目上标出两者的区别。

## 决定渔获的条件

| 条件 | 抛竿前要确认的内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 生物群系 | 条目写明的具体栖息地，而不是附近相似的群系。 |
| 流体 | 水与熔岩分属两张表。熔岩需要紫水晶鱼钩或下界合金鱼竿。 |
| 维度 | 下界与末地条目只在对应维度成立。 |
| 高度与光照 | 同一生物群系内，地表、洞穴与高山条目不同。 |
| 时间与天气 | 群系匹配之后，白天、夜晚、雨天与雷暴仍然是限制。 |

![鱼种条目与垂钓条件](images/visual-fishing-guide.png)

鱼种条目与垂钓条件

这五项都以图鉴为准。栖息地页面只缩小寻找范围，不能覆盖鱼种自身的条件。

## Runes & pouches

Items are grouped by role or matching attributes. Hover an item for its name, values and slot requirements.

Rune crafting workstation

<ItemGrid>

</ItemGrid>

Equipped rune storage

Casting resource

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:fire_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:frost_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:healing_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:lightning_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:soul_stone" />
</ItemGrid>

Runes are ammunition, not a way to learn spells. Read the selected spell's cost before crafting a supply. Only spells with a rune cost consume them. A pouch saves carrying space but does not create runes or remove their cost.

1. Start with the rune named by your spell. For a Fire starter, combine a suitable stone base with coal using the shapeless recipe. This makes 2 Fire Runes. Use the recipe browser for other schools and alternative ingredients.
2. When you have a Rune Crafting Altar, open it and put the stone base and matching reagent into its two ingredient slots. Take the rune output. The same coal recipe makes 8 Fire Runes here, so the altar improves supply without being required for the first cast.
3. Make a Rune Pouch using the recipe below. In the inventory, hold the pouch on the cursor and right-click a rune stack to load it. Inspect the pouch contents, then place it in the supported quiver accessory slot. Casting can draw the required rune from an equipped pouch.
4. Test one affordable spell with a valid target before leaving base. If the game reports a missing rune, check the exact rune type and quantity, the pouch contents and whether the pouch is equipped. Loose runes in your inventory are also a starting option.

Lightning and Soul Runes are catalog entries, not supplies you must collect for every caster. Follow the cost of the spell you actually use. Rune-pouch recipes require Bundle API, which this selection includes.

## 符文与符文袋

这些物品栏用于识别可选物品，并非必须配齐的套装或合成配方。同组物品仅共享所列用途或属性组合，具体数值、效果与槽位要求请查看各自提示。

符文合成工作站

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:crafting_altar" />
</ItemGrid>

装备式符文储存

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:small_rune_pouch" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:medium_rune_pouch" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:large_rune_pouch" />
</ItemGrid>

施法材料

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:fire_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:frost_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:healing_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:lightning_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:soul_stone" />
</ItemGrid>

符文是施法弹药，不会让你学会法术。先看所选法术的消耗，再制作对应符文。只有标有符文消耗的法术才会消耗符文。符文袋节省携带空间，不会生成符文，也不会免除消耗。

1. 从法术要求的符文入手。火系入门可把合适的石质基材与煤进行无序合成，得到 2 个火焰符文。其他学派与替代材料请查配方浏览器。
2. 有符文祭坛后，打开界面，把石质基材与对应材料放入两个原料槽，再取出符文。同样的煤配方在祭坛产出 8 个火焰符文。祭坛能提高补给效率，但第一次施法不需要先造祭坛。
3. 按下方配方制作符文袋。在背包中用光标拿起符文袋，右键符文堆叠以装入。查看袋内物品，再把符文袋放入支持的箭袋饰品槽。施法时可直接消耗已装备袋中的对应符文。
4. 出发前，找有效目标试放一次消耗较少的法术。若提示缺少符文，依次检查符文种类、数量、袋内物品与装备槽位。入门时也可直接把散装符文放在背包中。

闪电符文与灵魂符文属于物品目录，并非每个施法者都要收集的材料。以实际使用法术的消耗为准。符文袋配方需要 Bundle API，当前选择已包含此依赖。

## Rolls & spells

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="wizards:staff_arcane" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

Roll with <KeyBind id="keybinds.combat_roll.roll" />. Combat Roll supplies the dodge action and rolls in whatever direction you are moving. The roll has a short cooldown that the HUD shows, and it adds exhaustion, so repeated rolls shorten the time before you need food. A roll is unavailable while you use an item, jump or swim.

Invulnerability during a roll is off by default in this selection, so treat a roll as repositioning rather than a guaranteed dodge. Critical Strike supplies melee critical attributes, and neither a weapon animation nor a roll promises invulnerability.

Spell actions use the Spell Engine hotbar. Assign its controls in Key Binds if an action is unbound. The recipe browser uses separate settings, so a shared key can need attention in both interfaces.

combat.handling.zh_cn:
## 攻击与武器类型

![使用职业装备进行近战](images/visual-melee-combat.png)

## 一览武器系列

| 系列 | 示例 | 差异 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 剑或斧 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_axe" /><ItemIcon id="rogues:iron_dagger" /></ItemGrid> | 单手快速攻击，距离较短。 |
| 巨剑或巨锤 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:iron_claymore" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:iron_great_hammer" /></ItemGrid> | 挥动更慢，需要双手持握。 |
| 弓 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bow" /><ItemIcon id="archers:composite_longbow" /></ItemGrid> | 拉弓后释放，拉满时伤害更高。 |
| 弩 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:crossbow" /></ItemGrid> | 先装填，再在合适的时机发射。 |
| 法杖或魔杖 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="wizards:staff_arcane" /><ItemIcon id="wizards:wand_arcane" /></ItemGrid> | 施放武器法术，而不是挥击。 |

***

Better Combat 为支持的武器提供攻击模式与动画。比较攻击距离、攻速、伤害及双手要求，弓弩还各有蓄力或装填方式。

用 <KeyBind id="key.attack" /> 攻击，用 <KeyBind id="key.use" /> 使用物品。

***

## 翻滚与施法

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="wizards:staff_arcane" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

按 <KeyBind id="keybinds.combat_roll.roll" /> 翻滚。Combat Roll 提供闪避动作，并按当前移动方向翻滚。翻滚有短暂冷却，界面会显示剩余时间，同时消耗饥饿度，连续翻滚会更快需要进食。使用物品、跳跃或游泳时无法翻滚。

本整合默认关闭翻滚期间的无敌帧，因此请把翻滚当作重新走位，而不是必定躲开攻击。Critical Strike 提供近战暴击属性，武器动画或翻滚本身都不保证无敌。

法术招式使用 Spell Engine 快捷栏。若招式没有绑定按键，可在按键设置中分配。配方浏览器使用独立设置，按键重复时可能需要同时检查两处界面。

- [法术与招式](combat.abilities.md) 查看职业书绑定与法术快捷栏要求。
- [完整操作](help.controls.md)
- [技能成长](combat.skills.md) 在相连分支中分配职业与武器技能点。

## Equipment roles

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_chestplate" /><ItemIcon id="jewelry:copper_ring" /></ItemGrid>

Weapons and focuses determine attack patterns and spell access. Armor supplies protection and build attributes. Accessories add attributes or item-specific effects in their accepted slots.

| Equipment | Compare |
| --- | --- |
| Weapon or focus | Attack pattern, damage, speed, reach and compatible abilities. |
| Armor | Protection, matching spell-school bonuses and set requirements. |
| Accessories | Attribute, accepted slot, trigger condition and cooldown. |

A Fire-power bonus does not strengthen a Frost spell. Compare melee damage for melee techniques, ranged damage for archery and the matching spell-power school for magic or healing. Read haste and critical modifiers too.

- [Weapons & armor](equipment.weapons-armor.md) Class equipment, named sets, Arsenal and Cataclysm.
- [Accessories](equipment.accessories.md) Starter ring recipes, jewelry and relic catalogs.
- [Armor & status](equipment.display.md) Equipment attributes and temporary effects.

***

## First equipment

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="jewelry:copper_ring" /><ItemIcon id="wizards:wand_novice" /></ItemGrid>

Choose a class weapon or focus before spending rare materials on armor. A craftable copper or iron ring can add early protection, but does not unlock class spells. A triggered equipment bonus is not another freely castable class spell.

- [Combat](reference.skills.md) Class choices and starter recipes in each class article.
- [Spells & abilities](combat.abilities.md) Prepare the book and meet casting requirements.

## 装备作用

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_chestplate" /><ItemIcon id="jewelry:copper_ring" /></ItemGrid>

武器与法器决定攻击模式及可用法术。护甲提供防护与构筑属性。饰品在适用槽位中增加属性或物品专属效果。

| 装备 | 比较内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 武器或法器 | 攻击模式、伤害、攻速、距离与兼容招式。 |
| 护甲 | 防护、对应学派加成与套装要求。 |
| 饰品 | 属性、适用槽位、触发条件与冷却。 |

火焰强度不会增强冰霜法术。近战招式比较近战伤害，弓术比较远程伤害，魔法与治疗比较对应学派的法术强度，同时查看急速与暴击属性。

## First steps

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_binding" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_binding" />

<Recipe id="spell_engine:spell_binding_table" />

1. Open a class article and craft its starter weapon or focus. Weapon-provided abilities are separate from class-book abilities.
2. Create and bind the matching class book at a Spell Binding Table, then equip it in its spell-book slot with compatible held equipment. Check the displayed experience, lapis, bookshelf and casting-resource requirements.
