## Mechanical Trowel

![The Mechanical Trowel palette manager](images/visual-trowel-palette.png)

The Mechanical Trowel palette manager

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:wand_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" />
</ItemGrid>

The <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" /> is a functional building tool, not another decorative block. Quick mode randomly places blocks from your hotbar. Named palettes let you control a repeated material mix, and gradient mode transitions between palette sections. Placement consumes available building materials.

### Acquisition

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" />

Craft one trowel with one <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_ingot" />, one <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_block" /> and one <ItemLink id="minecraft:stick" /> arranged along the diagonal shown in the recipe.

### Palette controls

| Action | Your key |
| --- | --- |
| Palette manager | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.open_palette" /> |
| Building mode | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.toggle_build_mode" /> |
| Radial menu | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.open_radial_menu" /> |
| Replacement mode | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.toggle_replace" /> |

Prepare a hotbar mix for quick placement, or open the palette manager to create and select a named palette. Preview the target before using a bulk operation. Replacement changes existing blocks, so test it on a small disposable section first.

***

## Trowel upgrades

| Upgrade item | Function |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_template" /> | Unlocks wand mode, which extends blocks using the current palette. |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" /> | Raises the wand operation's block limit. |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" /> | Converts available base blocks to supported Chipped or Rechiseled variants. Chipped is installed here. |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" /> | Extends placement reach. |

Upgrade recipes are controlled by server settings. The shipped default requires the wand upgrade for wand mode. Applied Energistics 2 and Refined Storage integration templates require their corresponding storage mods.

### Wand template

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:wand_template" />

Use the smithing table with an ender pearl in the template slot, your trowel as the base and <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_template" /> as the addition. The recipe returns the upgraded trowel.

### Other upgrades

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" />

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" />

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" />

These upgrades use the same smithing slot arrangement with their matching upgrade item. Check the recipe browser for whether a server enables each recipe.

***

## Assembly order

![Cloud Skipper airship build](images/visual-assembled-airship.png)

Cloud Skipper airship build

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:honey_glue" /><ItemIcon id="create:super_glue" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:contraption_diagram" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:navigation_table" /></ItemGrid>

A Simulated Contraption is a group of blocks that this pack turns into one physical body. Build the shape first, then glue it, then assemble it.

1. Build the hull, deck and mount points in place, with the wheels, bearings and propulsion already fitted.
2. Mark the body with <ItemLink id="create:super_glue" /> or <ItemLink id="simulated:honey_glue" />. Glue selects faces, so glue the hull to the deck and the deck to the machinery.
3. Place the <ItemLink id="simulated:physics_assembler" /> against the build, hold use on it, and pull the lever.

Blocks along diagonal edges are included, so a stair-stepped hull does not need a glued strip on every step. The assembler used for the first assembly is not needed afterwards, and any assembler can take the body apart again.

| Message | What it means | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cannot disassemble onto the same Simulated Contraption! | The assembler is part of the body it is trying to release | Move the assembler off the body |
| Too fast to disassemble! | The body is still moving | Stop it, then retry |
| Too far from the ground to disassemble! | The body is too high to set the blocks back down | Lower it or assemble over solid ground |
| Could not align Simulated Contraption to disassemble! | The stored layout no longer fits the space | Clear the landing area |

<Recipe id="simulated:physics_assembler" />

<Recipe id="offroad:borehead_bearing" />
## Moving a body before it flies

A new body starts as one block. Assemble it once, then build the rest onto the assembled block, so every part joins the same physics object from the first piece instead of being glued together later.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:iron_handle" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:honey_glue" /></ItemGrid>

Small bodies can be punched around, but mass rises with size, so fit an <ItemLink id="simulated:iron_handle" /> and sneak use it to drag the body where you want it. Drag first, then finish the hull, because a half-built body is lighter than a finished one.

Diagonal steps stay attached, so a stair-shaped hull does not need a glued strip on every step. A part with no connection in any direction breaks off as its own separate body, which is how a glued joint failing in flight looks on the ground.

## Connections and splitting

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:docking_connector" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:paired_docking_connector" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:rope_winch" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:rope_connector" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:rope_coupling" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:merging_glue" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:swivel_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:spring" /></ItemGrid>

Two bodies stay separate unless you join them. A Slime Ball merges any two Simulated Contraptions, and <ItemLink id="simulated:merging_glue" /> glues across a gap between two bodies. Disconnected sections of one body split off on their own, which is what happens when a glued joint is broken in flight.

Docking connectors join a moving body to a fixed one. Rope parts tow and tether, and the swivel bearing and spring absorb the movement between two bodies instead of passing it through the frame.

| Part | Holds what to what | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:docking_connector" /> | Moving body to a fixed dock | Mooring an airship or loading a barge |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:rope_winch" /> and <ItemLink id="simulated:rope_connector" /> | Two points along a rope | Towing and securing a load |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:swivel_bearing" /> | Two bodies that must rotate | A trailed car or a swinging mount |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:spring" /> | Two bodies that must move apart and back | Suspension and shock absorption |

## Wheels

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="offroad:wheel_mount" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:small_tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:large_tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:monstrous_tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:borehead_bearing" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="offroad:wheel_mount" /> takes one tire on its front face. The pack refuses a tire placed anywhere else, so aim at the mount face that points away from the chassis. Mounts carry the body, they do not drive it, so a rolling chassis still needs a propeller, thruster or engine and a steering input.

<ItemLink id="offroad:borehead_bearing" /> spins a cutting head for excavation. It is a work attachment, not a wheel.
vehicles.assembly.zh_cn:
## 组装顺序

![Cloud Skipper 飞艇成品](images/visual-assembled-airship.png)

Cloud Skipper 飞艇成品

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:honey_glue" /><ItemIcon id="create:super_glue" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:contraption_diagram" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:navigation_table" /></ItemGrid>

模拟悬浮体是把一组方块变成单一物理实体。先造形状，再涂胶，最后组装。

1. 先在原地造好船体、甲板和挂点，轮子、轴承与动力装置也要提前装好。
2. 用 <ItemLink id="create:super_glue" /> 或 <ItemLink id="simulated:honey_glue" /> 标记整体。胶水按面连接，所以船体要粘到甲板，甲板要粘到机械。
3. 把 <ItemLink id="simulated:physics_assembler" /> 贴在结构上，对着它长按使用，然后拉下扳手。

斜边上的方块会被一并纳入，阶梯状船体不需要每一级都补一条胶。首次组装用过的组装器之后不再需要，任意一台组装器都能把实体重新拆开。

| 提示 | 含义 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cannot disassemble onto the same Simulated Contraption! | 组装器本身属于要拆开的实体 | 把组装器移出实体 |
| Too fast to disassemble! | 实体还在移动 | 先停稳再试 |
| Too far from the ground to disassemble! | 实体太高，方块放不回地面 | 降低高度或在实地上方组装 |
| Could not align Simulated Contraption to disassemble! | 保存的布局已经放不回原空间 | 清空落点区域 |

<Recipe id="simulated:physics_assembler" />

<Recipe id="offroad:borehead_bearing" />
## 飞行之前先移动实体

新实体从一块方块开始。先组装这一块，再把其余部分直接建造在已组装的方块上，这样从第一块起所有部件就属于同一个物理实体，不必事后补胶。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:iron_handle" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:honey_glue" /></ItemGrid>

小实体可以用手打走，但体积越大质量越高，所以装上 <ItemLink id="simulated:iron_handle" />，潜行使用即可拖曳到想要的位置。先拖到位再补完船体，因为半成品比成品轻。

阶梯状的斜面会自动连在一起，不需要每一级都补一条胶。任何方向都连不上的部件会脱离成独立实体，飞行中粘合处断裂在地面上看到的就是这个样子。

## 连接与分离

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:docking_connector" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:paired_docking_connector" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:rope_winch" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:rope_connector" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:rope_coupling" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:merging_glue" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:swivel_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:spring" /></ItemGrid>

两个实体默认各自独立。黏液球能把任意两个模拟悬浮体合并，<ItemLink id="simulated:merging_glue" /> 则跨过两个实体之间的空隙涂胶。同一实体的断开部分会自行分离，飞行中粘合处被破坏时就是这样。

对接连接器把移动实体接到固定结构上。绳索部件用来拖曳和系留，万向轴承与弹簧则吸收两个实体之间的相对运动，不让这股力直接传进骨架。

| 部件 | 连接对象 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:docking_connector" /> | 移动实体与固定码头 | 飞艇系泊、驳船装卸 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:rope_winch" /> 与 <ItemLink id="simulated:rope_connector" /> | 绳索两端的固定点 | 拖曳与固定货物 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:swivel_bearing" /> | 需要相对转动的两个实体 | 拖挂车厢、摆动挂架 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:spring" /> | 需要拉开又回位的两个实体 | 悬挂与减震 |

## 轮子

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="offroad:wheel_mount" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:small_tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:large_tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:monstrous_tire" /><ItemIcon id="offroad:borehead_bearing" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="offroad:wheel_mount" /> 只接受装在前面的一个轮胎。装在别的面上会被拒绝，所以要对准背向底盘的那一面。轮架只承重，不提供动力，会滚的底盘仍然需要螺旋桨、推进器或发动机，以及转向输入。

<ItemLink id="offroad:borehead_bearing" /> 带动挖掘刀头，属于作业附件，不是轮子。

vehicles.airships.en_us:
## Lift from a sealed volume

![Airships with different hulls and lift arrangements](images/visual-airship-designs.png)

Airships with different hulls and lift arrangements

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:white_envelope" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:adjustable_burner" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:steam_vent" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:levitite" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:levitite_blend" /><ItemIcon id="ballastmod:ballast_stones" /><ItemIcon id="aeroencasedpipe:white_envelope_encased_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:white_envelope_encased_shaft" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:white_symmetric_sail" /></ItemGrid>

An <ItemLink id="aeronautics:white_envelope" /> does not lift by itself. Envelope blocks form the skin, and the enclosed air blocks fill with hot air. The pack gives hot air 1.5 kilograms of lift per cubic metre, so a balloon's lift is its trapped volume, not its block count.

Three rules decide whether a balloon works.

1. The skin must be airtight. Envelope blocks, envelope encased shafts and the encased fluid pipes all count.
2. Air fills from the top down. A hole in the third layer of a five layer balloon leaves only the top two layers filled.
3. Anything built inside the balloon reduces the trapped volume. Keep masts, pipes and walkways outside the skin.

Dye an envelope by using dye on it. Using the same colour again spreads the dye to the neighbouring envelopes, which is the quick way to paint a whole balloon.

<Recipe id="aeronautics:adjustable_burner" />
## Burner and vent

<Recipe id="aeronautics:white_envelope" />

A <ItemLink id="aeronautics:adjustable_burner" /> sits under the balloon and fills it with hot air when it has a redstone signal. Its input panel sets the maximum output, capped at 500 in this pack, and the redstone strength scales that output down proportionally. Several burners combine into one balloon, which is how large hulls get a usable climb rate.

The burner searches up to 80 blocks for its balloon, so a burner in the gondola can feed an envelope above the deck. A <ItemLink id="aeronautics:steam_vent" /> is the steam alternative, with a cap of 5000, and it does not need a fire.

Lift falls as air pressure falls. The balloon does not keep climbing at the same rate, and the <ItemLink id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /> is the instrument that reads both air pressure and exact height.

## Levitite

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:andesite_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:smart_propeller" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="aeronautics:levitite" /> is the third lift source. It provides a fixed anti-gravity force and a drag that is strong at low speed and weak at high speed. Levitite alone can hold a body up but cannot make it climb, so it is used to carry a heavy hull that a propeller then moves. Curing <ItemLink id="aeronautics:levitite_blend" /> with fire, a blaze burner or a campfire turns the fluid into Levitite, and the cured block cannot be collected again. Clay used as a mould is destroyed during curing.

| Lift source | Gives | Limit in this pack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hot air envelope | Lift from trapped volume | 1.5 kilograms per cubic metre, burner output 500 |
| Steam vent | The same lift from steam | Output 5000, no fire needed |
| Levitite | Fixed lift with low-speed drag | Cannot climb on its own |
| Ballast stones | Removes lift by adding mass | Eight layers |

## Trim and thrust

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:gyroscopic_propeller_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:wooden_propeller" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="ballastmod:ballast_stones" /> gain mass with each added layer, up to eight. Use them to set the resting height so the balloon holds a level instead of porpoising between climb and stall.

Forward motion comes from a propeller. A <ItemLink id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /> turns any sail structure of at least two sail blocks, and more sails mean more thrust. Reverse the rotation to reverse the thrust. An upside down <ItemLink id="aeronautics:gyroscopic_propeller_bearing" /> stabilises a top-heavy hull, and a redstone signal resets its tilt to zero.

## Camera and body tilt

Aeronautics Camera Sync tilts the view with a sloping deck, and Aeronautics Player Tilt turns the body with it. Neither steers the ship.

| Action | Your key | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Toggle camera tilt | <KeyBind id="key.aero_cam_sync.toggle" /> | I |
| Toggle player tilt | <KeyBind id="key.aero_player_tilt.toggle" /> | O |
| Camera settings | <KeyBind id="key.aero_cam_sync.open_config" /> | Unbound |
| Player tilt settings | <KeyBind id="key.aero_player_tilt.open_config" /> | Unbound |

![不同船体与升力布置的飞艇](images/visual-airship-designs.png)

不同船体与升力布置的飞艇

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:white_envelope" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:adjustable_burner" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:steam_vent" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:levitite" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:levitite_blend" /><ItemIcon id="ballastmod:ballast_stones" /><ItemIcon id="aeroencasedpipe:white_envelope_encased_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:white_envelope_encased_shaft" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:white_symmetric_sail" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="aeronautics:white_envelope" /> 本身不产生升力。气囊方块构成外壳，被包住的空气方块才会充满热气。本包给热气的升力是每立方米 1.5 千克，所以浮力取决于被包住的体积，而不是方块数量。

三条规则决定气囊能不能用。

1. 外壳必须气密。气囊方块、包壳传动轴和包壳流体管道都算气密。
2. 热气从上往下填充。五层气囊的第三层破了一个洞，就只有上面两层被充满。
3. 气囊内部的建筑会占用体积。桅杆、管道和走道要留在外壳外面。

对着气囊使用染料即可上色。再用同一种颜色会把染料扩散到相邻气囊，整只气囊因此可以很快染完。

<Recipe id="aeronautics:adjustable_burner" />
## 燃烧器与排汽口

<Recipe id="aeronautics:white_envelope" />

<ItemLink id="aeronautics:adjustable_burner" /> 装在气囊下方，收到红石信号后向气囊充入热气。输入面板设定最大输出，本包上限为 500，红石强度按比例下调这一输出。多台燃烧器可以向同一只气囊叠加，大船体因此才有可用的爬升率。

燃烧器最多搜索 80 格找到气囊，所以吊舱里的燃烧器也能供给甲板上方的气囊。<ItemLink id="aeronautics:steam_vent" /> 是蒸汽方案，上限为 5000，不需要火。

气压随高度下降，升力也随之下降。气囊不会一直保持同样的爬升速度，<ItemLink id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /> 正是读取气压与精确高度的仪表。

## 浮岩

<ItemLink id="aeronautics:levitite" /> 是第三种升力来源，提供固定的反重力，并带有低速强、高速弱的阻力。单靠浮岩能把船体托住，却不能让它爬升，所以它常用来托起重船体，再由螺旋桨推动。用火、烈焰燃烧器或营火加热 <ItemLink id="aeronautics:levitite_blend" /> 会凝固成浮岩，凝固后的方块无法再采集。用作模具的黏土会在凝固过程中被消耗。

| 升力来源 | 提供 | 本包限制 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 热气气囊 | 由密闭体积产生升力 | 每立方米 1.5 千克，燃烧器输出 500 |
| 蒸汽排汽口 | 用蒸汽产生同样的升力 | 输出 5000，不需要火 |
| 浮岩 | 固定升力与低速阻力 | 无法自行爬升 |
| 压舱石 | 通过增加质量抵消升力 | 最多八层 |

## 配平与推力

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:gyroscopic_propeller_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:wooden_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:andesite_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:smart_propeller" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="ballastmod:ballast_stones" /> 每加一层就增加质量，最多八层。用它设定静止高度，让气囊停在一个高度，而不是在爬升与失速之间来回起伏。

前进靠螺旋桨。<ItemLink id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /> 能带动至少两块帆面组成的结构，帆面越多推力越大。反转旋转方向就反转推力。倒装的 <ItemLink id="aeronautics:gyroscopic_propeller_bearing" /> 能稳定头重脚轻的船体，红石信号会把倾角归零。

## 视角与身体倾斜

Aeronautics Camera Sync 让视角跟随倾斜甲板，Aeronautics Player Tilt 让身体一起转。两者都不操控飞船。

| 操作 | 你的按键 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 切换视角倾斜 | <KeyBind id="key.aero_cam_sync.toggle" /> | I |
| 切换身体倾斜 | <KeyBind id="key.aero_player_tilt.toggle" /> | O |
| 视角设置 | <KeyBind id="key.aero_cam_sync.open_config" /> | 未绑定 |
| 身体倾斜设置 | <KeyBind id="key.aero_player_tilt.open_config" /> | 未绑定 |

vehicles.engines.en_us:
## Propulsion families

![An aircraft engine workshop](images/visual-engine-workshop.png)

An aircraft engine workshop

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:vector_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:solid_fuel_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:ion_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_fan" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_turbine" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /></ItemGrid>

This pack has four ways to push a body, and they are not interchangeable. Pick the family, then follow that family's own help.

| Family | Makes movement by | Needs | Fits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Propeller bearing | Rotating a sail structure into air | Rotation and sails | Airships and planes |
| Create Propulsion thruster | Expelling a fluid or burning solid fuel | Fuel and a signal | Air and space |
| AeroEngine turbine | Compressing and igniting kerosene | Built core and fuel | Fast aircraft |
| Rocket thruster | Burning liquid fuel in vacuum | Fuel tank and feed | Orbital launch |

## Create Propulsion thrusters

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:vector_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:solid_fuel_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:liquid_vector_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:ion_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:stirling_engine" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="createpropulsion:thruster" /> takes a fluid and a redstone input. The 2x2 and 3x3 forms take more inputs and are built from the same block, so a cluster is a bigger engine rather than a different one.

A <ItemLink id="createpropulsion:vector_thruster" /> tilts its thrust. Each side except the front and back has a redstone input, and powering a side turns the nozzle towards that side. Signal strength from 0 to 15 sets how far it rotates from centre, which is what a joystick channel feeds. The liquid vector version adds fluid thrust to the same gimbal.

A <ItemLink id="createpropulsion:solid_fuel_thruster" /> burns solid items loaded from the rear, so it needs no pipe. The <ItemLink id="createpropulsion:ion_thruster" /> takes Forge Energy and redstone and gives low thrust for a long time, which suits station keeping rather than launch.

A <ItemLink id="createpropulsion:stirling_engine" /> is the other direction. Heat from below makes it produce rotation, so it powers a propeller or a pump instead of pushing the hull.

## Turbine core

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_fan" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_compressor" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_combustor" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_turbine" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_exhaust_cone" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_kerosene_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_alloy_ingot" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_alloy_sheet" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_blade" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:compressor_component" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:turbine_component" /></ItemGrid>

The AeroEngine core stacks in one order, fan, compressor, combustor, turbine, exhaust cone. Build the core, then add the casing, nozzle, fuel feed and gearbox that the engine's own Ponder shows. A core without a fuel feed spins nothing.

<Recipe id="aeroengineering:compressor_component" />

## Fuel and where it comes from

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_kerosene_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:turpentine_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:platinum_ingot" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:redstone" /></ItemGrid>

| Fuel or input | Feeds | Supply it by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Aviation Kerosene | AeroEngine turbine | Fluid pipe into the engine feed |
| Turpentine | Create Propulsion thruster | Fluid pipe or tank |
| Solid items | Solid Fuel Thruster | Loading the rear |
| Lava | Rocket thruster | Ship fluid system |
| Forge Energy and redstone | Ion thruster | Power network and signal |

The bucket icons stand for the fluid. Nothing here asks you to insert a bucket. Kerosene is also produced by Create: The Factory Must Grow, and the fuel compat addon lets AeroEngine accept it, so one oil line can supply both engine families. Refining is covered in [Oil and industry](power.industry.md).

## Thrust in this pack

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:wooden_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:andesite_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:smart_propeller" /></ItemGrid>

The pack config scales thrust per part, not per family. Propeller bearings produce 0.2 of the reference thrust, while wooden, andesite and smart propellers each sit at 1.0. That is why one large propeller beats several small bearings, and why a bearing with only two sail blocks moves a light hull and stalls a heavy one.
vehicles.engines.zh_cn:
## 推进家族

![飞行器发动机工坊](images/visual-engine-workshop.png)

飞行器发动机工坊

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:vector_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:solid_fuel_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:ion_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_fan" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_turbine" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:turbine_component" /></ItemGrid>

本整合包有四种推动载体的方式，彼此不能互换。先选家族，再照着该家族自己的帮助做。

| 家族 | 产生运动的方式 | 需要 | 适用 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 螺旋桨轴承 | 让帆面结构在空气中旋转 | 旋转力与帆面 | 飞艇与飞机 |
| Create Propulsion 推进器 | 喷出流体或燃烧固体燃料 | 燃料与信号 | 大气与太空 |
| AeroEngine 涡轮 | 压缩并点燃煤油 | 完整核心与燃料 | 高速飞机 |
| 火箭推进器 | 在真空中燃烧液体燃料 | 燃料箱与输送 | 轨道发射 |

## Create Propulsion 推进器

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:vector_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:solid_fuel_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:liquid_vector_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:ion_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:stirling_engine" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="createpropulsion:thruster" /> 需要流体与红石输入。2x2 与 3x3 形式由同一种方块拼成，输入更多，属于更大的发动机，而不是另一种机器。

<ItemLink id="createpropulsion:vector_thruster" /> 可以让推力偏转。除前后两面外，每一面都有红石输入，给某一面通电，喷口就朝那一面转。信号强度 0 到 15 决定偏离中心的幅度，摇杆通道正是这样接进来的。液体矢量版本在此基础上增加了流体推力。

<ItemLink id="createpropulsion:solid_fuel_thruster" /> 从尾部装入固体物品燃烧，不需要管道。<ItemLink id="createpropulsion:ion_thruster" /> 消耗 Forge 能量与红石，推力小但持久，适合位置保持而不是起飞。

<ItemLink id="createpropulsion:stirling_engine" /> 方向相反，底部受热后输出旋转力，用来带动螺旋桨或泵，而不是推动船体。

## 涡轮核心

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_fan" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_compressor" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_combustor" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_turbine" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_exhaust_cone" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_kerosene_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_alloy_ingot" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_alloy_sheet" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_blade" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:compressor_component" /></ItemGrid>

AeroEngine 核心按固定顺序叠放，风扇、压气机、燃烧室、涡轮、尾喷口。先造核心，再按该发动机的思索场景补外壳、喷口、燃料供给与齿轮箱。没有燃料供给的核心不会转出任何东西。

<Recipe id="aeroengineering:compressor_component" />

## 燃料与来源

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:aviation_kerosene_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:turpentine_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="createpropulsion:platinum_ingot" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:redstone" /></ItemGrid>

| 燃料或输入 | 供给对象 | 供给方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 航空煤油 | AeroEngine 涡轮 | 用流体管道接入发动机 |
| 松节油 | Create Propulsion 推进器 | 流体管道或储罐 |
| 固体物品 | 固体燃料推进器 | 从尾部装入 |
| 熔岩 | 火箭推进器 | 船体流体系统 |
| Forge 能量与红石 | 离子推进器 | 电力网络与信号 |

桶图标代表的是流体，这里没有任何步骤要求你放入桶。Create: The Factory Must Grow 也产出煤油，燃料兼容附属让 AeroEngine 可以接受它，因此一条炼油线能同时供应两个发动机家族。炼油流程见[石油与工业](power.industry.md)。

## 本包中的推力

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:propeller_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:wooden_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:andesite_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:smart_propeller" /></ItemGrid>

整合包按部件而不是按家族缩放推力。螺旋桨轴承只有基准推力的 0.2，木质、安山岩与智能螺旋桨都是 1.0。所以一个大螺旋桨胜过几个小轴承，只有两块帆面的轴承能推动轻船体，却推不动重船体。

vehicles.controls.en_us:
## Console and modules

![A cockpit with Aeroworks control modules](images/visual-cockpit-controls.png)

A cockpit with Aeroworks control modules

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:control_desk" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:joystick_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:throttle_quadrant_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:wheel_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:lever_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:pedal_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:button_panel_module" /><ItemIcon id="create:redstone_link" /><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="aeroworks:control_desk" /> is a socket board. Right-click a socket with a module to mount it, and use a wrench to pull it back out. Removed modules keep their settings, so you can move a tuned joystick to a second ship.

Sneak and use a placed control to open its configuration. There you set the key, the Redstone Link frequencies and the module options. A held module is configured by sneaking and using the air. Several modules can share one console, and small modules fit large sockets.

Right-click the desk with an empty hand to take control. Your keyboard and mouse then move the mounted controls, and each direction transmits on its own Redstone Link frequency with a strength that follows how far you push. Escape releases control.

Touching consoles form one deck. One player controls a deck at a time, and consoles placed apart stay separate stations. That is how a pilot seat and a throttle station on the same bridge behave as one cockpit.

## Servos

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:mechanical_servo" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:stepper_servo" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:gyroscope" /></ItemGrid>

Servos turn a redstone signal back into a shaft angle, which is how a console channel reaches a control surface.

| Part | Signal to angle | Set on the block |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="aeroworks:mechanical_servo" /> | Angle proportional to signal strength across a range | Right-click to set the rotation range |
| <ItemLink id="aeroworks:stepper_servo" /> | Moves in fixed steps, one step per signal level | Right-click to set the angle of each step |

Both finish the current rotation before answering a new signal, so a fast input change lags by one movement rather than jumping. A stepper accepts a signal on either side, one side turns each way, and power on both sides holds it still. The <ItemLink id="aeroworks:gyroscope" /> keeps a body level, which is a stabiliser rather than an input.

## Sensors and receivers

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:steering_wheel" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:throttle_lever" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:velocity_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:gimbal_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:directional_linked_receiver" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:optical_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:laser_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="create_tweaked_controllers:tweaked_linked_controller" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:modulating_linked_receiver" /></ItemGrid>

A manual input is a block you turn. A sensor is a block that reports.

| Part | Reports or does | Read it with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:steering_wheel" /> | Continuous steering input | Right-click and drag |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:throttle_lever" /> | Continuous throttle input | Right-click and drag |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /> | Redstone strength from height, with a minimum and maximum set in its screen | Goggles for air pressure and exact height |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:velocity_sensor" /> | Relative speed and direction towards or away | Its screen |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:gimbal_sensor" /> | Tilt on two axes | Its screen |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:optical_sensor" /> | Detected block and distance | Its screen |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:laser_sensor" /> | Distance along a line | Its screen |

The altitude sensor increases output as it climbs by default and can be inverted, which is the usual way to hold a ceiling or a floor without a program. Receivers carry a channel from a console or link into a distant part of the ship, so you do not run a wire through the hull.

## Crafting

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_monitor_helmet" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:folding_landing_gear_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:hud_display" /></ItemGrid>

vehicles.controls.zh_cn:
## 控制台与模块

![装有 Aeroworks 控制模块的驾驶舱](images/visual-cockpit-controls.png)

装有 Aeroworks 控制模块的驾驶舱

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:control_desk" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:joystick_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:throttle_quadrant_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:wheel_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:lever_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:pedal_module" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:button_panel_module" /><ItemIcon id="create:redstone_link" /><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="aeroworks:control_desk" /> 是一块插槽板。手持模块右键插槽即可装上，用扳手可以取下。取下的模块保留设置，调好的摇杆可以直接换到另一艘船上。

潜行使用已放置的控制件可以打开配置，按键、红石链接频率和模块选项都在这里设置。手持模块时潜行使用空气即可配置该模块。同一控制台可以装多个模块，小模块也能装进大插槽。

空手右键控制台即可接管。此后键盘和鼠标会带动已安装的控制件，每个方向都在各自的红石链接频率上发送信号，强度随推动幅度变化。按 Escape 放开控制。

相邻的控制台会组成一个操控台组。同一时间只有一名玩家能控制一个操控台组，隔开摆放的控制台则是独立工位。驾驶座和节流工位并排时因此像同一个驾驶舱一样工作。

## 伺服机构

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:mechanical_servo" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:stepper_servo" /><ItemIcon id="aeroworks:gyroscope" /></ItemGrid>

伺服机构把红石信号还原成轴的角度，控制台通道就是这样带动舵面的。

| 部件 | 信号到角度 | 方块上的设置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="aeroworks:mechanical_servo" /> | 在设定范围内按信号强度成比例转动 | 右键设置转动范围 |
| <ItemLink id="aeroworks:stepper_servo" /> | 分级转动，每个信号等级走一档 | 右键设置每档角度 |

两者都会先转完当前动作再响应新信号，所以输入变化快时会慢一个动作，而不是直接跳过去。步进伺服两侧都能接收信号，一侧正转一侧反转，两侧同时通电则原地保持。<ItemLink id="aeroworks:gyroscope" /> 用于保持机体水平，属于稳定装置，不是输入装置。

## 传感器与接收器

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="simulated:steering_wheel" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:throttle_lever" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:velocity_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:gimbal_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:directional_linked_receiver" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:optical_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:laser_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="create_tweaked_controllers:tweaked_linked_controller" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:modulating_linked_receiver" /></ItemGrid>

手动输入是你去转的方块，传感器是替你读数的方块。

| 部件 | 作用 | 读取方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:steering_wheel" /> | 连续转向输入 | 右键拖动 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:throttle_lever" /> | 连续油门输入 | 右键拖动 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /> | 按高度输出红石强度，上下限在界面里设定 | 戴工程师护目镜可读气压与精确高度 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:velocity_sensor" /> | 相对速度，以及靠近或远离方向 | 打开界面 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:gimbal_sensor" /> | 两个轴上的倾斜角 | 打开界面 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:optical_sensor" /> | 探测到的方块与距离 | 打开界面 |
| <ItemLink id="simulated:laser_sensor" /> | 沿直线测距 | 打开界面 |

高度传感器默认越高输出越强，也可以反过来，这是不用程序就能守住某一高度层的常用做法。接收器把控制台或链接的通道送到船体远端，不必让线缆穿过整个外壳。

## 合成

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:engine_monitor_helmet" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:folding_landing_gear_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:hud_display" /></ItemGrid>

<Recipe id="aeroworks:throttle_quadrant_module" />

vehicles.radar.en_us:
## Detection chain

![Radar antenna assemblies](images/feedback-radar-dish.png)

Radar antenna assemblies

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_receiver_block" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_dish_block" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_plate_block" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:monitor" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:data_link" /></ItemGrid>

A radar is a bearing, a receiver, a dish array and a monitor, linked in that order.

1. Place the <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_bearing" /> and give it rotation. It sweeps the array.
2. Place the <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_receiver_block" /> beside it.
3. Build dishes with <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_dish_block" /> or plates with <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_plate_block" />. Dishes and plates are interchangeable, and each added piece extends range.
4. Place a <ItemLink id="create_radar:monitor" /> where you read it, and join the two with a <ItemLink id="create_radar:data_link" />.
5. Right-click the link to configure the channel.

A sweeping bearing alone detects nothing. An array with no receiver reports nothing. The monitor shows what the receiver sends, so check the link colour before blaming the array.

## Network and filters

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:network_filterer" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_filter_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:target_filter_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:ident_filter_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:identification_transponder" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_safe_zone_designator" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_warning_receiver" /></ItemGrid>

The <ItemLink id="create_radar:network_filterer" /> is the centre of a radar network. It accepts filters that limit what the network can see and do, and it links to monitors in the same way a single radar does.

| Filter | Limits by | Fit it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_filter_item" /> | Which contacts appear | The screen is crowded |
| <ItemLink id="create_radar:target_filter_item" /> | Which contacts can be targeted | You share airspace with allies |
| <ItemLink id="create_radar:ident_filter_item" /> | Which identities are accepted | You run transponders |

An <ItemLink id="create_radar:identification_transponder" /> on a friendly craft marks it as known. The <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_warning_receiver" /> warns a craft that it is being tracked, and the <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_safe_zone_designator" /> keeps a position out of the weapon network.

## Fire control

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_yaw_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_pitch_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:fire_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:guided_fuze" /></ItemGrid>

A turret needs a yaw controller under the mount and a pitch controller beside it. Link both with data links, then select a target on the monitor. The <ItemLink id="create_radar:fire_controller" /> emits redstone when the cannon is aligned, and that signal is what actually fires the gun.

Red data links belong to a weapon network and blue data links to a radar network. Mixing the two is the usual reason a turret tracks but never fires.

<Recipe id="create_radar:crafting/auto_pitch_controller" />

## Aircraft radar

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:airborne_radar" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:binoculars" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:plane_radar" /></ItemGrid>

The AeroEngine <ItemLink id="aeroengineering:airborne_radar" /> is a separate instrument. It switches targets, confirms a lock and sends launch frequencies to a missile, so it belongs with the aircraft's own weapon, not with the ground radar network. <ItemLink id="create_radar:binoculars" /> identify a contact by eye when the screen is ambiguous.
vehicles.radar.zh_cn:
## 探测链

![雷达天线组件](images/feedback-radar-dish.png)

雷达天线组件

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_receiver_block" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_dish_block" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_plate_block" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:monitor" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:data_link" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:plane_radar" /></ItemGrid>

一部雷达由轴承、接收器、天线阵和显示器组成，按这个顺序连接。

1. 放下 <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_bearing" /> 并给它旋转力，由它扫动天线阵。
2. 在旁边放下 <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_receiver_block" />。
3. 用 <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_dish_block" /> 造天线，或用 <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_plate_block" /> 造平板。两者可以混用，每增加一件都扩大范围。
4. 在你要看的位置放下 <ItemLink id="create_radar:monitor" />，用 <ItemLink id="create_radar:data_link" /> 把两者连起来。
5. 右键链接设置频道。

只转的轴承什么也探测不到。没有接收器的天线阵什么也报不出来。显示器显示的是接收器送来的内容，所以在怀疑天线之前先看链接颜色。

## 网络与过滤器

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:network_filterer" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_filter_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:target_filter_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:ident_filter_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:identification_transponder" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_safe_zone_designator" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:radar_warning_receiver" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="create_radar:network_filterer" /> 是雷达网络的中心。它接受过滤器，用来限制网络能看见什么、能做什么，并像单部雷达一样连到显示器。

| 过滤器 | 限制内容 | 适用时机 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_filter_item" /> | 屏幕上出现哪些目标 | 画面过于杂乱 |
| <ItemLink id="create_radar:target_filter_item" /> | 哪些目标可以被锁定 | 与友军共用空域 |
| <ItemLink id="create_radar:ident_filter_item" /> | 接受哪些身份 | 使用应答机时 |

友方飞行器装上 <ItemLink id="create_radar:identification_transponder" /> 就会被识别为已知目标。<ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_warning_receiver" /> 在被跟踪时提醒本机，<ItemLink id="create_radar:radar_safe_zone_designator" /> 则把某个位置排除在火力网络之外。

## 火力控制

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_yaw_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_pitch_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:fire_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:guided_fuze" /></ItemGrid>

炮塔需要在炮架下方装偏航控制器，旁边装俯仰控制器。两者都用数据链接连好，然后在显示器上选择目标。<ItemLink id="create_radar:fire_controller" /> 只在火炮对准时输出红石，真正开火的是这个信号。

红色数据链接属于火力网络，蓝色属于雷达网络。两者接反，是炮塔会跟随却始终不开火的常见原因。

<Recipe id="create_radar:crafting/auto_pitch_controller" />

## 机载雷达

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:airborne_radar" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:binoculars" /></ItemGrid>

AeroEngine 的 <ItemLink id="aeroengineering:airborne_radar" /> 是另一套仪表。它切换目标、确认锁定并向导弹发送发射频率，所以它与飞机自己的武器配套，而不是接入地面雷达网络。<ItemLink id="create_radar:binoculars" /> 用来在画面含糊时用肉眼确认目标。

vehicles.weapons.en_us:
## Cannon assembly

![Cannons mounted on a ship](images/feedback-mounted-cannons.png)

Cannons mounted on a ship

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:cannon_mount" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:steel_cannon_barrel" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:steel_sliding_breech" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:bronze_autocannon_barrel" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:autocannon_ammo_container" /></ItemGrid>

A large cannon is a barrel, a chamber, a breech and a mount, built in that order. The barrel is the length, the chamber holds the charge, the breech is what you open to load, and the mount is what the whole thing pivots on.

| Family | Parts | Fires |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cast iron | Barrel, chamber, breech | Cheap early guns |
| Bronze | Barrel, chamber, breech | Autocannon work |
| Steel | Barrel, sliding breech | Standard ship gun |
| Nethersteel | Barrel, chamber, breech | The heavy end |

Families do not mix. A steel barrel will not seat a bronze breech, so decide the family before you start casting.

Mount it with the <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:cannon_mount" /> on an assembled body. On a Sable ship the mount is what makes the gun follow the hull, and the recoil is scaled by the pack's potato cannon setting only for that weapon, so a large cannon does not throw the ship the way the potato cannon does.

## Loading and firing

The load order is powder, then projectile, then close. Open the breech, insert the charge, insert the shell, close the breech, then give the mount a redstone signal to fire. A gun that clicks but does not fire is usually empty, or the breech is still open.

The <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:autocannon_ammo_container" /> feeds an autocannon a belt of rounds so it can fire repeatedly without reloading each shot. Point it into the feed and load the container instead of the breech.

<Recipe id="createbigcannons:ap_shot" />

## Ammunition

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:ap_shell" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:ap_shot" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:bag_of_grapeshot" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:big_cartridge" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:guided_fuze" /></ItemGrid>

| Round | Job | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:ap_shell" /> | Pierces armour | Armoured ships and blocks |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:ap_shot" /> | Solid impact | Structures |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:bag_of_grapeshot" /> | Spread at short range | Crew and light craft |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:big_cartridge" /> | Complete charge and round | Fast reloading |

Match the round to the bore. A shell that does not fit the barrel is a shell you cannot load, and the recipe browser shows which family each round belongs to.

## Aircraft weapons

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:missile_assembly_station" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:air_to_air_missile" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:mounted_potato_cannon" /></ItemGrid>

AeroEngine supplies a <ItemLink id="aeroengineering:missile_assembly_station" /> and an <ItemLink id="aeroengineering:air_to_air_missile" />. The missile is fired from the aircraft radar lock, so build the station before you plan an intercept.

The <ItemLink id="aeronautics:mounted_potato_cannon" /> is the light option. Its recoil is a pack setting of 0.2, which is enough to nudge a small hull and not enough to stop a large one.

## Aiming

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_yaw_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_pitch_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:fire_controller" /></ItemGrid>

Point the gun with a yaw and pitch controller from [Radar](vehicles.radar.md), and let the fire controller pull the trigger when the barrel is on target. Firing by hand from a moving deck works, but the shot inherits the ship's motion.

***
vehicles.weapons.zh_cn:
## 火炮组装

![安装在船上的火炮](images/feedback-mounted-cannons.png)

安装在船上的火炮

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:cannon_mount" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:steel_cannon_barrel" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:steel_sliding_breech" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:bronze_autocannon_barrel" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:autocannon_ammo_container" /></ItemGrid>

大型火炮由炮管、药室、炮闩和炮架组成，按这个顺序搭建。炮管决定长度，药室装发射药，炮闩是你打开装填的部分，炮架负责整个火炮的回转。

| 家族 | 部件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 铸铁 | 炮管、药室、炮闩 | 便宜的前期火炮 |
| 青铜 | 炮管、药室、炮闩 | 自动炮作业 |
| 钢 | 炮管、滑动炮闩 | 标准舰炮 |
| 下界钢 | 炮管、药室、炮闩 | 重型端 |

各家族不能混用。钢炮管装不上青铜炮闩，所以在开炉之前就要定好家族。

把 <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:cannon_mount" /> 装在已组装的载体上。在 Sable 船上，炮架让火炮跟随船体，后坐力只按整合包里的土豆炮设置缩放那一种武器，所以大型火炮不会像土豆炮那样把船推开。

## 装填与开火

顺序是发射药、弹丸、闭闩。打开炮闩，放入发射药，放入炮弹，关上炮闩，然后给炮架红石信号开火。只响一声却不发射，通常是空膛，或者炮闩还开着。

<ItemLink id="createbigcannons:autocannon_ammo_container" /> 用弹链给自动炮持续供弹，不必每发都手动装填。把它对准进弹口，往容器里装弹即可。

<Recipe id="createbigcannons:ap_shot" />

## 弹药

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:ap_shell" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:ap_shot" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:bag_of_grapeshot" /><ItemIcon id="createbigcannons:big_cartridge" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:guided_fuze" /></ItemGrid>

| 弹种 | 作用 | 目标 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:ap_shell" /> | 穿甲 | 装甲船与方块 |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:ap_shot" /> | 实心撞击 | 建筑结构 |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:bag_of_grapeshot" /> | 近距离散布 | 人员与轻型载具 |
| <ItemLink id="createbigcannons:big_cartridge" /> | 药弹一体 | 快速装填 |

弹药要与口径配套。装不进炮管的炮弹就是无法装填的炮弹，配方浏览器会显示每种弹药属于哪个家族。

## 机载武器

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:missile_assembly_station" /><ItemIcon id="aeroengineering:air_to_air_missile" /><ItemIcon id="aeronautics:mounted_potato_cannon" /></ItemGrid>

AeroEngine 提供 <ItemLink id="aeroengineering:missile_assembly_station" /> 与 <ItemLink id="aeroengineering:air_to_air_missile" />。导弹依靠机载雷达锁定发射，所以要先造好组装台再计划拦截。

<ItemLink id="aeronautics:mounted_potato_cannon" /> 是轻量选择。它的后坐力在整合包里是 0.2，足以推动小船体，却推不动大船。

## 瞄准

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_yaw_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:auto_pitch_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_radar:fire_controller" /></ItemGrid>

用[雷达](vehicles.radar.md)的偏航与俯仰控制器转动火炮，让火力控制器在炮口对准时触发。在移动甲板上手动开火也能用，但炮弹会带着船的速度。

***

vehicles.water.en_us:
## Hull

![Deep Seas copper submarine](images/building-travel-submarine.png)

Deep Seas copper submarine.

A submarine is a sealed hull built as a Simulated Contraption, then fitted with ballast, propulsion and air. Assemble it as described in [Assembly](vehicles.assembly.md). The hull decides how deep you can go, so fit the pressure glass before the first dive rather than after it.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:floater" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:ballast_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:ballast_vent" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:water_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:submarine_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:rudder" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:arresting_hook" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:decompression_chamber" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:oak_boat" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:oak_tackle_box_boat" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="create_submarine:floater" /> keeps a surface boat up. It is a float, not a dive control.

## Dive and rise

<Recipe id="create_submarine:ballast_tank" />

The dive system is a <ItemLink id="create_submarine:ballast_vent" />, a pump, and one or more <ItemLink id="create_submarine:ballast_tank" /> blocks, joined with pipes.

1. Place the vent so at least one face touches the sea. Without sea contact there is nothing to pump.
2. Pipe every vent face you need to the tanks, through a Mechanical Pump.
3. Pull water from the vent into the tanks to dive. The submarine gets heavier as the tanks fill.
4. Reverse the pump to push the water back out of the vent. The tanks empty and the submarine rises.

The vent itself needs no rotation and no redstone. The pump is what moves the water, so a pump with no rotation is a ballast system that does nothing. With an <ItemLink id="create_submarine:pump_controller" /> and an Onboard Computer aboard, the computer works out which way round the pipe run goes and drives the pumps to a target depth you set on its screen.

## Propulsion and steering

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:underwater_mine" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Needs | Gives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:water_thruster" /> | Water pressure and rotation | Thrust that rises with both |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:submarine_propeller" /> | Rotation | Steady underwater drive |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:rudder" /> | A steering input | Turns the hull |

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:water_thruster" /> burns pressurised water for thrust and needs a water supply and rotation. More pressure and more speed mean more thrust. The <ItemLink id="create_submarine:submarine_propeller" /> is the simpler drive and works underwater, not in air. The <ItemLink id="create_submarine:rudder" /> is the steering surface.

A surface boat can use a propeller as well, but a propeller in air pushes nothing.

## Air and pressure

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:barometer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:copper_pressurizer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:iron_pressurizer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:phycological_membrane" /></ItemGrid>

| Machine | Takes | Gives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /> | Water and Forge Energy, or a shaft in its module slot | Oxygen |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /> | Stored oxygen and a redstone signal | Breathable air in the sealed room |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:barometer" /> | Nothing | Depth and hull pressure against the weakest block |

The electrolyzer can run without an electricity network. Put a shaft in its module slot and it converts rotation into its own power, which is the route this pack expects on a Create ship. The diffuser consumes oxygen in proportion to the size of the submarine, so a large hull needs more than one, or a smaller sealed cabin.

The barometer compares outside pressure with the weakest block in the hull. Read it before you descend further, and watch it after any hull repair. Copper and iron pressurised glass are windows that hold pressure, and a <ItemLink id="create_submarine:phycological_membrane" /> can be filled with air.

## Finding the way

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:sonar" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:pump_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:industrial_alarm" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:steel_cable" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:pulley" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="create_submarine:sonar" /> maps the sea floor, rocks, other ships and mines around the hull. With an Onboard Computer on the same ship it adds map pages and lets the autopilot follow the sea floor and keep the keel clear.

Steel cable and facing pulleys carry a sublevel along a fixed line, which suits a diving bell or a cable car more than a free submarine. The <ItemLink id="create_submarine:industrial_alarm" /> warns the crew, and the underwater mine is a weapon rather than a tool.

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

***
vehicles.water.zh_cn:
## 船体

![Deep Seas 铜制潜艇](images/building-travel-submarine.png)

Deep Seas 铜制潜艇。

潜艇是作为模拟悬浮体建造的密闭船体，然后装上压载、推进与空气系统。组装方法见[组装](vehicles.assembly.md)。船体决定你能潜多深，所以耐压玻璃要在第一次下潜前装好，而不是之后补。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:floater" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:ballast_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:ballast_vent" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:water_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:submarine_propeller" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:rudder" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:arresting_hook" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:decompression_chamber" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:underwater_mine" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:floater" /> 让水面船保持浮起。它是浮体，不是下潜控制。

## 下潜与上浮

<Recipe id="create_submarine:ballast_tank" />

下潜系统由 <ItemLink id="create_submarine:ballast_vent" />、一台泵和一个或多个 <ItemLink id="create_submarine:ballast_tank" /> 组成，用管道连接。

1. 放置排海口，至少有一面接触海水。接触不到海水就没有可抽的东西。
2. 用机械泵把需要的排海口各面接到压载舱。
3. 从排海口把水抽进压载舱即下潜。舱越满，潜艇越重。
4. 反转泵把水推回排海口。压载舱排空，潜艇上浮。

排海口本身不需要旋转力，也不需要红石。真正搬水的是泵，所以不转的泵等于一套什么也不做的压载系统。船上装有 <ItemLink id="create_submarine:pump_controller" /> 与船载计算机时，计算机会判断管路方向，并按你在屏幕上设定的目标深度驱动水泵。

## 推进与转向

| 部件 | 需要 | 提供 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:water_thruster" /> | 水压与旋转力 | 随两者提升的推力 |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:submarine_propeller" /> | 旋转力 | 稳定的水下推进 |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:rudder" /> | 转向输入 | 改变船体方向 |

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:water_thruster" /> 消耗加压水产生推力，需要供水与旋转力。压力越大、转速越高，推力越大。<ItemLink id="create_submarine:submarine_propeller" /> 是更简单的驱动，只在水中工作，空气中无效。<ItemLink id="create_submarine:rudder" /> 是转向面。

水面船也可以用螺旋桨，但螺旋桨在空气里推不动任何东西。

## 空气与压力

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:barometer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:copper_pressurizer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:iron_pressurizer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:phycological_membrane" /></ItemGrid>

| 机器 | 输入 | 输出 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /> | 水与 Forge 能量，或在模块槽放入传动轴 | 氧气 |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /> | 储存的氧气与红石信号 | 密闭舱内的可呼吸空气 |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:barometer" /> | 无 | 深度，以及相对最弱方块的水压 |

电解机可以完全不用电力网络。在模块槽放入传动轴，它就把旋转力转成自身用电，这是本包在 Create 船上预期的做法。扩散器按潜艇体积消耗氧气，大船体要么多装几台，要么缩小密闭舱。

气压计把外部压力与船体最弱的方块比较。继续下潜前先读它，修补船体后也要看它。铜制与铁制耐压玻璃是能承压的窗，<ItemLink id="create_submarine:phycological_membrane" /> 可以充入空气。

## 寻找航路

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:sonar" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:pump_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:industrial_alarm" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:steel_cable" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:pulley" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:oak_boat" /><ItemIcon id="starcatcher:oak_tackle_box_boat" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="create_submarine:sonar" /> 绘制船体周围的海床、岩石、其他船只与水雷。同一艘船上装有船载计算机时，它会增加地图页面，并让自动驾驶沿着海床保持龙骨离地。

钢缆与相对放置的滑轮让子层级沿固定线路移动，更适合潜水钟或缆车，而不是自由航行的潜艇。<ItemLink id="create_submarine:industrial_alarm" /> 用于提醒船员，水雷属于武器而不是工具。

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

transport.passenger.en_us:
## Route search

![Train bodywork with Bells & Whistles fittings](images/visual-train-fittings.png)

Train bodywork with Bells & Whistles fittings

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:navigator" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:train_station_clock" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:navigator" /> searches the train network that already exists. It does not lay track and it does not move you. Open it, pick a departure station and a destination station, and it lists the services, the transfer stops and the live position of the trains on each leg.

The station list comes from placed <ItemLink id="create:track_station" /> blocks with names. An unnamed station cannot be chosen, and a station on a line with no schedule has no service to show.

A <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:train_station_clock" /> shows the time at a station and the next departure. Place it where passengers wait, not on the train.

## Passenger displays

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_block" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_panel" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_half_panel" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_slab" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_sloped" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_small" /><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid>

The display family is one screen in several shapes, so it fits a wall, a slab, a slope or a small post.

| Shape | Fits |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_block" /> | A full wall panel |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_panel" /> | A wide wall strip |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_half_panel" /> | A narrow strip |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_slab" /> | A low ledge or counter |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_sloped" /> | A angled mount over a platform |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_small" /> | A post or a carriage interior |

Use a wrench on a placed display to choose what it shows. The options are train destination, passenger information, platform, departure board and static text. A destination display follows one train, so it belongs on the carriage. A platform or departure board display belongs at the station, where it can list several services.

<Recipe id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display" />

## A working station

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_block" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:navigator" /></ItemGrid>

1. Name the station on the <ItemLink id="create:track_station" /> and confirm the train stops there in its schedule.
2. Place the platform display facing the waiting area and set it to departure board.
3. Place a train destination display inside each carriage and set it to the train.
4. Carry the Navigator and check that the service appears between the two stations before you invite anyone aboard.

If the Navigator finds no route, the fault is in the schedule or the station name, not in the Navigator.
transport.passenger.zh_cn:
## 线路查询

![装有 Bells & Whistles 配件的列车车体](images/visual-train-fittings.png)

装有 Bells & Whistles 配件的列车车体

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:navigator" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:train_station_clock" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:navigator" /> 查询已经存在的铁路网络。它不铺轨，也不运送你。打开后选择出发站与目的站，它会列出车次、换乘站以及每一段上列车的实时位置。

车站列表来自已放置并命名的 <ItemLink id="create:track_station" />。没命名的车站无法选择，没有时刻表的线路也没有车次可显示。

<ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:train_station_clock" /> 显示车站时间和下一班发车。它装在候车处，不装在车上。

## 乘客显示屏

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_block" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_panel" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_half_panel" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_slab" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_sloped" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_small" /></ItemGrid>

显示屏家族是同一块屏幕的多种形状，可装到墙面、台阶、斜面或小立柱上。

| 形状 | 适用位置 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_block" /> | 整面墙板 |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_panel" /> | 宽墙条 |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_half_panel" /> | 窄条 |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_slab" /> | 矮台或柜台 |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_sloped" /> | 站台上方的斜装 |
| <ItemLink id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_small" /> | 立柱或车厢内部 |

对已放置的显示屏使用扳手可以选择显示内容。可选项目包括列车终点、乘客信息、站台、发车板与静态文字。终点显示跟随某一列车，所以装在车厢里。站台或发车板装设在车站，可以列出多趟车次。

<Recipe id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display" />

## 可用的车站

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:advanced_display_block" /><ItemIcon id="createrailwaysnavigator:navigator" /></ItemGrid>

1. 在 <ItemLink id="create:track_station" /> 上给车站命名，并确认列车时刻表里会停靠该站。
2. 把站台显示屏朝向候车区，设为发车板。
3. 在每节车厢内装一块终点显示屏，绑定该列车。
4. 带着导航器确认两站之间能查到车次，再邀请乘客上车。

导航器查不到线路时，问题在时刻表或车站名，不在导航器。

transport.railway-builder.en_us:
## Line, station, schedule

![Train bodywork with Bells & Whistles fittings](images/visual-train-fittings.png)

Train bodywork with Bells & Whistles fittings

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:track" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /><ItemIcon id="create:controls" /><ItemIcon id="create:schedule" /><ItemIcon id="create:railway_casing" /></ItemGrid>

A Create train needs three things in this order. A continuous line of <ItemLink id="create:track" />, a <ItemLink id="create:track_station" /> on that line, and a <ItemLink id="create:controls" /> block inside the body you intend to drive.

Lay the track first and check that both ends meet. A one block gap is enough to stop a train, and track laid on a curve needs a radius the bogies can follow.

Then build the carriage as a normal block structure and place the Train Controls inside it. Place the station beside the track, give it a name, and assemble the train through the station. The station is what turns the blocks into a train, so a carriage with no station nearby stays a building.

The <ItemLink id="create:schedule" /> is the timetable. Put it in the train, add the stations in the order you want, and set the conditions. A train with no schedule runs once and stops.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/track_station" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/controls" />

## Track families

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:track" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /><ItemIcon id="create:controls" /><ItemIcon id="create:schedule" /></ItemGrid>

Create supplies the standard track and the station and controls that go with it. Steam 'n' Rails extends the families with narrower and wider gauges, switches, signals and conductor equipment. Gauge is not cosmetic. A train assembles on the track it was built against, and a switch only joins tracks of the same gauge.

Build a short test line in the gauge you intend to use before you build the main line. Changing gauge halfway through is a rebuild, not an adjustment.

## Bogies

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:railway_casing" /></ItemGrid>

Blocks & Bogies adds a Bogie Customisation interface rather than a separate set of bogie items. Right-click a placed bogie to open it and choose the driver or truck role, then the axle count, size and length the menu offers. Valve gear styles are further choices in the same menu, and the menu can switch to the Steam 'n' Rails styles.

| Choice | Changes | Keep consistent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Role | Whether the bogie drives or carries | One driver bogie per train |
| Axle count | How many wheels touch the rail | Match the carriage weight |
| Size and length | The wheel and frame footprint | Match the curve radius |
| Valve gear | Visible motion | Appearance only |

Not every combination is interchangeable. A long bogie on a tight curve derails where a short one holds, so test the combination on the tightest curve on your line.

## Freight and passengers

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:schedule" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /></ItemGrid>

A carriage carries what you put in it. Seats, storage and fluid tanks are ordinary blocks inside the train body, and the schedule decides where it stops. For passenger information and route search, see [Train travel](transport.passenger.md).
transport.railway-builder.zh_cn:
## 线路、车站与时刻表

![装有 Bells & Whistles 配件的列车车体](images/visual-train-fittings.png)

装有 Bells & Whistles 配件的列车车体

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:track" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /><ItemIcon id="create:controls" /><ItemIcon id="create:schedule" /><ItemIcon id="create:railway_casing" /></ItemGrid>

Create 列车按顺序需要三样东西。连续的 <ItemLink id="create:track" /> 线路，线路上的一座 <ItemLink id="create:track_station" />，以及要驾驶的车体内部的一块 <ItemLink id="create:controls" />。

先铺轨，并确认两端接上。一格缺口就足以让列车停下，弯道上的轨道还需要轮架能跟得上的半径。

然后把车厢当作普通方块结构造好，把列车控制装在里面。把车站放在轨道旁，命名，再通过车站组装列车。车站才是把方块变成列车的装置，附近没有车站的车厢只是建筑。

<ItemLink id="create:schedule" /> 是时刻表。放进列车，按想要的顺序加入车站并设置条件。没有时刻表的列车只跑一趟就停。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/track_station" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/controls" />

## 轨道家族

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:track" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /><ItemIcon id="create:controls" /><ItemIcon id="create:schedule" /></ItemGrid>

Create 提供标准轨道以及配套的车站与控制。Steam 'n' Rails 扩展出更窄和更宽的轨距、道岔、信号与乘务设备。轨距不是装饰。列车在哪种轨道上组装，就属于哪种轨距，道岔也只连接同轨距的轨道。

在铺主线之前，先用打算使用的轨距修一段短测试线。中途换轨距等于重建，而不是调整。

## 转向架

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:railway_casing" /></ItemGrid>

Blocks & Bogies 增加的是转向架定制界面，而不是另一套转向架物品。右键已放置的转向架打开界面，先选驱动或承载角色，再选菜单提供的轴数、尺寸与长度。气门机构样式是同一界面里的进一步选择，菜单也可以切到 Steam 'n' Rails 的样式。

| 选项 | 改变 | 保持一致 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 角色 | 转向架驱动还是承载 | 每列车一个驱动转向架 |
| 轴数 | 接触轨道的轮数 | 与车厢重量匹配 |
| 尺寸与长度 | 车轮与框架占地 | 与弯道半径匹配 |
| 气门机构 | 可见运动 | 仅影响外观 |

并非所有组合都能互换。长转向架在急弯上会脱轨，短转向架则能通过，所以要在全线最急的弯道上测试组合。

## 货运与客运

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:schedule" /><ItemIcon id="create:track_station" /></ItemGrid>

车厢装什么由你决定。座椅、储物与流体罐都是车体内的普通方块，停靠位置由时刻表决定。乘客信息与线路查询见[列车出行](transport.passenger.md)。

transport.local.en_us:
## Hypertube line

![Hypertube sections and supports](images/visual-local-hypertubes.png)

Hypertube sections and supports

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube_entrance" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube_accelerator" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube_junction" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:tube_scanner_attachment" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:redstone_detector_tube_attachment" /></ItemGrid>

A hypertube is a tube you are fired through, not a vehicle you drive.

1. Right-click a placed tube while holding another tube, then place the second one. The pair is now connected.
2. Continue the line the same way. Use a wrench on a segment to change its segment count.
3. Put an entrance at each end and give it at least 16 revolutions per minute. Faster rotation moves you faster.
4. Add accelerators along the run to raise speed, or set one to brake mode by right-clicking it.

An entrance with no rotation is a hole in the wall. The entrance mode itself is changed with a wrench, and a Redstone Detector Attachment can switch the mode from a signal.

## Branches and speed

| Part | Does | Set with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:hypertube_accelerator" /> | Raises speed, or brakes | Right-click to toggle brake mode |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:hypertube_junction" /> | Joins up to three tubes | Wrench to cycle modes |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:tube_scanner_attachment" /> | Detects a traveller | Nothing, it outputs redstone |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:redstone_detector_tube_attachment" /> | Switches entrance or accelerator mode | Its redstone input |

A junction can join three tubes. While you travel you pick the branch with your movement keys. In Continue mode travellers always take the side tubes, and in Center mode they always take the front tube. The detector attachment toggles between those two forced modes.

The scanner attachment reads 8 redstone power for a baby and 15 for an adult, so a signal line can count who passed. Attachments also fit into accelerators on any side at the same time.

## Walkways

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="escalated:metal_walkway_steps" /><ItemIcon id="escalated:wooden_walkway_steps" /></ItemGrid>

Escalated adds moving walkway steps in metal and wood. They are rotation powered like any Create machine, and they carry you along a floor rather than through a tube. Use them at the station end of a hypertube, where you want a short ride to the platform instead of another entrance.

<Recipe id="escalated:metal_walkway_steps" />
transport.local.zh_cn:
## 超导管道线路

![超导管道段落与支架](images/visual-local-hypertubes.png)

超导管道段落与支架

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube_entrance" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube_accelerator" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:hypertube_junction" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:tube_scanner_attachment" /><ItemIcon id="create_hypertube:redstone_detector_tube_attachment" /></ItemGrid>

超导管道是把你发射出去的管子，不是你驾驶的载具。

1. 手持管道右键已放置的管道，再放下第二段。两段就此连接。
2. 用同样方式继续延长。用扳手可以改变单个段的段数。
3. 两端各装一个入口，并给它至少每分钟 16 转。转速越高，行进越快。
4. 沿线加入加速器提高速度，或用右键把某个加速器设为制动模式。

不转的入口只是墙上的一个洞。入口模式用扳手切换，红石探测器附件可以用信号切换模式。

## 分支与速度

| 部件 | 作用 | 设置方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:hypertube_accelerator" /> | 提速或制动 | 右键切换制动模式 |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:hypertube_junction" /> | 连接最多三段管道 | 扳手循环模式 |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:tube_scanner_attachment" /> | 探测通行者 | 无需设置，直接输出红石 |
| <ItemLink id="create_hypertube:redstone_detector_tube_attachment" /> | 切换入口或加速器模式 | 由红石输入控制 |

分叉器最多连接三段管道。行进途中用移动键选择分支。继续模式下通行者总是走两侧管道，居中模式下总是走前方管道。探测器附件在这两种强制模式之间切换。

扫描附件对幼年生物输出 8 级红石，对成年生物输出 15 级，所以一条信号线就能统计经过的对象。附件也可以同时装在加速器的任意一侧。

## 步道

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="escalated:metal_walkway_steps" /><ItemIcon id="escalated:wooden_walkway_steps" /></ItemGrid>

Escalated 增加金属与木质两种移动步道。它们和 Create 其他机器一样靠旋转驱动，沿地面运送你，而不是穿过管道。把它们装在超导管道的车站一端，用来代替再建一个入口。

<Recipe id="escalated:metal_walkway_steps" />

## 房间与工具

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="handcrafted:oak_chair" />
  <ItemIcon id="immersive_paintings:painting" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" />
