storage.bulk.en_us:
## Vault capacity is blocks times twenty

An <ItemLink id="create:item_vault" /> stores items as a connected block. This pack sets the vault at 20 stacks per block, so capacity follows the number of blocks in the shape rather than the face you see.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/item_vault" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:item_vault" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:item_silo" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inventory_access_port" /></ItemGrid>

| Shape | Blocks | Stacks held |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Single vault block | 1 | 20 |
| Two block vault | 2 | 40 |
| Three by three face | 9 | 180 |

The vault connects only through its own faces and through funnels or chutes placed against them. A vault is not a chest, so it has no screen with slots you can sort. Read it with a stock link or a display link instead.

***

## Shapes that fit a wall

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:shipping_container" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_item_vault" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_shipping_container" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:fluid_vessel" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:basic_shipping_container" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_basic_shipping_container" /></ItemGrid>

| Block | Use |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:item_silo" /> | A vertical item vault for a tall room |
| <ItemLink id="create_vibrant_vaults:shipping_container" /> | Wide storage that reads as a container yard |
| <ItemLink id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_item_vault" /> | Tall storage for a narrow room |
| <ItemLink id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_shipping_container" /> | The vertical container variant |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:fluid_vessel" /> | A horizontal fluid tank |

Vibrant Vaults adds colored and dyed versions of each family. Color is a label, not a capacity change, so a red vault and a blue vault of the same shape hold the same amount.

The fluid vessel is a horizontal tank and can be turned into a boiler with reduced efficiency. Its window shape cycles with a wrench, which is worth doing before you bury it in a wall.

***

## Reaching the face you cannot see

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inventory_access_port" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inventory_bridge" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inventory_access_port" /> | Adds an accessible face to a container in a tight spot |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inventory_bridge" /> | Exposes two inventories as one connection, filters respected |
| <ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> | Takes filtered items from a chosen face |
| <ItemLink id="create:stock_link" /> | Makes the vault visible to a stock network |

The bridge is the part that changes layouts. Its filters are respected when items are extracted through it, so it can present a wall of vaults as one tidy output without also leaking everything inside.

Neither part adds capacity. A vault with three access ports holds exactly what the same vault held before.

***

## Placing a first vault

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:item_vault" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /></ItemGrid>

1. Craft one <ItemLink id="create:item_vault" /> and place it against the wall of the room it serves.
2. Put a funnel or chute on the face your belt reaches.
3. Add a second vault block against the first and check that the two read as one store.
4. Fit a stock link if you want a factory gauge to count the contents.

The expected result is a store that grows by adding blocks, not by adding chests. The next step is the part that feeds it without a player. [Material routing](machines.logistics.md) covers belts, arms and packages.
storage.bulk.zh_cn:
## 储物仓容量是方块数乘二十

<ItemLink id="create:item_vault" /> 以相连方块的形式储存物品。本包把储物仓设为每格 20 组，因此容量取决于形状里的方块数，而不是你看到的那一面。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/item_vault" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:item_vault" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:item_silo" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inventory_access_port" /></ItemGrid>

| 形状 | 方块数 | 可存组数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 单格储物仓 | 1 | 20 |
| 两格储物仓 | 2 | 40 |
| 三乘三一面 | 9 | 180 |

储物仓只通过自己的面和贴着面的漏斗或滑槽连接。它不是箱子，没有可以整理的可视格界面。要用库存链接或显示链接去读它。

***

## 适合墙面的形状

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:shipping_container" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_item_vault" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_shipping_container" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:fluid_vessel" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:basic_shipping_container" /><ItemIcon id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_basic_shipping_container" /></ItemGrid>

| 方块 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:item_silo" /> | 用于高层空间的竖向储物仓 |
| <ItemLink id="create_vibrant_vaults:shipping_container" /> | 看着像集装箱堆场的宽储存 |
| <ItemLink id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_item_vault" /> | 窄房间用的高储存 |
| <ItemLink id="create_vibrant_vaults:vertical_shipping_container" /> | 竖向集装箱变体 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:fluid_vessel" /> | 横向流体罐 |

Vibrant Vaults 为每个家族加入彩色与染色版本。颜色是标签，不改变容量，同样形状的红色储物仓与蓝色储物仓存的一样多。

流体容器是横向储罐，可以改成锅炉但效率较低。它的窗口形状可用扳手切换，在把它埋进墙里之前值得先调好。

***

## 够到看不见的那一面

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inventory_access_port" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inventory_bridge" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inventory_access_port" /> | 在狭窄位置给容器增加一个可用面 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inventory_bridge" /> | 把两个容器作为一个连接暴露，过滤器仍然有效 |
| <ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> | 从指定面取出过滤后的物品 |
| <ItemLink id="create:stock_link" /> | 让储物仓对库存网络可见 |

改变布局的是桥接器。通过它抽取物品时过滤器有效，因此一整面储物仓可以只露出一个整齐的出口，而不会把里面的东西全部漏出去。

这两个部件都不增加容量。装了三个接入口的储物仓，装的还是原来那么多。

***

## 放下第一只储物仓

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:item_vault" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /></ItemGrid>

1. 做一只 <ItemLink id="create:item_vault" />，贴放在它服务的房间墙边。
2. 在传送带够得到的那一面装漏斗或滑槽。
3. 贴着第一格再加一格，确认两格被读作同一处储存。
4. 若要让工厂仪表统计内容，装上库存链接。

要看到的结果是储存靠增加方块而增长，而不是靠增加箱子。下一步是不用玩家也能喂满它。[物料输送](machines.logistics.md)说明传送带、机械臂与包裹。

storage.handling.en_us:
## The inventory itself is the interface

Most storage time is lost in the screens, not in the containers. This pack installs three interface mods that remove the repeated drag and click work.

Open any supported container and use its search field and sort button. Sophisticated Inventory Interactions adds search, player inventory sorting, container sorting and transfer controls to supported screens.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:chest" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:hopper" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| Screen action | What it saves |
| --- | --- |
| Search field | Scrolling a full chest for one item |
| Sort button | Manual arrangement after every dump |
| Transfer controls | Shift clicking one stack at a time |
| Mouse wheel over a slot | Dragging a stack by hand |

Mouse Tweaks handles the drag and wheel side. It is a convenience mod, so the exact gesture is worth checking once in the controls screen rather than assuming it matches another pack.

***

## What gets picked up

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="interactic:item_filter" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:hopper" /></ItemGrid>

| Setting | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Filter contents | Items that may be collected |
| Pickup rules | Whether the filter decides what enters your inventory |
| Rendering rules | Whether filtered drops are drawn differently |

Interactic Renewed separates pickup from rendering, so a filter can hide clutter from view without changing what you actually collect. Set it before a mining trip, not after your inventory is full of stone.

The mod is also what makes dropped items easier to see and grab. A filter that hides an item from rendering does not stop you collecting it.

***

## The trash slot is not storage

| Setting in this pack | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Instant deletion | Off, so items wait in the slot |
| Delete while slot is hidden | Off |
| Deny list | Empty, so nothing is protected by default |
| Hints | On |

Instant deletion being off is the setting that matters. An item in the trash slot is not gone until the slot is cleared, which gives you one chance to take it back. Turning instant deletion on removes that chance for every item at once.

The deny list is empty, so TrashSlot protects nothing on its own. If a valuable item keeps ending up there, add it to the deny list rather than relying on care.

Current bindings for the carry key and the handbook are in [Controls](help.controls.md).
storage.handling.zh_cn:
## 物品栏本身就是界面

储存的时间大多耗在界面上，而不是容器里。本包装了三个界面模组，去掉重复的拖拽与点击。

打开任何受支持的容器，使用它的搜索栏与排序按钮。Sophisticated Inventory Interactions 在受支持的界面里加入搜索、玩家物品栏排序、容器排序与转移控制。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:chest" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:hopper" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:shulker_box" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| 界面操作 | 省掉什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 搜索栏 | 在一整箱里翻找一件物品 |
| 排序按钮 | 每次倒完东西后手动整理 |
| 转移控制 | 一叠一叠地按住 Shift 点击 |
| 在格子上滚动鼠标滚轮 | 手动拖动一叠物品 |

鼠标滚轮与拖拽由 Mouse Tweaks 处理。它是便利模组，具体手势值得在控制界面里确认一次，而不是假定与别的整合包相同。

***

## 什么会被捡起

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="interactic:item_filter" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:hopper" /></ItemGrid>

| 设置 | 影响 |
| --- | --- |
| 过滤器内容 | 允许被收集的物品 |
| 拾取规则 | 过滤器是否决定进入物品栏的东西 |
| 渲染规则 | 被过滤的掉落是否以不同方式显示 |

Interactic Renewed 把拾取与渲染分开，因此过滤器可以把杂物从视野里隐藏，而不改变你实际收集的东西。下矿前就设好，别等物品栏塞满石头再设。

让掉落物更容易看清与拾取的也是这个模组。把某件物品从渲染里隐藏，不会阻止你捡起它。

***

## 垃圾桶不是储存

| 本包设置 | 取值 |
| --- | --- |
| 即时删除 | 关闭，物品会留在格子里 |
| 隐藏时仍可删除 | 关闭 |
| 禁止删除清单 | 为空，默认不保护任何物品 |
| 提示 | 开启 |

TrashSlot 给物品栏界面增加一个格子，并不新增物品。真正重要的是即时删除关闭。格子里的物品在被清空之前都还在，你因此有一次取回的机会。打开即时删除，等于对所有物品一次取消这次机会。

禁止删除清单为空，所以 TrashSlot 本身不保护任何东西。如果贵重物品总是掉进去，把它加进清单，而不是靠小心。

搬运按键与手册的当前绑定见[操作与按键](help.controls.md)。

machines.rotation.en_us:
## Stress before speed

Every rotating network has a capacity from its generators and an impact from its machines. While impact stays under capacity the whole network turns. The moment impact exceeds capacity the network stops and nothing on it works.

This pack keeps the stress mechanic on, so the first question at any machine is not how fast it should spin but whether the network can carry it.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:water_wheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:large_water_wheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:windmill_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="create:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| Source | Capacity | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> | 32 stress units | Cheapest steady source |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_water_wheel" /> | 128 stress units | Four times the wheel, same footprint height |
| <ItemLink id="create:windmill_bearing" /> | 512 stress units | Needs a sail assembly above it |
| <ItemLink id="create:steam_engine" /> | 1024 stress units | Needs a boiler and water supply |

The pack leaves the global speed limit at 256 revolutions per minute. Impact grows with speed, and the configuration states that a machine's cost doubles for every speed increase it receives, so gearing a line faster buys throughput at the price of capacity.

***

## Turning and reversing

A <ItemLink id="create:shaft" /> passes rotation straight through. A <ItemLink id="create:cogwheel" /> changes the axis by a quarter turn. A <ItemLink id="create:gearbox" /> splits one input into four directions.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:shaft" /><ItemIcon id="create:cogwheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:large_cogwheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:gearbox" /><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:shaft" /> | Nothing, same axis and speed |
| <ItemLink id="create:cogwheel" /> with a second cogwheel | Direction of the second axis reverses |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_cogwheel" /> meshed with a small one | Speed changes by the size ratio, direction reverses |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearbox" /> | Four faces, opposite faces turn the same way |

Create: Connected fills the gaps in that set. Each part answers a different routing problem.

| Part | Difference |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:cross_connector" /> | Relays rotation in two directions without them meeting |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:parallel_gearbox" /> | All four faces turn the same way |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:six_way_gearbox" /> | Shafts on all six sides, top and bottom at half speed |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brass_gearbox" /> | Each face configured independently with a wrench |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:encased_chain_cogwheel" /> | A chain drive that also takes a cogwheel |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:crank_wheel" /> | A hand crank with a cogwheel for tight gear ratios |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | Passes capacity between two networks without joining them |

Rotation direction is not cosmetic. Two networks only merge when they meet turning the same way. If a join reverses, the connecting part breaks, so check direction with the wrench before you power a new branch.

A windmill needs at least eight sails to assemble. Each additional eight sails above that adds one revolution per minute, so a modest sail disc is the normal build rather than a huge one.

***

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/wrench" />
## Controls that keep a line safe

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create:gearshift" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:shear_pin" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:brake" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:centrifugal_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:freewheel_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_gearshift" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Use |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:clutch" /> | Redstone cuts the branch without stopping the source |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearshift" /> | Redstone reverses the branch |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:shear_pin" /> | Single use connector that breaks instead of stalling the whole network |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /> | Uncoupled after a delay when the network is overstressed, reset with a wrench |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brake" /> | Stops the network by overstressing it on purpose |

A clutch belongs on any branch you want to switch off while the source keeps running. A shear pin belongs on a branch you would rather lose than stall.

***

## First drive line

Two <ItemLink id="create:andesite_alloy" /> make eight <ItemLink id="create:shaft" />. That ratio is why short shaft runs are cheap and long ones are not.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/shaft" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/water_wheel" />

1. Place the <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> against flowing water so its paddles are pushed.
2. Run a shaft from the wheel to the machine you want to drive.
3. Fit a <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" /> on the line and read capacity against impact.
4. Watch the machine turn for a full cycle before adding a second one.

The expected result is a machine that runs without stopping and a stressometer that does not sit above capacity. The next useful step is a reserve so a short interruption does not stop production. [Stored rotation](power.stored-rotation.md) covers batteries and springs.

## Reading the numbers

Engineer's goggles show the stress a component is carrying and the speed it is running at, so a stalled machine reads as a number instead of a guess. The speedometer and the stressometer measure one component each and convert into each other, which is how you compare a drive line before and after a change.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:goggles" /><ItemIcon id="create:speedometer" /><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /></ItemGrid>
machines.rotation.zh_cn:
## 先看应力，再看转速

每个旋转网络都有来自动力源的容量，也有来自机器的应力消耗。消耗低于容量时整个网络都在转。消耗超过容量的一刻，网络停转，上面所有东西都不工作。

本包保留应力机制，所以面对一台机器时，第一个问题不是它该转多快，而是网络带不带得动它。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:water_wheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:large_water_wheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:windmill_bearing" /><ItemIcon id="create:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| 动力源 | 容量 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> | 32 点应力 | 最便宜的稳定来源 |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_water_wheel" /> | 128 点应力 | 四倍于小水车，高度相同 |
| <ItemLink id="create:windmill_bearing" /> | 512 点应力 | 上方需要组装风帆 |
| <ItemLink id="create:steam_engine" /> | 1024 点应力 | 需要锅炉与供水 |

本包把全局转速上限留在每分钟 256 转。应力消耗随转速上升，配置说明每提升一档转速，机器的消耗翻倍，因此让一条线转得更快，是用容量换产量。

***

## 转向与换向

<ItemLink id="create:shaft" /> 把旋转原样传过去。<ItemLink id="create:cogwheel" /> 让轴转四分之一圈改变方向。<ItemLink id="create:gearbox" /> 把一个输入分成四个方向。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:shaft" /><ItemIcon id="create:cogwheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:large_cogwheel" /><ItemIcon id="create:gearbox" /><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 改变什么 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:shaft" /> | 不改变，同轴同速 |
| <ItemLink id="create:cogwheel" /> 与第二只齿轮啮合 | 第二根轴反向 |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_cogwheel" /> 与小齿轮啮合 | 按尺寸比例改变转速，方向相反 |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearbox" /> | 四个面，相对两面同向 |

Create: Connected 补上了这套部件的空缺。每个部件解决不同的走线问题。

| 部件 | 区别 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:cross_connector" /> | 两个方向各自传递，互不干扰 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:parallel_gearbox" /> | 四个面同向 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:six_way_gearbox" /> | 六面都有轴，上下两面为半速 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brass_gearbox" /> | 每个面的方向可单独用扳手配置 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:encased_chain_cogwheel" /> | 链条传动上再加一只齿轮 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:crank_wheel" /> | 带齿轮的手摇曲柄，用于紧凑的齿轮比 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | 在两个不合并的网络之间传递容量 |

旋转方向不是外观问题。两个网络只有在同向相接时才会合并。接上后如果反向，连接部件会断裂，所以在给新支线供能前用扳手确认方向。

风车至少需要八片风帆才能组装。之后每多八片风帆增加每分钟一转，因此普通风帆盘就是正常做法，不必做巨大的盘面。

***

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/wrench" />
## 让线路可控的部件

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create:gearshift" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:shear_pin" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:brake" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:centrifugal_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:freewheel_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_clutch" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_gearshift" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:clutch" /> | 红石切断支线，动力源继续转 |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearshift" /> | 红石让支线反向 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:shear_pin" /> | 一次性连接件，超载时断开而不是拖停全网 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /> | 网络超载后延时脱开，用扳手复位 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brake" /> | 故意让网络超载来刹车 |

需要关掉而动力源继续转的支线，用离合器。宁可断开也不愿拖停全网的支线，用剪切销。

***

## 第一条传动线

两块 <ItemLink id="create:andesite_alloy" /> 做八根 <ItemLink id="create:shaft" />。这个比例正是短距离便宜、长距离昂贵的原因。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/shaft" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/water_wheel" />

1. 把 <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> 放在流动的水边，让水流推动桨叶。
2. 从水车接轴到要驱动的机器。
3. 在线上装一只 <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" />，对照容量与消耗。
4. 先看机器完整运行一个周期，再增加第二台。

要看到的结果是机器连续运转，应力表不高于容量。下一步值得做的是储备，让短暂中断不至于停掉生产。[旋转储备](power.stored-rotation.md)说明蓄电池与弹簧。

## 读数字

工程师护目镜会显示部件当前承受的应力和转速，卡住的机器会显示成具体数字而不是靠猜。速度表和应力表各测量单个部件，并且可以互相转换，改动前后用它们对比同一条传动线最直接。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:goggles" /><ItemIcon id="create:speedometer" /><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /></ItemGrid>

machines.logistics.en_us:
## One clean line

A belt carries items between a container and a machine. An <ItemLink id="create:andesite_funnel" /> picks items up from the container and drops them onto the belt, and a second funnel at the far end moves them into the machine.

Start with one input container, one belt and one funnel. Get that running before you plan a factory.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/logistics/andesite_funnel" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /><ItemIcon id="create:andesite_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:chute" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Limit in this pack |
| --- | --- |
| Mechanical belt | 20 blocks maximum length |
| Andesite funnel | Extracts once every 8 game ticks |
| Brass funnel | Same rate, with filtering and a count |
| Chute | Vertical drop, no rotation needed |

The expected result is items moving without anyone opening a chest. If the belt moves but nothing arrives, the funnel is facing the wrong way, since one side extracts and the other inserts.

***

## Filters decide what moves

A <ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> takes a filter in its settings and moves only matching items. A <ItemLink id="create:brass_tunnel" /> splits one stream across several outputs according to its filters.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_tunnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_arm" /><ItemIcon id="create:smart_fluid_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Useful fact |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> | Filter plus a requested count, so a machine gets exactly its input |
| <ItemLink id="create:brass_tunnel" /> | Distributes every 10 game ticks |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_arm" /> | Reaches 5 blocks and serves several inputs and outputs from one point |
| <ItemLink id="create:smart_fluid_pipe" /> | Filters fluids the same way a brass funnel filters items |

A mechanical arm is the answer when one machine needs three ingredients and produces two outputs in a tight space. It has a fixed reach of 5 blocks in this pack, so lay the machines out around it rather than stretching the arm.

***

## Packages move stock, not items

Create 6 packaging turns loose items into addressed packages. A <ItemLink id="create:packager" /> packs, a <ItemLink id="create:stock_link" /> reads a container as stock, and a <ItemLink id="create:package_frogport" /> receives a package at the far end.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:packager" /><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /><ItemIcon id="create:package_frogport" /><ItemIcon id="create:redstone_requester" /><ItemIcon id="create:chain_conveyor" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:packager" /> | Turns a container of items into a package |
| <ItemLink id="create:stock_link" /> | Exposes a container to the stock network |
| <ItemLink id="create:package_frogport" /> | Accepts packages addressed to its address |
| <ItemLink id="create:chain_conveyor" /> | Carries 20 packages, up to 32 blocks, with 4 connections |
| <ItemLink id="create:redstone_requester" /> | Requests stock without a factory gauge |

Two settings from Additional Logistics matter once a factory gauge exists. Promise Limits caps how many open promises one gauge may hold, which stops a slow line from being flooded with ingredient packages. Additional Stock lets a restocker request extra above its target instead of topping up by one item at a time.

The mod also supplies a cash register. This pack disables stock tickers in its server configuration, so treat the register as shop furniture rather than a stock market.

| Additional part | Difference |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:package_accelerator" /> | Speeds the packager, at a stress cost |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:package_editor" /> | Rewrites package addresses by rule |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:cash_register" /> | Records shop sales in a ledger |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:sales_ledger" /> | The ledger the register writes to |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:lazy_shaft" /> | Cheaper over runs longer than two blocks |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:lazy_cogwheel" /> | The same saving on a cogwheel |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:flexible_shaft" /> | Wrench set connections on individual sides |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brass_chute" /> | A chute with brass filtering |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:network_monitor" /> | Train network readout, a computer integration rather than a stock screen |

***

## Fluids follow the same rules

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create:hose_pulley" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Limit in this pack |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_pump" /> | Pushes or pulls 16 blocks on either side |
| <ItemLink id="create:fluid_tank" /> | 8 buckets per block, up to 32 blocks tall |
| <ItemLink id="create:hose_pulley" /> | Reaches 128 blocks of fluid |
| Hose pulley on a large body | A body of 10000 or more source blocks counts as infinite |

The hose pulley is how a lava lake becomes a factory input. Below that 10000 block threshold it simply drains what it finds, so a small pond will empty and stay empty.

The next useful step is storage that a line can fill and empty without a player. [Bulk storage](storage.bulk.md) covers vaults and silos.
machines.logistics.zh_cn:
## 先做一条干净的线

传送带在容器与机器之间搬运物品。<ItemLink id="create:andesite_funnel" /> 从容器取出物品放到带上，另一端的漏斗把它送进机器。

先做一个输入容器、一条传送带、一只漏斗。它跑起来之后再去规划工厂。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/logistics/andesite_funnel" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /><ItemIcon id="create:andesite_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:chute" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 本包限制 |
| --- | --- |
| 机械传送带 | 最长 20 格 |
| 安山漏斗 | 每 8 游戏刻取出一次 |
| 黄铜漏斗 | 速率相同，可过滤并指定数量 |
| 滑槽 | 垂直下落，不需要旋转 |

要看到的结果是无人开箱也有物品在移动。如果带在动却没有东西送到，通常是漏斗方向装反了，一面取出，另一面送入。

***

## 过滤器决定什么能走

<ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> 在设置里放过滤器，只搬运匹配的物品。<ItemLink id="create:brass_tunnel" /> 按过滤器把一路物品分到多个出口。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_tunnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_arm" /><ItemIcon id="create:smart_fluid_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 有用的事实 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> | 过滤器加指定数量，机器正好拿到该拿的份数 |
| <ItemLink id="create:brass_tunnel" /> | 每 10 游戏刻分配一次 |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_arm" /> | 触及 5 格，一个点服务多个输入与输出 |
| <ItemLink id="create:smart_fluid_pipe" /> | 像黄铜漏斗过滤物品那样过滤流体 |

一台机器要三种原料、出两种产物、空间又紧时，机械臂就是答案。本包里它的触及固定为 5 格，因此要围绕它摆机器，而不是硬拉长手臂。

***

## 包裹搬运的是库存

Create 6 的包裹系统把散装物品变成写着地址的包裹。<ItemLink id="create:packager" /> 打包，<ItemLink id="create:stock_link" /> 把容器当作库存读取，<ItemLink id="create:package_frogport" /> 在另一端收包裹。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:packager" /><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /><ItemIcon id="create:package_frogport" /><ItemIcon id="create:redstone_requester" /><ItemIcon id="create:chain_conveyor" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:packager" /> | 把一箱物品打成包裹 |
| <ItemLink id="create:stock_link" /> | 把容器接入库存网络 |
| <ItemLink id="create:package_frogport" /> | 接收寄到它地址的包裹 |
| <ItemLink id="create:chain_conveyor" /> | 运送 20 个包裹，最长 32 格，可有 4 个连接 |
| <ItemLink id="create:redstone_requester" /> | 不用工厂仪表也能请求库存 |

有了工厂仪表之后，Additional Logistics 的两项设置很关键。承诺上限限制一只仪表同时持有的未完成请求，避免慢线被原料包裹淹没。额外库存让补货仪表在低于目标时多订一批，而不是一次只补一件。

该模组还提供收银机。本包在服务端配置里关闭了股票行情，因此把收银机当作店铺摆设，而不是交易行情工具。

| 附加部件 | 区别 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:package_accelerator" /> | 加快打包机，代价是应力 |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:package_editor" /> | 按规则改写包裹地址 |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:cash_register" /> | 把店铺销售记入账本 |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:sales_ledger" /> | 收银机写入的账本 |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:lazy_shaft" /> | 超过两格的连线更省材料 |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:lazy_cogwheel" /> | 齿轮上的同样节省 |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:flexible_shaft" /> | 用扳手逐面设置连接 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brass_chute" /> | 带黄铜过滤的滑槽 |
| <ItemLink id="createadditionallogistics:network_monitor" /> | 列车网络读数，属于计算机联动而非库存界面 |

***

## 流体遵循同样的规则

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create:hose_pulley" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 本包限制 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_pump" /> | 两侧各推或抽 16 格 |
| <ItemLink id="create:fluid_tank" /> | 每格 8 桶，最高 32 格 |
| <ItemLink id="create:hose_pulley" /> | 触及 128 格流体 |
| 软管滑轮与大水体 | 一万格以上水源视为无限 |

让熔岩湖变成工厂原料的就是软管滑轮。低于一万格的阈值时，它只会抽干眼前的水体，小池塘抽完就空了。

下一步值得做的是让产线自己装满、自己取空的储存。[大宗储存](storage.bulk.md)说明储物仓与筒仓。

machines.renewables.en_us:
## Vents are under water here

A molten vent is a renewable source of Create orestone. In this pack the land vents are switched off and the underwater vents are switched on, so the surface search is a waste of time. Look along the seabed.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:dormant_molten_asurine" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_veridium" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_crimsite" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scorchia" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scoria" /></ItemGrid>

| Block | State |
| --- | --- |
| Dormant vent block | Found inside the vent shell, inert |
| Active vent block | Produces its stone when lava lands on it |
| Orestone | The building and crushing material the vent makes |

Six families exist, Asurine, Veridium, Crimsite, Ochrum, Scorchia and Scoria. Each has a dormant and an active form. The block you want is the one with magma on it, not the plain orestone around it.

***

## Wake a vent in three steps

1. Clear the blocks inside the vent until you reach the block that matches the surrounding orestone but carries magma.
2. Break that dormant core with an explosion. A single block of dynamite or a charged creeper is enough to set it off.
3. Watch the magma brighten. That block is now active.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:tnt" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| Step | Failure to expect | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Explosion does nothing | Wrong block | The plain orestone looks similar, the core has magma |
| Vent stays dark | Explosion too far | The blast must touch the core block |
| Lava sits on top | Vent still dormant | Activation happens before any lava |

Do this in open water with room to swim. The vent is under the sea in this pack, so bring a way to breathe and a light source.

***

## Lava in, stone out

Lava dropped onto an active vent turns into the vent's orestone. The lava is consumed and replaced by stone, which makes the vent a converter rather than a generator.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="create:hose_pulley" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

| Supply method | When it fits |
| --- | --- |
| Buckets by hand | Proving the vent works, a few stacks at a time |
| <ItemLink id="create:hose_pulley" /> on a lava lake | The lake is large enough to count as infinite |
| Pumped from a tank | You already move lava for fuel or casting |

The hose pulley treats a body of 10000 or more source blocks as infinite in this pack, so a lava lake under the world is worth more than a lava pool in a cave. The pulley also reaches 128 blocks, which is usually enough to stand it above the vent and let stone collect below.

The vent produces stone that then follows the normal ore route. [Ore processing](machines.ore-processing.md) covers crushing and washing it, and [Material routing](machines.logistics.md) covers the belts that carry it away.
machines.renewables.zh_cn:
## 本包的喷口在水下

熔岩喷口是可再生的 Create 矿石岩来源。本包关闭了陆地喷口，只开启水下喷口，因此在陆地上找是白费力气。沿海床寻找。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:dormant_molten_asurine" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_veridium" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_crimsite" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scorchia" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scoria" /></ItemGrid>

| 方块 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 休眠喷口方块 | 在喷口外壳内部，尚未激活 |
| 激活喷口方块 | 熔岩落上去时产出对应石材 |
| 矿石岩 | 喷口产出的建筑与粉碎材料 |

共有六个家族，蔚蓝岩、辉绿岩、绯红岩、赭金岩、焦黑岩与焦岩。每个家族都有休眠与激活形态。要找的是带岩浆的那一块，而不是周围普通的矿石岩。

***

## 三步唤醒喷口

1. 挖开喷口内部的方块，直到找到与周围矿石岩相同、但表面带岩浆的那一块。
2. 用爆炸破坏这块休眠核心。一块炸药或一只充能苦力怕就足以引爆。
3. 看岩浆变亮。这一块此时已经激活。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:tnt" /><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| 步骤 | 可能遇到的情况 | 原因 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 爆炸没有反应 | 打错了方块 | 普通矿石岩外观相似，核心带岩浆 |
| 喷口仍然发暗 | 爆炸距离太远 | 爆炸必须触及核心方块 |
| 熔岩停在表面 | 喷口仍在休眠 | 必须先激活再倒熔岩 |

在开阔水域操作，留出走位空间。本包的喷口在海里，所以要带呼吸手段和光源。

***

## 熔岩进去，石材出来

倒在激活喷口上的熔岩会变成该喷口的矿石岩。熔岩被消耗并替换成石头，因此喷口是转换器，不是发生器。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="create:hose_pulley" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

| 供料方式 | 适用场合 |
| --- | --- |
| 手提水桶 | 验证喷口，一次几组 |
| 熔岩湖上的 <ItemLink id="create:hose_pulley" /> | 湖体足够大，可视为无限 |
| 从储罐抽取 | 已经在为燃料或浇铸搬运熔岩 |

本包里软管滑轮把一万格以上的水体视为无限，因此地下的熔岩湖比洞穴里的一小池熔岩更值钱。滑轮触及 128 格，通常足以架在喷口上方，让石头落向下方收集。

喷口产出的石头走正常矿物路线。[矿物加工](machines.ore-processing.md)说明如何粉碎与洗涤，[物料输送](machines.logistics.md)说明把它运走的传送带。

machines.enchanting.en_us:
## Turn experience into a liquid

Create: Enchantment Industry stores experience as a fluid, which is the piece that makes enchanting automatable. The conversion happens at a <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /> placed over an <ItemLink id="create:item_drain" />.

<EmiSearch query="@create_enchantment_industry" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" /><ItemIcon id="create:item_drain" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_hatch" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_lantern" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Job |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /> | Grinds items and also sands them, and releases experience |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" /> | The drain variant that collects that release |
| <ItemLink id="create:item_drain" /> | Collects the released experience as fluid |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_hatch" /> | Lets you put your own experience into a tank or take it back |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_lantern" /> | Absorbs experience nearby and works while mounted on a contraption |

<Recipe id="create_enchantment_industry:crafting/mechanical_grindstone" />

The first action is to grind one enchanted or damaged item over the drain and watch the tank fill. If nothing appears, the grindstone is not turning, or the drain has no fluid tank to push into.

***

## Enchant, forge and copy

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_enchanter" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_forger" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:printer" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:enchanting_template" /></ItemGrid>

| Machine | Publisher description |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_enchanter" /> | A blaze acting as a smart enchanting table |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_forger" /> | A blaze acting as a smart anvil for repairing and combining |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:printer" /> | Copies written books, enchanted books, name tags and train schedules |

The printer is the machine that changes how a base operates. One good enchanted book becomes a stack of copies for the price of liquid experience, so a single lucky find can equip a whole workshop.

Read the block's own help entry before automating it. The enchanter and forger both take equipment and liquid experience, and the exact slots are specific enough that a screenshot would age badly.

***

## Repair on the line

An item with Mending can be repaired by a spout filled with liquid experience, which means a belt can repair gear as it passes.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:spout" /><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:enchanted_book" /></ItemGrid>

| Setup | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Spout over a belt, liquid experience in the tank | Passing Mending items lose damage |
| Experience hatch at a tank | You deposit or withdraw your own levels |
| Deployer kills and crushing wheel kills | Drop experience nuggets in this mod |

The repair route is worth building once you carry gear you would rather not replace. A short belt with a spout and a tank beside your main workshop removes most trips to an anvil. The anvil and the name tag still do manual work, since Easy Anvils changes their interface rather than making them powered machines.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:anvil" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:name_tag" /></ItemGrid>

***

## What this pack leaves out

This pack does not install Apothic Enchanting or Apotheosis, so the integration blocks those mods add are not part of the catalog here.

| Integration block | Needs |
| --- | --- |
| Brass Bookshelf, Infuser | Apothic Enchanting |
| Blaze Composer, Affix Augmentor, Gem Cutter | Apotheosis |

Plan around the grindstone, enchanter, forger, printer and experience storage. Those are the machines that exist.

Next step is power for the grindstone. [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) covers the drive line.
machines.enchanting.zh_cn:
## 把经验变成液体

Create: Enchantment Industry 把经验存成流体，这正是附魔能自动化的关键。转换发生在放在 <ItemLink id="create:item_drain" /> 上方的 <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" />。

<EmiSearch query="@create_enchantment_industry" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" /><ItemIcon id="create:item_drain" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_hatch" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_lantern" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /> | 磨制物品，也能打磨，并释放经验 |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" /> | 收集这些释放物的排液变体 |
| <ItemLink id="create:item_drain" /> | 把释放的经验收集为流体 |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_hatch" /> | 让你把自己的经验存入储罐或取回 |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_lantern" /> | 吸收附近经验，装在移动结构上也能工作 |

<Recipe id="create_enchantment_industry:crafting/mechanical_grindstone" />

第一步是在排除口上方磨掉一件附魔或受损物品，看储罐被填满。如果什么也没有，要么磨石没在转，要么排液口没有可推入的储罐。

***

## 附魔、锻造与复制

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_enchanter" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_forger" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:printer" /><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:enchanting_template" /></ItemGrid>

| 机器 | 发行方描述 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_enchanter" /> | 由烈焰人充当智能附魔台 |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_forger" /> | 由烈焰人充当智能铁砧，用于修理与合并 |
| <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:printer" /> | 复制成书、附魔书、命名牌与列车时刻表 |

改变基地运作方式的是打印机。一本好附魔书可以用液体经验换成一整叠副本，一次幸运的收获就能装备整个工坊。

自动化之前先读方块自带的帮助条目。附魔台与锻造台都要放入装备与液体经验，槽位细节具体，截图很快就会过时。

***

## 在线上修理

带经验修补的物品可以用装满液体经验的注液器修理，因此一条传送带经过就能修复装备。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:spout" /><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:enchanted_book" /></ItemGrid>

| 布置 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 传送带上方的注液器，储罐装液体经验 | 经过的经验修补物品减少损伤 |
| 储罐旁的存取口 | 存入或取回自己的等级 |
| 发射器击杀与粉碎轮击杀 | 本模组下会掉落经验颗粒 |

当你带着不想替换的装备时，修理线就值得建。主工坊旁一条短带、一个注液器、一只储罐，能省掉大部分跑铁砧的路。铁砧与命名牌仍然是手动工具，Easy Anvils 改的是它们的界面，并没有把它们变成动力机器。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:anvil" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:name_tag" /></ItemGrid>

***

## 本包没有的内容

本包没有安装 Apothic Enchanting 与 Apotheosis，因此这两个模组带来的联动方块不在这里的目录中。

| 联动方块 | 需要 |
| --- | --- |
| 黄铜书架、注入器 | Apothic Enchanting |
| 烈焰作曲器、词缀增幅器、宝石切割器 | Apotheosis |

按磨石、附魔台、锻造台、打印机与经验储存来规划。存在的机器就是这些。

下一步是给磨石供能。[旋转动力](machines.rotation.md)说明传动线。

machines.trading.en_us:
## A depot at a workstation

A <ItemLink id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /> turns one villager trade into a machine input and output. The villager still owns the trade list. The depot only hands over what the trade wants and takes what it gives.

Place the depot against a workstation a villager has claimed, not against the villager.

<Recipe id="trading_floor:trading_depot" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lectern" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:emerald" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | What it supplies |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /> | The machine interface for one trade |
| The claimed workstation | Ties the depot to one villager |
| The villager | Owns the trade list, prices and restock |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:emerald" /> | The common currency, still paid by you |

Trades happen while the villager is working. A villager who cannot reach its workstation, or who is asleep, does not trade, and the depot will sit with its input inside.

***

## What a working depot does

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_arm" /><ItemIcon id="create:display_link" /></ItemGrid>

| Result | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Trades per work session | Up to 4 in this pack |
| Villager experience | Earned by the villager, on by default |
| Player experience | Off by default in this pack |
| Readout | Goggles and display links show the trade state |

The four trades per session is a pack setting, not a limit of the mod's design. It is enough to make an iron farm or a book trade worth automating, and low enough that a single depot will not fund a base on its own.

***

## Two depots, two inputs

A trade that costs two different items needs two depots, each with its own input. Their filters must match, or one of them must be left empty.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:chute" /></ItemGrid>

| Arrangement | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| One depot, one input | Handles a single item trade |
| Two depots, matching filters | Both feed the same trade |
| Two depots, one filter empty | The empty one accepts anything |
| Two depots, different filters | The trade will not complete |

Feed each depot with a <ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> set to the exact item. A filter that accepts a substitute item breaks the trade silently, because the villager will not accept it.

The next useful step is moving the payment in and the result out without a player. [Material routing](machines.logistics.md) covers belts, funnels and arms.
machines.trading.zh_cn:
## 工作站旁的交易站

<ItemLink id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /> 把一笔村民交易变成一个机器的输入与输出。交易清单仍然属于村民。交易站只负责交付交易要的东西，并取走交易给出的东西。

把交易站贴放在村民已经认领的工作站上，而不是贴在村民身上。

<Recipe id="trading_floor:trading_depot" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lectern" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:emerald" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 提供什么 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /> | 单笔交易的机器接口 |
| 被认领的工作站 | 把交易站绑定到一位村民 |
| 村民 | 拥有交易清单、价格与补货 |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:emerald" /> | 通用货币，仍需你来支付 |

交易在村民工作时段进行。够不到工作站或正在睡觉的村民不会交易，交易站会带着里面的输入一直停着。

***

## 一个能用的交易站

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_arm" /><ItemIcon id="create:display_link" /></ItemGrid>

| 结果 | 细节 |
| --- | --- |
| 每个工作时段交易次数 | 本包最多 4 次 |
| 村民经验 | 归村民，默认开启 |
| 玩家经验 | 本包默认关闭 |
| 读数 | 护目镜与显示链接可显示交易状态 |

每时段四次是本包设置，不是模组设计的极限。它足以让铁农场或书籍交易值得自动化，也低到单靠一个交易站养不起整个基地。

***

## 两个交易站，两种输入

需要两种不同物品的交易要用两个交易站，各自带输入。两者的过滤器必须一致，或者其中一个留空。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /><ItemIcon id="create:chute" /></ItemGrid>

| 布置 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 一个交易站，一种输入 | 处理单物品交易 |
| 两个交易站，过滤器一致 | 两者共同供给同一笔交易 |
| 两个交易站，一个过滤器留空 | 留空的那个接受任何物品 |
| 两个交易站，过滤器不同 | 交易无法完成 |

用设为精确物品的 <ItemLink id="create:brass_funnel" /> 给每个交易站供料。接受替代物品的过滤器会让交易悄悄失败，因为村民不会收下那件替代品。

下一步是不靠玩家把付款送进去、把产物取出来。[物料输送](machines.logistics.md)说明传送带、漏斗与机械臂。

machines.miscellaneous.en_us:
## Tools that save the walk home

Create Stuff 'N Additions adds hand tools that run on rotation stored in the item rather than on a workstation. They are the reason a small base can mine and build without running a shaft everywhere.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:portable_drill" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:block_picker" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:grapplin_whisk" /></ItemGrid>

| Tool | What it replaces |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:portable_drill" /> | A pickaxe, and it breaks blocks at machine speed |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /> | Walking to pick up drops, it pulls them to you |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:block_picker" /> | Carrying a block around to place many of them |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:grapplin_whisk" /> | Climbing, it pulls you toward a surface |

Each tool holds its own charge and is refilled from a tank. The pack gives gadgets 1600 units of capacity, so one filling lasts a working session rather than a whole project.

***

## Tanks and portable engines

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:small_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:medium_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:large_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| Item | Capacity in this pack |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:small_filling_tank" /> | 800 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:medium_filling_tank" /> | 1600 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:large_filling_tank" /> | 3200 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:steam_engine" />, <ItemLink id="create_sa:hydraulic_engine" />, <ItemLink id="create_sa:heat_engine" /> | Portable steam, hydraulic and heat engines |

The filling tanks are the refill station for tools and jetpacks. Place one, fill it, and hold the tool against it. A large tank refills four small tanks worth of gadgets before it needs attention.

The portable steam engine in this mod is not Create's placed <ItemLink id="create:steam_engine" />. It is a handheld or mounted component for gadgets, and it does not feed a stress network.

***

## The drone

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:brass_drone_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:drone_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:fan_component" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:vault_component" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Job |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:brass_drone_item" /> | The drone itself, deployed from the item |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:drone_controller" /> | Sets where the drone flies and what it does |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:fan_component" /> | Pushes items or entities |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:vault_component" /> | Holds what the drone collects |

This pack enables the drill, fan, magnet and vault modules for drones. Three of those modules have their own items here, and the vault module is the one that makes a collection run worth flying.

Start with one drone, one module and a short route. A drone that does nothing is usually out of charge or outside the controller's set area.

***

## Shortcuts this pack adds

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:phantom_membrane" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:feather" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:brown_mushroom" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:red_mushroom" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:brown_mushroom_block" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:red_mushroom_block" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:prismarine_shard" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:blue_dye" /></ItemGrid>

| Shortcut | Input | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Haunting a feather | One feather | One phantom membrane |
| Compacting mushrooms | Four matching mushrooms | One mushroom block of that color |
| Blasting a shard | One prismarine shard | One blue dye |

<Recipe id="stam1ocreatetweaks:blasting/blue_dye" />

The feather recipe removes the need to wait for phantoms, which matters for anything that asks for membranes. The mushroom block recipe is the cheap way to store a harvest. The blue dye recipe turns ocean salvage into a dye without a flower farm.

Next step is power for the machines these tools support. [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) owns the drive line.
machines.miscellaneous.zh_cn:
## 省下跑回家的路的工具

Create Stuff 'N Additions 加入的手持工具靠物品内部储存的旋转工作，而不是靠工作站。小基地不必到处拉轴，原因就在这里。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:portable_drill" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:block_picker" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:grapplin_whisk" /></ItemGrid>

| 工具 | 替代什么 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:portable_drill" /> | 镐，并以机器速度破坏方块 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /> | 走过去捡掉落，它把掉落吸过来 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:block_picker" /> | 随身带着方块去连续放置 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:grapplin_whisk" /> | 攀爬，把你拉向表面 |

每件工具自带电量，从储罐补充。本包给装置 1600 点容量，一次加满够用一个工作时段，而不是整个工程。

***

## 储罐与便携引擎

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:small_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:medium_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:large_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| 物品 | 本包容量 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:small_filling_tank" /> | 800 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:medium_filling_tank" /> | 1600 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:large_filling_tank" /> | 3200 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:steam_engine" />、<ItemLink id="create_sa:hydraulic_engine" />、<ItemLink id="create_sa:heat_engine" /> | 便携蒸汽、液压与热能引擎 |

注液罐是工具与喷气背包的补给站。放一个、装满，把工具对着它按住使用。一只大罐能补满四只小罐当量的装置，才需要再管一次。

本模组的便携蒸汽引擎不是 Create 的已放置 <ItemLink id="create:steam_engine" />。它是给装置用的手持或安装部件，不向应力网络供能。

***

## 无人机

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:brass_drone_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:drone_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:fan_component" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:vault_component" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:brass_drone_item" /> | 无人机本体，从物品放出 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:drone_controller" /> | 设定无人机飞到哪里、做什么 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:fan_component" /> | 推动物品或实体 |
| <ItemLink id="create_sa:vault_component" /> | 收纳无人机捡到的物品 |

本包为无人机开启了钻头、风扇、磁铁与储物模块。其中三件有独立物品，储物模块是让一趟收集飞行值得做的那个。

先用一架无人机、一个模块、一段短路线。完全不动的时候，通常是没电，或者飞出了控制器设定的范围。

***

## 本包增加的捷径

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:phantom_membrane" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:feather" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:brown_mushroom" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:red_mushroom" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:brown_mushroom_block" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:red_mushroom_block" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:prismarine_shard" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:blue_dye" /></ItemGrid>

| 捷径 | 输入 | 产出 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 缠魂羽毛 | 一根羽毛 | 一片幻翼膜 |
| 压缩蘑菇 | 四个同种蘑菇 | 一个同色蘑菇方块 |
| 熔炼碎片 | 一个海晶碎片 | 一份蓝色染料 |

<Recipe id="stam1ocreatetweaks:blasting/blue_dye" />

羽毛配方省掉了等幻翼的时间，任何需要幻翼膜的东西都因此变便宜。蘑菇方块配方是储存收获的便宜办法。蓝色染料配方让海洋拾获直接变成染料，不必种花。

下一步是给这些工具所支持的机器供能。[旋转动力](machines.rotation.md)统一说明传动线。

power.electricity.en_us:
## Rotation becomes voltage

Create: Electro Energetics does not store a magical energy number. A source induces a voltage, a device lets current flow, and the current does the work. That is why a short circuit, a long thin wire and a badly matched transformer all change the result.

The alternator is the join between the two systems. Rotation turns it, and it produces current.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_rotor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:stator" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_brushes" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer_core" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Job |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:alternator_rotor" /> | The turning part of an alternator |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:stator" /> | The stationary winding around the rotor |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:alternator_brushes" /> | Carries current to the moving part, with a three phase variant in the same family |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /> | Stores charge for later draw |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /> | A small buffer that smooths a changing draw |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /> | The same role on a high voltage section |

Build the alternator on the same shaft line as your workshop. The Ponder entry for the alternator shows the assembled shape, and it is faster to follow that than to guess the block order.

***

## Wire a circuit in one direction

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:connector" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:copper_wire_spool" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:fuse" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Use |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:connector" /> | Termination point for a wire on a block |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:copper_wire_spool" /> | Lays wire between connectors |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /> | Wire for runs that need insulation |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse" /> with a fuse holder | Opens the circuit before a fault damages it |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse_holder" /> | Holds a fuse in the line |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /> | Reads the voltage at a point |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:clamp_meter" /> | Reads current through a wire without breaking the run |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /> | Reads the current through a point |

1. Place a connector on the alternator output and another on the machine.
2. Run a spool between them and watch the wire take the shape you drew.
3. Fit a fuse in its holder between source and load.
4. Read the voltmeter at the source, then at the load.

A voltage that falls between the two readings is the wire and the distance, not a broken machine. That is the difference between this and a fluid style power system, and the reason a meter is the first purchase rather than the last.

***

## Motors, pumps and heat

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:blue_electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:bulb" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /></ItemGrid>

| Consumer | Gives you |
| --- | --- |
| Electric motor | Rotation without a shaft line, in several colors |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /> | Fluid movement at a distance from the workshop |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:bulb" /> | Light and a visible sign that the circuit is live |
| Resistive heater | Heat for machines that want it |

A <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:transformer" /> changes voltage between sections, and a <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /> holds a section steady. Put the transformer where the wire length changes, not at every machine.

The mod also converts between its own electricity and Forge Energy devices through a dedicated converter block, which is how it feeds machines from other mods. It runs its simulation off the main thread and keeps working in unloaded chunks, so a long transmission line between two bases behaves the same whether or not you stand beside it.

***

## Electrified rail

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:pantograph" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:rail_contact_shoe" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:catenary_holder" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:catenary_holder" /> | Holds the overhead wire above the track |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:pantograph" /> | Collects current from overhead wire |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:rail_contact_shoe" /> | Collects current from a third rail |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /> | Cuts the section by hand |

Electrified rail is a separate project from a workshop circuit. Run the overhead line first, test the pantograph on one short section, then extend. [Railways](transport.passenger.md) covers the trains themselves.

The next useful step, once a circuit is stable, is moving the same work into an industrial process line. [Industrial machinery](power.industry.md) covers that separate system.
power.electricity.zh_cn:
## 旋转变成电压

Create: Electro Energetics 不储存一个抽象的能量数字。电源感应出电压，设备让电流通过，电流做功。短路、又长又细的导线、匹配不当的变压器，都会因此改变结果。

交流发电机是两套系统的接合点。旋转带动它，它产出电流。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_rotor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:stator" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_brushes" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:alternator_rotor" /> | 发电机中旋转的部分 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:stator" /> | 环绕转子的固定绕组 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:alternator_brushes" /> | 把电流送到旋转部分，另有同族的三相变体 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /> | 储存电荷供之后取用 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /> | 平滑波动负载的小缓冲 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /> | 高压区段上的同样角色 |

把发电机接在工坊同一条轴线上。发电机的思索条目展示组装形态，照着做比猜方块顺序快。

***

## 单向接一条电路

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:connector" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:copper_wire_spool" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:fuse" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:connector" /> | 导线在方块上的接线点 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:copper_wire_spool" /> | 在接线点之间铺设导线 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /> | 需要绝缘的线路 |
| 带底座的 <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse" /> | 在故障损坏线路前断开电路 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse_holder" /> | 把保险丝固定在线路中 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /> | 读取某点的电压 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:clamp_meter" /> | 不拆线就能读取导线中的电流 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /> | 读取通过某点的电流 |

1. 在发电机输出端与机器上各放一个接线点。
2. 用线轴在两点之间拉线，导线会按你画出的形状铺设。
3. 在电源与负载之间装上带底座的保险丝。
4. 先在电源端读电压表，再到负载端读一次。

两次读数之间的落差来自导线与距离，不是机器坏了。这正是它与流体式能源系统的区别，也是为什么电表该先买而不是最后买。

***

## 电机、泵与热

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:blue_electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:bulb" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer_core" /></ItemGrid>

| 用电设备 | 给你什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 电动机 | 不必拉轴就能得到旋转，有多种颜色 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /> | 在远离工坊的位置输送流体 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:bulb" /> | 照明，也是电路带电的可见信号 |
| 电阻加热器 | 为需要热的机器供热 |

<ItemLink id="electroenergetics:transformer" /> 在区段之间改变电压，<ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /> 让一个区段保持稳定。变压器装在导线长度变化的地方，而不是每台机器旁边都装。

模组还提供专门的转换方块，在本模组电力与其他模组的 Forge Energy 设备之间转换，这是它驱动外部机器的途径。它的模拟在主线程之外运行，在未加载的区块里也继续工作，因此两座基地之间的长输电线路，无论你站在哪一边表现都一样。

***

## 电气化铁路

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:pantograph" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:rail_contact_shoe" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:catenary_holder" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:catenary_holder" /> | 把接触网架在轨道上方 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:pantograph" /> | 从上方接触网取流 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:rail_contact_shoe" /> | 从第三轨取流 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /> | 手动切断该区段 |

电气化铁路是独立于工坊电路的另一件事。先架好接触网，在一小段上测试受电弓，再延伸。[铁路](transport.passenger.md)说明列车本身。

电路稳定之后，下一步是把同样的活交给工业产线。[工业机械](power.industry.md)说明那套独立系统。

power.industry.en_us:
## Coke before steel

Create: The Factory Must Grow starts with a coke oven, because steel needs coke and coke needs coal. The oven is a square multiblock, from one block up to six by six, and every oven block must face the same way.

<Recipe id="tfmg:crafting/materials/coke_oven" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coke_oven" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coal_coke" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:creosote_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:coal" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:casting_basin" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_mixer" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_chemical_vat" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:copper_cable_hub" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

| Rule | Why it matters |
| --- | --- |
| Square shape | Rectangles do not assemble |
| All blocks face one way | The output side is the marked face |
| Pump carbon dioxide from the top | It accumulates and blocks the process |
| Pump creosote from another side | It is a byproduct with its own use |

A larger square finishes a batch faster and produces less creosote per item, according to the official wiki. A small oven is the right first build, and a larger one is a throughput decision later.

***

## Steel needs hot air

The blast furnace turns iron into molten steel and silicon, and it will not run on fuel alone. It needs a supply of hot air for each process, so the air heater is part of the build rather than an upgrade.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_hatch" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_stove" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:fireproof_bricks" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:blast_furnace_output" /> | The output block, the face everything points at |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:blast_furnace_hatch" /> | Input and access point |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:blast_stove" /> | Supplies the hot air |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:fireproof_bricks" /> and reinforcement | The shell, and the speed upgrade |

The furnace consumes fuel on a fixed timer while it is running, and reinforcement blocks make each process faster. Build it beside the coke oven so coke arrives without a trip, and keep the hatch reachable for a funnel.

***

## Oil, distillation and engines

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:surface_scanner" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:pumpjack_base" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_controller" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:regular_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:large_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| Stage | Part |
| --- | --- |
| Find a deposit | <ItemLink id="tfmg:surface_scanner" /> reports oil under the chunk |
| Extract | <ItemLink id="tfmg:pumpjack_base" /> with pipes and a drive |
| Move it | <ItemLink id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" /> rather than a bucket line |
| Split it | <ItemLink id="tfmg:steel_distillation_controller" /> with outputs |
| Cast or mix | <ItemLink id="tfmg:casting_basin" />, <ItemLink id="tfmg:industrial_mixer" />, <ItemLink id="tfmg:steel_chemical_vat" /> |
| Burn it | <ItemLink id="tfmg:regular_engine" />, <ItemLink id="tfmg:simple_large_engine" />, <ItemLink id="tfmg:large_engine" />, <ItemLink id="tfmg:radial_engine" />, <ItemLink id="tfmg:turbine_engine" /> |

Engines are rotation sources, not generators of electricity. Each family has its own fuel appetite, and the large engines accept less refined fuel while asking for a steady air supply. Follow the pumpjack entry before laying the extraction route, because the pipe layout is easier to copy than to derive.

***

## Its own electrical grid

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:generator" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:heavy_electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:transformer" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:voltmeter" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:electricians_wrench" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Job |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:generator" /> | Produces electricity from rotation |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:electric_motor" /> | Turns electricity back into rotation |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:heavy_electric_motor" /> | The larger motor for heavy loads |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:transformer" /> | Moves between voltage groups |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:voltmeter" /> | Reads the industrial circuit |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:electricians_wrench" /> | Configures the industrial electrical parts |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:winding_machine" /> | Winds a spool around an input while rotation is supplied |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:freezer" /> and <ItemLink id="tfmg:compressor" /> | Cooling and compression stages |

This grid is not the Electro Energetics grid. The two mods model electricity differently and their parts do not plug into each other, so pick one for a given building and keep it there. [Electricity](power.electricity.md) covers the other system.

Next step is heat, because the coke oven and the blast furnace both burn something. [Burners and fuel](power.burners.md) covers the heat side.
power.industry.zh_cn:
## 先有焦炭，再有钢

Create: The Factory Must Grow 从焦炉开始，因为钢需要焦炭，焦炭需要煤。焦炉是方形多方块结构，从一格到六乘六格，所有炉块必须朝向同一面。

<Recipe id="tfmg:crafting/materials/coke_oven" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coke_oven" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coal_coke" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:creosote_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:coal" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:casting_basin" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_mixer" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_chemical_vat" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:copper_cable_hub" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

| 规则 | 为什么重要 |
| --- | --- |
| 必须是方形 | 长方形无法组装 |
| 所有方块朝同一面 | 输出在标记的那一面 |
| 从顶部抽出二氧化碳 | 积聚会堵住过程 |
| 从其他面抽出杂酚油 | 它是有独立用途的副产物 |

按官方维基说明，更大的方形每批完成得更快，每份产物的杂酚油更少。先建小炉，之后再把大炉当作产量决策。

***

## 炼钢需要热风

高炉把铁变成熔融钢与硅，只靠燃料不行。每次加工都需要热风供应，因此加热炉是结构的一部分，不是升级件。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_hatch" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_stove" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:fireproof_bricks" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:blast_furnace_output" /> | 输出方块，所有部件朝向它 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:blast_furnace_hatch" /> | 输入与操作入口 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:blast_stove" /> | 提供热风 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:fireproof_bricks" /> 与加固块 | 外壳，以及提速升级 |

运行中的高炉按固定计时消耗燃料，加固方块让每次加工更快。把它建在焦炉旁边，焦炭就不必搬运，同时让输入口保持可被漏斗触及。

***

## 石油、蒸馏与引擎

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:surface_scanner" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:pumpjack_base" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_controller" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:regular_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:large_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| 阶段 | 部件 |
| --- | --- |
| 找矿藏 | <ItemLink id="tfmg:surface_scanner" /> 报告区块下方的石油 |
| 抽取 | <ItemLink id="tfmg:pumpjack_base" /> 配管道与传动 |
| 输送 | 用 <ItemLink id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" />，而不是一桶桶搬 |
| 分馏 | <ItemLink id="tfmg:steel_distillation_controller" /> 配输出 |
| 浇铸或混合 | <ItemLink id="tfmg:casting_basin" />、<ItemLink id="tfmg:industrial_mixer" />、<ItemLink id="tfmg:steel_chemical_vat" /> |
| 燃烧 | <ItemLink id="tfmg:regular_engine" />、<ItemLink id="tfmg:simple_large_engine" />、<ItemLink id="tfmg:large_engine" />、<ItemLink id="tfmg:radial_engine" />、<ItemLink id="tfmg:turbine_engine" /> |

引擎是旋转来源，不是发电设备。每个家族对燃料的要求不同，大型引擎接受更粗糙的燃料，但需要稳定的空气供应。铺抽取路线之前先看抽油机条目，管道布局照着做比自行推导容易。

***

## 它自己的电网

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:generator" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:heavy_electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:transformer" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:voltmeter" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:electricians_wrench" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:generator" /> | 把旋转变成电力 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:electric_motor" /> | 把电力变回旋转 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:heavy_electric_motor" /> | 承担重负载的大型电机 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:transformer" /> | 在电压组之间转换 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:voltmeter" /> | 读取工业电路 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:electricians_wrench" /> | 配置工业电气部件 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:winding_machine" /> | 有旋转输入时把线轴绕在原料外 |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:freezer" /> 与 <ItemLink id="tfmg:compressor" /> | 冷却与压缩工段 |

这套电网不是 Electro Energetics 的电网。两个模组对电的建模方式不同，部件不能互相接入，因此一座建筑选一套并保持一致。[电力](power.electricity.md)说明另一套系统。

下一步是热，因为焦炉与高炉都要烧东西。[燃烧与燃料](power.burners.md)说明供热一侧。

power.burners.en_us:
## Heat is its own resource

A <ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" /> supplies heat to the block above it. It is not rotation and it is not electricity, so a machine can have full rotation and still do nothing because its burner is cold.

Start with an <ItemLink id="create:empty_blaze_burner" />. That is the crafted item, not a captured blaze.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/empty_blaze_burner" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:empty_blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:blaze_rod" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| State | What you see |
| --- | --- |
| Empty burner | A cold cage, it supplies no heat |
| Fed burner | A blaze inside, ordinary heat, flames at the sides |
| Superheated burner | Taller flame, used by recipes that demand it |

To capture a blaze, place the empty burner and let a blaze walk into it. A burner with a blaze inside can be picked up with a wrench and moved without losing it.

***

## Feed it, or pipe it

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| Route | What it gives |
| --- | --- |
| Burnable items dropped in | Ordinary heat for as long as the fuel lasts |
| A blaze cake | Superheated, for the recipes that name it |
| Liquid fuel through a pipe | Ordinary heat without restocking the burner by hand |
| Lava | Ordinary heat only, never superheat |

Create: Liquid Fuel is what makes the pipe route work. It does not add a new burner, it lets the existing one accept fluid from a tank, so a single tank can feed a row of burners through pipes and a pump.

The pump in this pack moves fluid 16 blocks to either side, and a tank holds 8 buckets per block. A bank of three burners under a basin is a small demand, so one tank is normally enough.

***

## Unified fuels does not mean any fuel

Create: Unified Fuels connects supported consumers through shared fuel groups, and it generates compatibility data instead of adding machines. The selected release covers systems such as The Factory Must Grow, the Crafts and Additions burners, Liquid Fuel and the Stuff 'N Additions fueling tanks when those mods are present.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:regular_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| Question | Where the answer is |
| --- | --- |
| Will this fluid burn here | The consumer's own entry, not the fluid's name |
| Will it superheat | Only fuels the burner lists as superheating |
| Is diesel accepted by a burner | Only if the burner's group includes it |

Refinery intermediates, process chemicals and steam are not automatically burnable. A shared fuel supply is a convenience for consumers that already accept the same group, not a universal adapter.

Test with one bucket before plumbing a line across a base. If the burner rejects it, the fluid is outside its group, and no amount of pipe will change that.

Heat and rotation meet at the same machine. [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) covers the drive side, and [Industrial machinery](power.industry.md) covers the furnaces that use the most heat.
power.burners.zh_cn:
## 热是独立的资源

<ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" /> 为它上方的方块供热。它不是旋转，也不是电力，因此一台机器可能旋转充足却毫无反应，因为它的燃烧器是冷的。

先做一只 <ItemLink id="create:empty_blaze_burner" />。这是合成出来的物品，不是已收服的烈焰人。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/empty_blaze_burner" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:empty_blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:blaze_rod" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| 状态 | 看到什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 空燃烧器 | 冷笼子，不供热 |
| 有燃料的燃烧器 | 内有烈焰人，普通热，两侧有火 |
| 过热燃烧器 | 火焰更高，供需要过热的配方使用 |

收服烈焰人时，放下空燃烧器，让烈焰人走进去。内有烈焰人的燃烧器可以用扳手取下搬走，烈焰人不会丢失。

***

## 投料或用管道供料

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

| 途径 | 得到什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 投入可燃物品 | 燃料持续期间提供普通热 |
| 烈焰蛋糕 | 过热，供明确要求过热的配方 |
| 通过管道送入液体燃料 | 不必手动补料的普通热 |
| 熔岩 | 只有普通热，从不过热 |

让管道途径成立的是 Create: Liquid Fuel。它不新增燃烧器，而是让现有燃烧器接受来自储罐的流体，因此一只储罐可以通过管道与泵供给一整排燃烧器。

本包的泵向两侧各输送 16 格流体，储罐每格存 8 桶。工作盆下方三只燃烧器需求不大，通常一只储罐就够。

***

## 统一燃料不等于任何燃料

Create: Unified Fuels 通过共享燃料组连接受支持的用能设备，它生成兼容数据，不新增机器。所选版本覆盖 The Factory Must Grow、Crafts and Additions 的燃烧器、Liquid Fuel 与 Stuff 'N Additions 的加注罐等系统，前提是对应模组存在。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:regular_engine" /></ItemGrid>

| 问题 | 答案在哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 这种流体在这里能烧吗 | 看用能设备自己的条目，不看流体名称 |
| 能否过热 | 只有燃烧器列为可过热的燃料才行 |
| 柴油能被燃烧器接受吗 | 只有该燃烧器的燃料组包含它才行 |

精炼中间产物、工艺化学品与蒸汽不会自动成为可燃燃料。共享燃料供应服务于本来就接受同一燃料组的设备，它不是万能转换器。

跨基地铺线之前先用一桶测试。燃烧器拒收，说明该流体不在它的燃料组里，再多的管道也改变不了。

热与旋转在同一台机器上会合。[旋转动力](machines.rotation.md)说明传动一侧，[工业机械](power.industry.md)说明最耗热的炉子。

power.stored-rotation.en_us:
## A battery for rotation

A <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> stores rotation as stress and gives it back later. It charges while it has no redstone signal and discharges while powered, which means a lever decides when the reserve runs the line.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /><ItemIcon id="create:analog_lever" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:kinetic_interface" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:portative_steam_engine" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:punchcard" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> | Charges unpowered, discharges powered |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | Moves capacity between two separate networks |
| <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" /> | Shows what the battery is doing to the network |
| <ItemLink id="create:analog_lever" /> | A clean way to switch discharge on |

In the current release the battery keeps its charge in item form and only releases the stress the network actually needs, so you can carry a charged battery to a distant site instead of building a shaft line there. Capacity, discharge speed and stress impact are all configurable, so two packs can legitimately disagree about the numbers.

***

## Springs store the same thing differently

A <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring" /> holds rotation and releases it on demand. The difference is control. A spring responds to signal strength, so a comparator or an analog lever can set why and how hard it releases.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_alloy" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:unfinished_spring" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:friction_welder" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_base" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_catapult" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_drill" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_fan" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_launcher" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_saw" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_shove" /></ItemGrid>

| Part | Job |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_alloy" /> | The material springs are made from |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:unfinished_spring" /> | The form that becomes a spring |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:friction_welder" /> | Applies the alloy to the unfinished spring |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /> | A larger coil for bigger reserves |

The released recipe applies spring alloy to an unfinished spring with the friction welder, which needs rotation. That makes the first spring a two step project, and it is why spring alloy is worth stockpiling before you want a dozen.

A spring can also release with enough force to break blocks. Keep splash mode, or any high setting, away from a normal reserve, and test the setting on a throwaway structure.

***

## Which reserve fits

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring" /></ItemGrid>

| Reserve | Best for |
| --- | --- |
| Kinetic Battery | A compact buffer on one network, switched by redstone |
| Spring | Signal controlled output, and moving a reserve to where it is needed |

A battery answers a stoppage. A spring answers a demand that changes. Most bases need one of the two, and the choice is about how the reserve should switch on.

The first action is a battery on a line that already runs, with a lever on its discharge side. Watch the stressometer fall when the source stops, and watch production continue.

Reserves do not create capacity out of nothing. [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) owns the stress budget and the speed rules.
power.stored-rotation.zh_cn:
## 旋转用的蓄电池

<ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> 把旋转存为应力，之后再放出来。没有红石信号时充电，通电时放电，因此由一只拉杆决定储备什么时候带动线路。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /><ItemIcon id="create:analog_lever" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:kinetic_interface" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:portative_steam_engine" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:punchcard" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_base" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_catapult" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_drill" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_fan" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_launcher" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_saw" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_shove" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> | 无信号充电，有信号放电 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | 在两个独立网络之间转移容量 |
| <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" /> | 显示蓄电池对网络做了什么 |
| <ItemLink id="create:analog_lever" /> | 干净的放电开关 |

在当前版本中，蓄电池以物品形态保留电量，并且只释放网络实际需要的应力，因此可以把充满的蓄电池带到远处的工地，而不必在那里拉一条轴。容量、放电速度与应力消耗都可配置，不同整合包的数字因此可以不同。

***

## 弹簧用另一种方式存同样的东西

<ItemLink id="createsprings:spring" /> 储存旋转，按需释放。区别在控制方式。弹簧响应红石信号强度，因此比较器或模拟拉杆可以决定它释放多少、为什么释放。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_alloy" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:unfinished_spring" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:friction_welder" /></ItemGrid>

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_alloy" /> | 制作弹簧的材料 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:unfinished_spring" /> | 会成为弹簧的形态 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:friction_welder" /> | 把合金应用到未完成的弹簧上 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /> | 更大储备用的大线圈 |

已发布的配方用摩擦焊接机把弹簧合金应用到未完成的弹簧上，而焊接机需要旋转。因此第一只弹簧是两步工程，这也是在需要一打弹簧之前就囤合金的理由。

弹簧释放的力量也能破坏方块。把溅射模式或任何高设定与普通储备分开，并且先用临时建筑测试设定。

***

## 三种储备怎么选

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring" /></ItemGrid>

| 储备 | 适合什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 动力蓄电池 | 同一网络上的紧凑缓冲，用红石切换 |
| 弹簧 | 按信号控制输出，把储备移动到需要的地方 |

蓄电池应对停转。弹簧应对变化的需求。多数基地只需要其中一个，区别在于储备该如何开启。

第一步是在一条已经在转的线上装蓄电池，并在放电侧装拉杆。电源停下时看应力表下降，同时看生产继续。

储备不会凭空创造容量。[旋转动力](machines.rotation.md)统一说明应力预算与转速规则。
